jobs.excerpt: Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.
jobs.description:
Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.

Companies like Delta Air Lines, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, and Microsoft use the Chooose platform to build, operate, and scale their lower carbon fuel programs (typically referred to as Sustainable Aviation Fuel, or SAF), and to advance voluntary and compliance carbon management initiatives.

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

The role

As a Engagement Manager at Chooose, you will partner with our enterprise customers in the aviation and energy sectors, enabling them to build and operate their SAF programs. In close collaboration with the Chooose Customer organization, you will own day-to-day relationships with our largest customers in your assigned region, supporting customers across their entire experience with the Chooose platform, from implementation to solution go-live and beyond.
This is a remote role that must be based in Illinois, Texas, Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida
Alt ID: Strategic Account Manager / Client Partner / Engagement Manager / Enterprise CSM / Strategic Account Lead

What you'll do

  • Own total responsibility for a portfolio of key enterprise customers within the aviation, energy, and logistics sectors.
  • Become the expert on the customer's SAF program. Thoroughly understand the customer’s program objectives, and guide how the customer leverages the Chooose platform to reach these objectives.
  • Cultivate high-trust relationships with key stakeholders across our customer organizations (from Sustainability to Fuel Procurement) and function as the customer's trusted advisor.
  • Drive customer success. Assess, clarify, and validate customer needs and new commercial expansion opportunities on an ongoing basis. Proactively qualify and champion these needs and opportunities internally, with an emphasis on gathering and delivering structured product feedback.
  • Maintain a balanced approach and multiple perspectives. Enable commercial growth while considering Chooose's commitment to enabling long-term, high-integrity climate action.
  • Manage complex software deployments. Supported by an assigned Technical Implementation Manager and other key resources, oversee the implementation of complex decarbonization programs including a range of climate solutions from Sustainable Aviation Fuel to carbon offsets and removals.
  • Refine our playbook. Drive continuous improvement across Technical Implementation, Customer Operations, and Customer Success functions.
  • Collaborate with multiple Chooose teams to execute the operational tasks needed to achieve program objectives on time and with high quality.
  • Proactively and continually educate yourself on the carbon-related requirements and market trends impacting our customers and the sectors in which we operate.

What you bring to the table

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited institution, ideally in the hard sciences.
  • Minimum of 4 years of demonstrated success in management consulting, SaaS implementation, enterprise project management, or similar.
  • Experience in enterprise software organizations relating to carbon markets, fuel markets, or carbon accounting is a plus.
  • Technical capability. You enjoy helping customers solve business and technical problems, and are comfortable with technical and highly configurable SaaS solutions. Previous experience with API integrations and enterprise-grade SaaS solutions is a plus.
  • You listen carefully and authentically care about solving customer problems.
  • Polished presentation skills and are comfortable discussing technical and commercial topics with external stakeholders.
  • Self-directed problem solver who takes initiative
  • Flexible with work hours for global customer support.
  • You're willing to be flexible with your work hours to support your colleagues and accommodate our global customers.
  • You’re open to frequent travel on short notice.
  • You have superior verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Spanish is a plus.
  • Must be based in Illinois, Texas, Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida

The interview process

At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process. If your qualifications look like a fit, we’ll begin with a few introductory conversations where you'll have the chance to discuss your experience and learn more about our company. The second phase varies depending on the role and will involve a practical exercise for you to show your work. You’ll receive written instructions for the exercise in advance, and we’ll then schedule a time to discuss. The third and final phase consists of a one-on-one conversation with a member of our executive team. The process should take approx. 4-6 weeks. While we strive to keep to this timeline, the occasional adjustment may occur; we’re focused on ensuring enough time to get to know one another.

Pay, perks, & more

We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, voluntary 401k contributions, paid parental leave, a robust PTO package, the option to participate in our employee equity program, flexible work hours, and access to 'Spaces' coworking space.
We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply.
Compensation will be based on experience and skill, commensurate with market rates, and will include both salary and equity in Chooose.
Chooose is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment to our employees and welcome input from candidates and employees on how we can enhance our inclusiveness.
Prerequisite for Employment: Chooose may request to conduct background checks on prospective applicants to verify the information provided in the CV, transcripts, and other documentation. This background check may be carried out by our partner and will not be conducted without the applicant's prior consent. Prospective applicants will receive more information about this.

Claims and Labeling Manager

Reports to: Standards Senior Director

Remote – US, Europe

About Us

Textile Exchange is a global non-profit driving positive impact on climate change across the fashion and textile industry. It guides a growing community of brands, manufacturers, and farmers towards more purposeful production from the very start of the supply chain.

By 2030, its goal is to guide the industry to achieve a 45% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions within fiber and raw material production. Its focus is holistic and interconnected, accelerating the adoption of practices that improve the state of our water, soil health, and biodiversity too.

For real change to happen, everyone needs a clear path to positive impact. That’s why Textile Exchange believes that approachable, step-by-step instruction paired with collective action can change the system to make preferred materials and fibers an accessible default, mobilizing leaders through attainable strategies, proven solutions, and a driven community.

At Textile Exchange, materials matter. To learn more, visit TextileExchange.org.

Working at Textile Exchange 

We work remotely with a team located in 20+ countries. We are a diverse group committed to harnessing the strengths of the global textile industry to accelerate change toward climate and other key environmental goals. We work collaboratively on important environmental issues around the world by working and interacting with farming groups, processors, brands, retailers, and environmental experts in the textile and fashion industries around the world. We offer an opportunity to join a cutting-edge global environmental nonprofit and to help strengthen the impact of our organization.

Position Summary

The Claims and Labeling Manager is responsible for the policies and procedures that support the use of claims and labels related to the standards systems. This role combines criteria development, policy management, guidance development, and content expertise; and collaborates with internal teams on claims maker support, stakeholder engagement, and communications. This role will manage direct report(s), including goal setting, performance management, coaching, and professional development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure the consistent, accurate and credible application of claims and labeling requirements across Textile Exchange standards, supporting stakeholder confidence and trust in the integrity of certified claims.
  • Enable effective stakeholder use of claims and labels by providing expert guidance and claims submission approval support, resulting in timely and consistent outcomes for standards users and certification bodies.
  • Drive stakeholder understanding and adoption of claims and labeling requirements through clear guidance, training and education, reducing confusion and improving complaince across the system.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manage the development and revisions of the standards system claims and labeling policies and associated documents, including drafting/revising criteria, holding meetings with internal and external key stakeholders, facilitating public and targeted consultations, and the finalization and publication of new versions of the documents. 
  • Manage ISEAL code compliance and best practice as it relates to claims.
  • Develop procedures, guidance and tools to support the standard system claims framework.
  • Collaborate with internal legislation experts to understand risks and opportunities related to developing or existing legislative requirements.
  • Collaborate other departments and teams to support stakeholders and their use of the Textile Exchange trademarks and credible claims; 
  • Manage inquiries from external stakeholders regarding claims and trademark use via the case management system.

Secondary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manage team members, including goal setting, performance management and professional development.
  • Serve as lead on key projects related to claims and labeling.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience working with voluntary standards and/or verification programs.
  • Possess strong understanding of credible sustainability claims and trademark use related to certification.  
  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing staff, including performance management, coaching and professional development.
  • Confident and highly capable of leading projects, managing deadlines, and delivering on workplans. 
  • Able to work with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders globally, and comfortable with a dynamic environment. 
  • Detail-oriented, logical, systematic, methodical, and highly organized.  
  • Excellent written and grammatical skills in English to draft technical content. Ability to synthesize and present complex information in a simple, meaningful way.  
  • Familiarity with business analytics tools such as Power BI and CRM tools such as Salesforce.
  • A driven individual with a strong work ethic and high degree of autonomy; self-starting and proactive.  
  • Demonstrated interest in Textile Exchange’s vision, mission, and goals.  
  • ​Ability to work in a flexible, yet fast-paced remote environment, able to meet deadlines and share progress regularly.
  • Flexibility of working across multiple time zones and ability to overlap with the North American time zones for parts of the workday. 
  • Experience working at an international organization. 
  • Ability to travel occasionally for conferences, work meetings and industry events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in global textile supply chains, and comprehensive understanding of global supply chains and stakeholders.
  • Understanding of the Empowering Consumers Directive (ECD).
  • Experience with ISEAL compliant schemes.

Customer Engagement & Strategy

Post-Sales Partnership

  • Continue as a trusted advisor to enterprise leadership, ensuring ongoing alignment of their evolving needs with solution capabilities.

  • Strong understanding of networking (LAN/WAN, routing, switching, VPNs, TCP/IP) and core security protocols (IPSec, TLS/SSL, PKI, SAML, OAuth, RADIUS, etc.).
  • Ability to articulate and design solutions across:

    • Zero Trust and SASE architectures
    • Cloud and hybrid security (IaaS, SaaS, containerized workloads)

This is an opportunity to operate at the intersection of cybersecurity strategy, executive engagement, and customer success, influencing large-scale enterprise organizations as they modernize operations and adopt cutting-edge solutions. Due to growth, we are adding a Director, Transformation Operations to our team!

We are seeking a proven transformation leader with deep Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) experience who has successfully led operational transformation during periods of rapid growth, organizational scaling, and process realignment. This individual will bring a unique blend of strategic vision and hands-on execution, helping our organization evolve capabilities, optimize operations, and deliver enterprise-wide transformation outcomes.

The Director, Transformation Operations serves as the dedicated owner of the Transformation Office operating system and enterprise transformation portfolio performance discipline.

This role ensures the enterprise transformation program operates with discipline, consistency, visibility, decision quality, and follow-through. The role owns enterprise transformation portfolio performance visibility, accountability disciplines, delivery confidence reporting, path-to-green management, operating cadence, governance readiness, action management, and executive reporting coordination.

This is a highly visible role that requires both tactical leadership and strategic influence. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable designing enterprise transformation frameworks and governance models as they are rolling up their sleeves to remove barriers, drive accountability, refine processes, and ensure initiatives stay on track. They will help align transformation efforts to business priorities while creating the operational rigor needed to sustain growth and scale.

The Director, Transformation Operations partners closely with the Strategic Transformation Officer, Chief of Staff, EPMO, Finance, Communications, Change, Value Stream Owners, Orchestrators, business owners, and technology leaders to ensure transformation work is organized, transparent, decision-useful, and advancing against enterprise commitments. By ensuring the Transformation Office operating system runs reliably, the role enables senior leadership to focus on strategic acceleration, enterprise capabilities, stakeholder alignment, enterprise-level risk management, and long-range planning.

If you have helped a PBM navigate growth, drive complex operational transformation, realign processes, and build scalable ways of working while balancing strategic thinking with practical execution, we'd love to hear from you.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Own the Transformation Office operating system, governance cadence, and execution disciplines that enable effective enterprise transformation delivery.
  • Lead governance readiness and coordination for Transformation Operating Committee meetings, Value Stream Owner and Orchestrator forums, leadership reviews, and other transformation governance routines.
  • Develop and manage governance agendas, materials, decision logs, and follow-up processes that drive focused discussions and actionable outcomes.
  • Maintain the enterprise transformation accountability framework, ensuring decisions, commitments, actions, and deliverables are tracked, escalated, and resolved.
  • Drive follow-through across Value Stream Owners, Orchestrators, EPMO, Finance, Communications, Change Management, business leaders, and technology partners.
  • Identify execution barriers, stalled commitments, unresolved decisions, and organizational impediments, while facilitating timely escalation and resolution.
  • Ensure leadership decisions translate into clear ownership, measurable outcomes, defined timelines, and transparent accountability.
  • Own enterprise transformation portfolio performance visibility across initiatives, value streams, and governance forums.
  • Partner with EPMO, Finance, and transformation leaders to gather, validate, challenge, and synthesize portfolio performance information.
  • Establish and maintain standardized reporting for milestones, risks, dependencies, delivery confidence, value realization, and path-to-green activities.

About Prime Coalition

Prime Coalition is a nonprofit organization with a mission to bridge critical funding gaps to transform markets into a force for climate solutions. Prime Coalition envisions a world in which humanity thrives without the threat of climate change.

The world’s most complex social and environmental problems — like climate change — will often require the speed and scale of market-based solutions. In 2014, Prime Coalition and its growing coalition of visionary philanthropists began deploying catalytic capital alongside traditional grantmaking to mitigate global greenhouse gas emissions through early-stage technology innovation. Today, Prime Coalition knocks down barriers for philanthropists to deploy charitable capital into a broader set of untapped climate solutions. Our team’s deep philanthropy expertise and commitment to evidence-based assessment of impact and additionality guide philanthropists toward programs they can trust to enable climate change mitigation, adaptation, and resilience.

We see our respect for our teammates, planet, and communities as inexorably linked. How we treat one another and embody values in our lives and work is deeply important. We ground our work in our values of tenacity, humility, and care.

About the Position

The Manager, Accounting is a new position for Prime Coalition and will join the Finance & Operations Department reporting directly to the Director, Finance. In your role, you will be pivotal to Prime Coalition's daily accounting workflows, ensuring every transaction is accurate and policy-compliant.

This position is for someone with a strong accounting foundation who is comfortable working across multiple systems, handling and reconciling detailed financial data, supporting financial reporting used by leadership, and supporting the Director, Finance to ensure grantor, audit, and tax deliverables are accurate, complete, and well-supported.

Job responsibilities include but are not limited to:

General Accounting - 40%

  • Accurate recording and consolidation of all financial transactions and financial notes for Prime Coalition and its disregarded entities in accordance with GAAP and IRS regulations, including:
    • Recording financial transactions accurately against required dimensions, including restrictions and project codes
    • Calculating and recording journal entries for monthly allocations, following approved methodologies
    • Recording the financial transactions of all of Prime Coalition’s investment programs, including assets, liabilities, interest accruals, cash management, and returns for Prime Coalition’s catalytic investments
    • Recording inter-company transactions
    • Delivering detailed data reconciliations and analytical support to the Director, Finance
    • Ensuring accounting data is accurate and ready for monthly, quarterly, or annual reconciliations
  • Maintain secure file locations for all accounting-related documents
  • Support Director, Finance to track assigned KPIs
  • Support Director, Finance with the day-to-day operations of Prime Coalition’s catalytic investing program
  • Support Director, Finance to maintain up-to-date employee training decks for accounting processes

Accounts Payable & Receivable - 35%

  • Oversee the accounts payable platforms, including:
    • Ensuring proper coding, approval workflows, and documentation
    • Timely processing of payables and payments
    • Managing employee expense process
  • Support Director, Finance to ensure revenue and receivables entries meet GAAP and IRS regulations and documentation is audit ready
  • Support monthly reconciliation between financial software and CRM/fundraising software

Audit, Tax, & Compliance - 20%

  • Assist in preparing schedules and supporting documentation for the annual audit
  • Support tax preparation process, including supporting schedules for Form 990 and state filings
  • Maintain documentation in a format that supports audit readiness
  • Issue annual 1099 Forms and 1042-S Forms per IRS regulations
  • Support Director, Finance to ensure compliance with statutory law and financial regulations

Shared Expectations

  • A commitment to Prime Coalition’s mission and its values
  • Active participant in diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging training
  • Collaborative with a sense of humility
  • Intrinsic, driving motivation to mitigate climate change
  • Self-motivation and flexibility
  • Willingness to be a productive member of a team, respecting differences while working toward shared goals

Qualifications

Education & Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, taxation, or related field and 4–7 years of progressive responsibility in finance, accounting, or tax experience; or 7–10 years of equivalent professional experience
  • Proficiency with accounting software(s) (Sage Intacct preferred) and banking platforms
  • Strong foundation in accounting principles, including general ledger accounting, journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, and financial reporting
  • Experience supporting finance and accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, month-end close activities, and financial recordkeeping
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain accurate, complete, and well-supported financial records with a high degree of attention to detail
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and data reconciliation
  • Ability to independently manage recurring processes and deadlines while maintaining accuracy, consistency, and strong internal controls
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting audit or tax preparation processes
  • Demonstrated understanding of non-profit accounting related to 501(c)3 organizations
  • Familiarity with investment-related transactions, reconciliations, valuations, or reporting
  • Experience working with Sage Intacct, Emburse Nexonia, Raiser’s Edge NXT, or similar platforms
  • Experience using technology to improve workflows, reduce manual steps, and strengthen documentation and reporting
  • Demonstrated fluency in financial statements and accounting procedures

To Apply

Please submit your resume, cover letter, and brief response to the short application question. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is October 11, 2026.

Our Commitment To Equity

To ensure an equitable hiring process, Prime Coalition does not hold informational interviews. We encourage you to review our website and the job posting to learn more about our work, values, and the key competencies and qualities we seek.

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Research shows that men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria. Yet, women and other people who are systematically marginalized tend to only apply if they meet every requirement. If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply. We are dedicated to considering a broad array of candidates, including those with diverse workplace experiences and backgrounds. Whether you’re new to the field, returning to work after a gap in employment, simply looking to transition, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar. Please use your cover letter to tell us about your interest and what you hope to bring to this role.

The Marketing OS – LeadGen Team owns the products and platform capabilities that help agencies attract, engage, capture, qualify, and understand leads across digital and offline customer journeys.

  • Forms and form-building experiences

  • Surveys and customer data-collection workflows

You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and Data on your portfolio, partner with adjacent product teams on shared foundations, and help shape how HighLevel competes in lead generation, conversational engagement, behavioral tracking, and marketing attribution.

Your work will directly impact product adoption, lead volume, lead quality, engagement, conversion, retention, and overall platform growth.

Slang.ai is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient. Our mission is to transform the restaurant industry by providing the ultimate voice AI solution for consistently outstanding customer experiences. At Slang.ai, we foster a culture of innovation, inclusivity, and growth, ensuring that every "Slangsta" (employee) feels valued and connected to our broader AI driven impact.

What Your Experience Will Be:

As a Slang Ambassador in our referral program, you will have the unique opportunity to leverage your industry expertise and network to help restaurants discover the value of Slang.ai. Working directly with our Sales Director and Account Executives, you will play a vital role in our growth by introducing potential buyers to our team. Your role is flexible, impactful, and designed to reward you for successful outcomes.
You will begin with a personalized onboarding process, including training on Slang.ai’s value proposition, the tools we provide, and our ideal customer profile. Together, we’ll identify the best-fit restaurants for you to target, ensuring your efforts lead to mutual success.

Why You Belong Here & Why you will Grow:

At Slang.ai, trust forms the cornerstone of our relationships—both internally and externally. As a Slang Ambassador, you’ll embody this trust as the first point of contact for many potential customers. You’ll work closely with our team in a collaborative and supportive environment that prioritizes growth, inclusion, and learning.
This role is perfect for individuals who are well-connected in the restaurant industry and want a flexible, results-driven opportunity to contribute to an innovative company. You’ll gain firsthand experience in the world of AI-powered customer solutions and have the chance to deepen your industry expertise while being fairly compensated for your efforts.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Introductions Made: Actively identify and connect restaurants to Slang’s Account Executives via email introductions.
  • Demo Engagements: Help drive successful demos by making warm, trusted introductions.
  • Conversions: Facilitate successful deals by introducing restaurants with a high likelihood of adopting Slang.ai.
  • Compensation Earned: You will earn monetary rewards based on the number of successful deals closed from your referrals.

What You Will Bring:

  • Industry Expertise: A strong network in the restaurant industry, with proven connections to decision-makers.
  • Relationship Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust quickly.
  • Entrepreneurship: A self-starter mindset with the ability to work independently and manage your time effectively.
  • Collaborative Spirit: A willingness to engage with Slang’s team and contribute to the program’s overall success.
  • Alignment with Our Mission: Passion for innovation and improving the customer experience in the restaurant industry.

How you will work

At Slang.ai, we understand the importance of flexibility and balance. As a Referral Partner, you will operate on your own schedule, with no strict time commitments. You will work remotely, using tools we provide for seamless collaboration and communication. Compensation is monetary and based on performance, offering a straightforward and rewarding engagement model.

Our Vision

Calling a business shouldn’t feel like a robot-hostage situation, where you’re forced to listen to horrible music and can't reach a human, while enduring a soulless voice uttering "I'm sorry I didn't quite get that" on repeat for eternity. (shudder) That’s why we started Slang.ai. We use the latest AI and audio wizardry to make transacting via voice so enjoyable it’s more human than human. By 2030, we will save businesses and consumers 1 billion minutes of precious time while transforming voice channels into the preferred mode of communication (it's faster and easier than text).
We have backgrounds building product at companies like Spotify, Buzzfeed, the New York Times, and OpenTable —shipping experiences that have reached hundreds of millions of users. Now, we’re using our backgrounds to start a new culture, one that puts product and human-centered design above all else while fostering constant learning and growth. Sound like something you’d like to be part of? Get on board.

Our Values

Overachiever Fever. We’re overachievers (we don’t know any other way)
Learner Fervor. We take every opportunity to learn (especially when it’s hard)
Humility Ability. We approach each other with curiosity and openness (know-it-alls not welcome!)
SMB MVP. We’re an expert member of our customers’ teams (we earn their trust)

Junior Full-Stack Developer

Full-Time | $7-$10 USD/Hour Starting
Remote | Philippines or Indonesia

About the Role

We are looking for a smart, resourceful junior full-stack developer who wants the opportunity to grow into a major engineering role.

This position is designed for someone early in their career who already understands the fundamentals of web development but has the potential to become much more. You do not need to know everything yet. We care more about your problem-solving ability, technical curiosity, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

You will work across our SaaS platform—building features, fixing bugs, improving user workflows, and testing your own work. Initially, you will receive smaller, clearly defined assignments. As your skills and understanding of the product grow, you will be given greater responsibility and more complex projects.

We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company—not someone looking for a short-term freelance project.

Responsibilities

Full-Stack Development

  • Build and improve frontend and backend features.
  • Fix bugs throughout the application.
  • Create and update user interfaces, forms, validation rules, and workflows.
  • Work with APIs, databases, and third-party integrations.
  • Read and understand an existing codebase.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-organized code.
  • Use Git to manage code changes and collaborate with the engineering team.
  • Participate in code reviews and apply feedback from senior developers.
  • Assist with deployments and post-deployment verification.

Testing and Product Quality

  • Test your own work thoroughly before submitting it for review.
  • Reproduce and investigate customer-reported issues.
  • Identify edge cases and unexpected user behavior.
  • Write clear bug reports with reproduction steps, screenshots, or videos.
  • Perform regression testing to ensure changes do not break existing features.
  • Recommend improvements to usability, performance, and reliability.

Requirements

  • You must be able to independently read, understand, and evaluate code.
    Do not apply if you rely on Claude to generate code that you cannot explain, debug, or verify yourself.**
  • Basic full-stack web development experience.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Git.
  • Familiarity with frontend frameworks such as React.
  • Basic understanding of backend development, APIs, and databases.
  • Ability to troubleshoot problems using browser developer tools and logs.
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Ability to explain your thinking clearly and ask good questions.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to test your own work.
  • Ability to work independently and manage assigned tasks.
  • Willingness to work overnight locally during U.S. business hours.
  • Reliable computer and internet connection.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Experience building personal, school, freelance, or professional web applications.
  • Experience working with REST APIs and relational databases.
  • Familiarity with SaaS applications and subscription-based products.
  • Experience with Asana or similar project-management tools.
  • A GitHub profile, portfolio, or working application that demonstrates your abilities.
  • Previous experience working with a remote international team.

Professional experience is helpful, but it is not required if you can demonstrate strong technical ability through projects or practical work.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate:

  • Learns quickly and actively searches for solutions.
  • Can take a problem from investigation through implementation and testing.
  • Is comfortable admitting when they do not know something.
  • Accepts feedback without becoming defensive.
  • Pays attention to how the entire product works—not only the assigned ticket.
  • Looks for underlying causes instead of applying temporary fixes.
  • Shows the potential to take ownership of larger systems over time.
  • Wants to become a highly capable full-stack engineer.

What Success Looks Like

  • Assigned features and fixes are completed accurately and on time.
  • Code is tested before being submitted for review.
  • Questions are thoughtful, specific, and asked early.
  • Mistakes are learned from and are not repeatedly made.
  • Knowledge of the platform grows steadily.
  • The developer progresses from smaller assignments to independently owning features.
  • Responsibility and compensation can increase as technical ability and contribution grow.

Overview

Position Summary:

The Sr. Total Rewards Analyst supports the design, analysis, governance, and communication of Mercury’s compensation and benefits programs. This role is primarily focused on compensation, representing approximately 60% of the position, with approximately 40% focused on benefits strategy, program evaluation, governance, and communications. The analyst uses data, sound judgment, and business partnership to help ensure programs are equitable, competitive, compliant, and aligned with Mercury’s business and talent priorities.

A significant portion of the role will support Mercury’s current career architecture project underway. The Sr. Total Rewards Analyst will analyze job and compensation data, assess implications for pay structures and processes, weigh in on design decisions, and provide informed recommendations to support alignment between career architecture and compensation.The role partners with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Payroll, HRIS, benefits consultants, vendors, and business leaders. Success requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, effective communication, discretion with confidential information, and the ability to translate complex Total Rewards topics into practical recommendations.

Geo-Salary Information

An in-person interview may be required during the hiring process

State specific pay scales for this role are as follows:

$83,670 to $161,815 (NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

$76,064 to $147,104 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME)

$68,457 to $132,394 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV)

In CA: Typical hiring range is $110,468 to $135,016

The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

Compensation Strategy & Analytics

  • Support compensation philosophy, governance, and program design across employee populations.
  • Conduct market pricing, benchmarking, internal equity, pay equity, range, and compensation analysis.
  • Prepare models, dashboards, reports, and recommendations for HR leaders, managers, and business stakeholders.
  • Support annual compensation planning, incentive processes, offer reviews, promotions, transfers, and other pay decisions.
  • Maintain compensation structures, job data, range information, and related documentation in partnership with Total Rewards and HRIS teams.

Career Architecture Project

  • Play a significant role in Mercury’s current career architecture project underway.
  • Analyze job and compensation data and assess how proposed job families, sub-families, levels, and role placement may affect pay structures, internal equity, and compensation processes.
  • Weigh in on design decisions, identify compensation-related risks and opportunities, and provide data-driven recommendations.
  • Support job data alignment, documentation, stakeholder coordination, communications, and integration with compensation processes.

Benefits Strategy & Governance

  • Support the strategy, governance, and ongoing evaluation of health and welfare, 401k/retirement, time-off, and other employee benefit programs.
  • Analyze participation, utilization, cost, vendor performance, and employee experience data to inform recommendations.
  • Partner with benefits consultants, carriers, vendors, HRIS, Payroll, and internal stakeholders to evaluate program performance, resolve issues, and support effective delivery.
  • Support annual enrollment strategy and other benefits communications by developing and reviewing content for accuracy, clarity, and compliance.
  • Analyze audit results, issue patterns, and plan information to identify risks and opportunities for improvement; direct administrative matters to the appropriate operational owner.

Business Partnership & Advisory

  • Provide clear, practical guidance to HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, managers, employees, and business leaders on compensation and benefits topics.
  • Explain complex Total Rewards concepts in plain language and develop manager- and employee-facing materials.
  • Protect confidential employee and company information and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive data.

Data, Tools & Continuous Improvement

  • Use HRIS, compensation planning, reporting, spreadsheet, and other analytical tools to improve data quality, efficiency, and decision-making.
  • Document processes, identify control points, and recommend improvements that strengthen accuracy and scalability.

jobs.excerpt: Supplier. io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on.
jobs.description:
Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source-to-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems.

Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest-to-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community.

For more information, visit .

The Opportunity

Supplier.io is shipping quickly, and our platform capability is growing faster than any one customer can keep pace with. Our installed base is our single largest growth opportunity: enterprises that already trust us with their supplier data, with more value available to them than they are putting to work today. This role exists to connect the two.

The Customer Marketing Manager will bring new capabilities to existing customers and turn that into usage, expansion conversations, and renewals. You will have a standing seat in the release process, working from the positioning and messaging set by the Director of Product Marketing and translating it into customer-facing programs that land in market. You will partner closely with the internal content, web, and email teams to get those programs built and shipped, without owning those channels yourself.

This is an execution-heavy role with a commercial edge. Success is measured in adoption and retention, not campaign volume.

What you will do

Product adoption and release enablement

  1. Represent customer marketing in the release process: join product and product marketing planning early enough to shape how each launch lands with existing customers.
  1. Translate the positioning and core messaging set by the Director of Product Marketing into customer-facing release communications, adapting tone, depth, and proof points for each segment and persona.
  1. Own the practical, in-the-weeds messaging layer in partnership with product release notes, announcement copy, in-app prompts, and enablement one-pagers that make a new capability concrete.
  1. Segment the installed base by product usage, entitlement, and persona, so every release reaches the customers it actually matters to.
  1. Build the recurring "what's new and why it matters for you" narrative that keeps customers current on the capabilities available to them.

Upsell, renewal, and retention

  1. Originate expansion and cross-sell plays: use product usage, entitlement gaps, and account signals to identify where the next conversation is, then bring the idea forward with the segment and the message attached.
  1. Partner with the demand generation team to turn those plays into campaigns. You bring the customer insight, targeting, and messaging; demand builds and runs the campaign and carries the upsell pipeline number.
  1. Work with Customer Success and Sales to pressure-test which plays are real before they become campaigns.
  1. Support renewal motions with value-realization assets: usage recaps, program results, and ROI framing that customers can take to their own stakeholders.
  1. Surface adoption gaps and low-usage accounts back to Customer Success, Product, and Product Marketing, so they can be addressed before renewal.
  1. Develop customer-facing collateral that supports adoption and expansion conversations in the field.

Campaigns and cross-functional execution

  1. Drive customer email campaigns from strategy through results: define the audience and segmentation, write the copy, brief the email team who builds and deploys, then analyze performance and iterate.
  1. Hold the installed-base communication calendar, so release communications, lifecycle campaigns, and demand-led expansion sends are sequenced rather than stacked on the same customers.
  1. Drive the customer newsletter and product update cadence.
  1. Brief and partner with the internal content, web, design, and email teams on adoption assets. You define the requirement and drive it to done; those teams own the build and their channels.

What you will need to succeed

  • 5+ years in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or a closely related role
  • B2B SaaS experience required
  • Ability to write clear, customer-facing copy without heavy editing
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Experience working lean: you build as much as you execute
  • Familiarity with AI tools, marketing automation, and email platforms
  • Supplier diversity experience is preferred

Senior Director, Safety Data and Systems, Global Patient Safety or designee

Job Description:

  • Design, develop and validate AI/ML and NLP components that support safety operations - including MedDRA/WHODrug auto-coding, case triage, duplicate detection and narrative summarization - with clear human-in-the-loop checkpoints
  • Contribute to model lifecycle management for safety-relevant AI/ML: versioning, monitoring, drift detection, retraining and documentation aligned with GxP / GAMP 5 and internal model governance
  • Support the qualification of AI/ML solutions against evolving regulatory expectations (EMA reflection paper on AI, FDA AI/ML guidance, EU AI Act obligations for high-risk systems) in partnership with Quality, DT/BIS and GPS Signal Management
  • Serve as the key technical resource for the configuration, maintenance, and administration of the Oracle Argus Safety system.
  • Support day-to-day operation and troubleshooting of safety systems.
  • Assist in system validation, testing, and deployment of safety systems updates.
  • Generate, validate, and customize safety reports and analytics.
  • Collaborate closely with the pharmacovigilance, clinical, and regulatory teams to ensure safety data management aligns with global regulatory standards (FDA, EMA, PMDA, ICH).
  • Participate in change management processes to enhance safety system integrations.
  • Contribute to audit readiness activities, including system inspections, validation reports, and compliance documentation.
  • Collaborates with internal systems team, BIS/ DT and Safety vendor on issues related to Safety data
  • Performs the generation and quality control of aggregate reports and line listings
  • Initiates and contributes to the development of procedural documents including but not limited to Safety Management Plans, SOPs, work instructions, job aides, forms, or templates
  • Collaborates and co-creates with applicable client functions (e.g. Medical Information, Data Management, Business Information Systems, Quantitative Science) in regards to pharmacovigilance technical aspects, setup and operation
  • Keeps up-to-date on applicable regulatory and PV tech guidelines and shares within GPS and client as applicable.
  • Participates in training related to safety data management
  • Proactively reviews processes and tools and provides suggestions for improvement and better efficiencies
  • Complete additional task and projects as assigned by line manager or delegate

Purpose of the role:

  • Apply AI/ML and NLP methods to safety data (not limited to auto-coding, signal management support, narrative summarization, case triage) within GxP-validated, explainable and regulator-defensible frameworks
  • Lead deliverables for GPS Safety Data Management and Safety System Maintenance activities
  • Provide high quality data outputs for Safety Signal Management, Risk Management and Safety Evidence generation
  • Collaborate and co-create with client functions and applicable vendors as required for seamless GPS Safety Data and Systems operations

Education and Experience:

  • At least Bachelors’ degree (or country equivalent) in computer science, data science, computational linguistics, applied statistics/biostatistics, life sciences / Information technology or other relevant field required.
  • Python, ML/NLP frameworks, model deployment/monitoring, MLOps tooling, ideally exposure to LLMs on unstructured clinical/safety text.
  • Familiarity with, or ability to rapidly acquire, GVP/21 CFR 314 concepts preferred
  • working understanding of safety database data models (Argus/ArisG) and E2B(R3) structure.
  • Relevant experience in IT / Safety / Clinical Research / Pharmacovigilance overall with at least 3 years of proven experience with safety database systems (e.g. ARGUS or ArisG) including workflow management
  • Equivalent and adequate combination of education and experience or proven practical expertise in all of the required skills

In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role

Knowledge, Skills, and Responsibilities:

  • Proficiency in Python for ML development, including scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy; experience with at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
  • Natural language processing for extraction of adverse events, drugs, and outcomes from unstructured text - case narratives, medical literature, call transcripts, and spontaneous reports.
  • Named Entity Recognition (NER), relation extraction, and text classification
  • Experience with transformer-based / large language models (BERT-family, clinical/biomedical models such as BioBERT or PubMedBERT, and modern LLMs) for narrative generation, summarization, and information extraction.
  • MedDRA and WHODrug auto-coding using ML/NLP; prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) a plus.
  • Supervised and unsupervised methods for classification, clustering, and anomaly detection.
  • Feature engineering and model evaluation (precision/recall trade-offs, ROC/AUC, calibration) with an understanding of why recall and sensitivity are weighted heavily in a safety context.
  • Model lifecycle management: versioning, monitoring, drift detection, retraining pipelines using standard MLOps tooling (e.g. MLflow, Azure ML, Databricks) in line with client DT/BIS standards
  • Model explainability / interpretability (SHAP, LIME) - essential where decisions must be defensible to health authorities.
  • Understanding of GxP / GAMP 5 validation as applied to AI/ML systems, model governance, and emerging regulatory expectations (EMA reflection paper on AI, FDA guidance) — rare and worth flagging as preferred.
  • Proficiency in Safety Database systems (e.g. Argus) and knowledge of other technical systems applicable to Safety /Pharmacovigilance (e.g. E2B gateway, safety signal detection tools and systems) is a plus.
  • Proficiency in electronic systems commonly used for Safety / PV, like for data visualization and analysis, dashboards
  • Solid understanding of the quality management processes, metrics and KPIs
  • Good knowledge of relevant pharmacovigilance regulatory requirements and guidance documents (including Europe, US, Japan)
  • Proficient in the Microsoft 365 stack (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive) and in modern collaboration and documentation tooling
  • Advanced Excel required; working proficiency in SQL required for querying safety and operational datasets
  • Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate successfully across functions and with vendors
  • Fluent communication in written and spoken English required
  • Ability to work independently with minimal oversight and prioritize effectively
  • Ability to complete multiple complex deliverables within tight timelines
  • Ability to function effectively in a team environment

Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.

Beyond individual research execution, the Senior UX Researcher plays a key role in strengthening the broader research practice — advancing research methodologies, and championing customer-centered decision-making across the organization

jobs.excerpt: ÜBER DAS SYNTAX INSTITUTDas Syntax Institut ist ein schnell wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen aus Berlin, das von erfolgreichen Unternehmern gegründet wurde.
jobs.description:
ÜBER DAS SYNTAX INSTITUT

Das Syntax Institut ist ein schnell wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen aus Berlin, das von erfolgreichen Unternehmern gegründet wurde. Unsere Mission ist es, Menschen praxisnah für gefragte Berufe in der Tech-Branche zu qualifizieren und sie erfolgreich in den Arbeitsmarkt zu integrieren. Unser Angebot umfasst praxisnahe Weiterbildungen in den Bereichen Softwareentwicklung, IT-Administration, Cloud & IT-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Projektmanagement. Darüber hinaus bieten wir deutschlandweit an mehreren Standorten Umschulungen im Bereich Fachinformatik an. Dabei vermitteln wir aktuelle Technologien, moderne Arbeitsmethoden und die Fähigkeiten, die Unternehmen heute tatsächlich benötigen.

Aufgaben

DEINE ROLLE

Als Dozent*in für SAP (FI / CO) brennst du für Controlling und Finanzwesen und steckst andere mit deiner Begeisterung an. Dabei schaffst du als Wegbegleiter*in eine wertschätzende und motivierende Lernatmosphäre auf Augenhöhe. Dein Ziel ist es, die Teilnehmenden zum Abschluss zu begleiten und das Fundament zu legen für eine erfolgreiche Integration in den Arbeitsmarkt.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Leitung und Durchführung von Kursen: Du planst und leitest den Unterricht im remote Format für die Fachrichtung(en) FI und/oder CO, passend zu deinem Eignungsprofil (siehe unten).

  • Praxisnahe Vermittlung: Du übersetzt komplexe Lernziele in verständliche Lerneinheiten. Diese reicherst du mit Beispielen aus deiner eigenen IT-Praxis an.

  • Teamentwicklung: Du förderst die Zusammenarbeit sowie die Selbstorganisation in den Lerngruppen und begleitest sie mit einem starken Konflikt- und Feedback-Management. Zusätzlich entwickelst du gezielte Initiativen für leistungsschwächere Teilnehmende und arbeitest eng mit unserem Student Success Team zusammen.

  • Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Lehrmaterialien: Du erstellst praxisnahe Lernmaterialien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Produktteam. Weiterhin bist du verantwortlich für die fachliche und didaktische Qualität deines Kurses.

Qualifikation

DAS SOLLTEST DU MITBRINGEN

  • Schwerpunkt FI / CO: Du bist SAP zertifiziert in den Bereichen FI (Finance) und/oder CO (Controlling) und bringst mindestens 2 Jahre SAP-Projekterfahrung im jeweiligen Bereich mit. Idealerweise konntest du bereits Erfahrung mit S/4HANA- sowie Implementierung- und Customization sammeln. Von Vorteil ist es, wenn du am “Train the Trainer” (PTWTTT) teilgenommen hast und EWM Erfahrung mitbringst.

  • Sprache und Kommunikation: Deine fließenden Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Niveau) und deine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke runden dein Profil ab und ermöglichen es dir, Lerninhalte klar und motivierend zu vermitteln.

  • Vermittlung: Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, SAP verständlich auf Anwender- und perspektivisch Beraterniveau zu vermitteln.

  • Freude am Lehren und Lernen: Dich begeistert es, anderen Wissen zu vermitteln und sie aktiv beim Lernen zu unterstützen. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und erklärst komplexe Themen logisch und nachvollziehbar. Du bringst eine Affinität zur (Online-)Lehre / E-Learning und web-basierten Lernprogrammen mit.

Benefits

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Ein Business mit Purpose: Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die wirtschaftlich, gesellschaftlich und sozial höchst relevant sind (Digitalisierung, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit des Wirtschaftsstandorts Deutschland, Arbeitsmarktpolitik, Gleichberechtigung, Technologie etc.)
  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Als Dozent*in hast du einen großen Einfluss auf die Ausgestaltung unserer Kurse und die Entwicklung unseres Unternehmens.
  • Langzeitperspektive: Wir bieten dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und fördern deine Entwicklung. Falls du noch keinen AEVO-Schein besitzt, unterstützen wir dich bei deinem erfolgreichen Abschluss, damit du optimal für die Rolle aufgestellt bist.
  • Attraktives Package: Neben einem marktüblichen Gehalt profitierst du bei uns von einem vergünstigten Sportangebot und erhältst hochwertige Betriebsgeräte.

Wenn du glaubst, dass diese Rolle gut zu dir passt, bewirb dich gerne bei uns. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Wir freuen uns über deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit CV und optional einem kurzen Anschreiben.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Associate Vice President, AI&D Scaled Operations and Transformation

Job Location: Thousand Oaks, California, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease – we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role as Associate Vice President, Scaled Operations and Transformation you will lead the operating system, enablement, and cross-functional mechanisms that make AI&D more consistent, scalable, and high-performing.The role translates AI&D strategy into clear operating standards, decision rights, performance mechanisms, workforce and capability plans, and repeatable ways of working across the AI&D organization.Serving as an enterprise integrator and catalyst for execution, the AVP will connect the AI&D leadership team with Product, Data, AI/DS, Technology, Finance, Human Resources, business functions, and external partners to remove friction, accelerate execution, and enable reuse across the organization. The role will build a globally connected operating model across US and AIN talent while helping AI&D move from experimentation to coordinated scale.The AVP will lead four integrated capabilities: Operating Excellence; Continuous Improvement & Organizational Performance; Partner Enablement & Operations; and Enterprise AI Literacy & Learning and Development. The role will establish mechanisms for handoffs and transition-to-scale, coordinate cross-AI&D operating interventions, and recommend capacity, workforce, and operating-model shifts.

Key Responsibilities:

Operating Excellence

  • Define and evolve AI&D operating models, governance, forums, decision rights, and standards that enable consistent execution across teams and geographies.

  • Establish repeatable ways of working, delivery standards, playbooks, and handoff patterns across AI&D, including clear transition-to-scale mechanisms.

  • Translate AI&D strategy into practical operating mechanisms that clarify accountability, dependencies, escalation paths, and execution rhythm.

  • Identify and address duplication, fragmentation, and gaps across teams while preserving accountability with business, Product, Data, AI/DS, and platform owners.

Continuous Improvement & Organizational Performance

  • Establish performance KPIs, operating reviews, and management mechanisms that provide leaders with timely insight into outcomes, capacity, risks, and health execution.

  • Drive capacity and workforce planning insights across AI&D, including location, talent mix, resource allocation, and capability need.

  • Lead continuous-improvement efforts to surface friction, prioritize enterprise interventions, and drive issues through resolution and adoption.

  • Use portfolio and resource analytics to identify trends, interdependencies, and opportunities to improve cycle time, productivity, and organizational effectiveness.

Partner Enablement & Operations

  • Establish AI&D partner and vendor operating standards, engagement playbooks, governance mechanisms, and health/performance measures.

  • Coordinate key external providers with the appropriate AI&D capability owners, ensuring clear accountability, milestones, handoffs, and value expectations.

  • Provide ecosystem insight and recommendations on partner utilization, operating models, and opportunities to improve reuse, leverage, and execution.

  • Complement Corporate Business Development and contracting organizations by enabling effective pull-through and operational use of AI&D partner relationships.

Enterprise AI Literacy & Capability Development

  • Lead the enterprise AI literacy and capability-development strategy in partnership with functional and enterprise learning leaders.

  • Define learning roadmaps, role-based pathways, onboarding and upskilling approaches, communities of practice, certification mechanisms, and change-enablement strategies.

  • Ensure AI&D has the skills, knowledge, and adoption mechanisms required to leverage AI tools and capabilities effectively and responsibly.

  • Use workforce insights and adoption measures to identify capability gaps and prioritize future learning investments.

Cross-AI&D Integration & Transformation

  • Serve as connective tissue across the AI&D leadership organization while maintaining clear ownership with the appropriate capability, Product, Data, AI/DS, platform, or business leader.

  • Lead cross-enterprise operating interventions that span multiple AI&D pillars, functions, and geographies, resolving dependencies and escalating enterprise tradeoffs to the VP.

  • Partner with workforce transformation efforts, including TWFS, to translate organizational and workforce decisions into executable operating plans and sustainable capabilities.

  • Represent AI&D in relevant enterprise transformation forums and share standards, lessons, tools, and reusable practices across the organization.

Team and Organizational Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing, globally connected organization across the four capabilities, with clear accountabilities, decision rights, and development paths.

  • Attract, develop, coach, and retain talent across operating model, strategy and operations, workforce planning, ecosystem management, learning, analytics, and transformation disciplines.

  • Deploy internal resources and external partners flexibly based on emerging AI&D needs, maintaining a lean operating model and strong spans of control.

  • Foster a culture of collaboration, disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and accountability across US and AIN teams.

Scope and Impact

  • Owns the AI&D operating system and enablement mechanisms that influence how work is planned, governed, delivered, transitioned, and improved across the organization.

  • Leads four integrated capabilities with cross-AI&D impact and coordinates work across AI&D pillars, enterprise functions, business stakeholders, and geographies.

  • Influences operating decisions involving governance, workforce and capacity, partner models, performance management, learning, and organizational effectiveness.

  • Partners regularly with the AI&D leadership team and senior leaders across Product, Data, AI/DS, Technology, Finance, Human Resources, business functions, and enterprise transformation teams.

  • Operates across US and AIN talent and helps establish globally scalable ways of working, with responsibility for balancing enterprise consistency with local execution needs.

  • Accountable for volume, quality, timeliness, and business impact of operating-model and enablement outputs; shared accountability applies to outcomes owned by the relevant business or capability leaders.

Success in the role may be evaluated through a balanced set of measures, including:

  • Adoption and effectiveness of AI&D operating standards, governance, decision rights, and delivery playbooks.

  • Improvement in execution speed, handoff cycle time, capacity utilization, and organizational performance.

  • Quality and health of partner/vendor engagement, including performance, reuse, and operational leverage.

  • AI literacy reach, capability development, learning impact, and adoption of enterprise AI tools and ways of working.

  • Workforce and capacity insights that improve allocation of resources and support AI&D location and capability strategies.

  • Resolution of cross-AI&D friction points and successful implementation of priority continuous-improvement interventions.

  • Effectiveness of cross-functional alignment, operating rhythm, decision-making, and enterprise integration.

  • Sustainability and scalability of AI&D operating mechanisms as the organization moves from experimentation to scaled execution.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The executive candidate we seek is an experienced leader with the following qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree & 7 years transformation experience OR

  • Master’s degree & 10 years of transformation experience OR

  • Bachelor’s degree & 12 years of transformation experience AND

  • 7 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience across technology, AI/data, digital transformation, operations, strategy and operations, or related disciplines.

  • Demonstrated experience designing and scaling enterprise operating models and leading complex, cross-functional transformation.

  • Proven experience leading global teams and influencing senior executives across business and technology organizations.

  • Advanced degrees in business, technology, data, organizational effectiveness, or related field.

  • Experience in biopharma/life sciences and regulated environments.

  • Experience operating across US and global delivery organizations or shared-service models.

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:

  • Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive

  • Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection

  • Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders

  • Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is $265,133 - $358,709. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • Comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts.

  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan

  • Stock-based long-term incentives

  • Award-winning time-off plans and bi-annual company-wide shutdowns

  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position. Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

jobs.description:
Labs Designer & Facilitator – UK and Ireland

24-32 hours per week | Remote from the UK or Ireland | Maternity cover until September 2027, with possibility of extension

Preferred starting date: 1 December 2026

Are you passionate about designing and facilitating participatory processes that drive systemic change for holistic landscape restoration? Do you thrive in complex, multi-stakeholder environments and enjoy working with grassroots movements to co-create regenerative futures? Then this might be the role for you!

Commonland supports a growing network of landscape restoration initiatives across the UK and Ireland. Through long-term, collaborative learning journeys (Labs) we aim to strengthen leadership, build a learning and action community, and address systemic barriers to holistic restoration. These labs go beyond one-off workshops - they are multi-year, collaborative processes that move from shared understanding to experimentation and action, helping communities tackle root causes of degradation and build regenerative landscapes. The UK/Ireland Lab is currently being co-designed with landscape partners. You will step into co-responsibility for its continued design and delivery. The role is positioned within Commonland's international Learning Team and is part of the wider Landscape Development and Support Team. For the Lab specifically, you will work closely with the UK/Ireland Team.


What You'll Do

  • Lead the co-design and delivery of the UK/Ireland Lab, building from a structured handover and adapting the programme to the UK and Irish context while maintaining alignment with Commonland's strategy.

  • Develop participatory, multi-stakeholder learning processes using systems thinking, design methodologies, and transformative facilitation.

  • Support landscape partners in identifying and addressing root causes of environmental and social challenges, including structural barriers and power dynamics.

  • Strengthen connections among participating landscape initiatives as a learning community and action-oriented partnership.

  • Collaborate with and support a small pool of facilitators and hosts to deliver impactful learning experiences.

Globally focused:

  • Contribute to Commonland's global learning infrastructure and share insights across regions, including a global Lab Designers community of practice and an organisation-wide Commonland global team retreat.

  • Support the development of tools and guides that serve landscape partners and Labs globally, including learning infrastructure, the Landscape Governance Canvas, and the Landscape System Mapping Toolkit currently in development.


What You Bring

You are someone who:

  • Strategic mindset – You see ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies.

  • Communicates effectively – You develop and deliver multimode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

  • Manages ambiguity – You operate effectively and can experiment, adapt and learn even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear.

  • Collaborates – You build partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives and deliver stakeholder-centric solutions.

  • Builds networks – You effectively build formal and informal learning networks inside and outside the organisation.

  • Project management – You initiate, plan, execute, and monitor initiatives efficiently, balancing scope, resources, timelines, and risks to deliver measurable outcomes.

You also bring:

  • Experience in participatory process design, facilitation, and working with diverse stakeholder groups

  • The ability to lead and guide a programme design and hosting team

  • A good understanding of the UK and/or Irish landscape restoration, environmental, or grassroots context; direct professional experience in this field and geography is highly valuable

  • Based in the UK or Ireland, legally eligible to work there, and able to travel regularly across the region

  • Fluency in English


What We Offer

  • A purpose-driven role where your work contributes directly to restoring landscapes and shaping a regenerative future

  • Flexibility to work remotely, with the freedom to design your workday in a way that suits your life and energy

  • A supportive team culture with room to grow, with opportunities for personal and professional development through learning, reflection, and experimentation

  • A consultancy agreement including a market-conform salary


How to Apply

We are excited to learn more about you and how your competencies fit this role. Please submit your CV via the application link before 5 October 2026 and answer a few questions related to the key criteria for this position. Your responses will help us assess all candidates fairly and consistently.

We are committed to an inclusive and fair recruitment process and encourage thoughtful, authentic responses. We kindly ask applicants not to use AI tools such as ChatGPT when completing their application. All applications are reviewed by our team, not by AI systems. As we carefully review each submission and have limited capacity, we may close the application window once enough applications are received. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as early as possible. If you have any questions about this position, feel free to contact Willemijn Helwig, Learning Lead, at .
