jobs.title: VP, Security & Quality
jobs.excerpt: At Meazure Learning, we aim to empower open-minded, inquisitive, and driven people, and we love how each new addition to the team adds to our culture.
jobs.description:
At Meazure Learning, we aim to empower open-minded, inquisitive, and driven people, and we love how each new addition to the team adds to our culture. Here, you can positively impact the careers of millions of test-takers and reshape the education technology landscape by working toward one vision:

“To provide life-long learners across the globe the freedom to pursue their academic dreams and career aspirations safely, securely, and conveniently.”

Our Vision starts with our values—Hungry, Humble and Smart. We seek team members who are driven to achieve results while bringing these values to life with how they lead and work. Team members who think of the organization and team first without ego or agenda. Leaders who instinctively collaborate and operate with emotional intelligence. This is the foundation of success for all employees at Meazure Learning.

The Role:

The VP, Security & Quality is a cross-functional leadership role responsible for advancing the security, integrity, quality, and operational reliability of Meazure Learning’s testing environment. This leader will oversee and continuously evolve testing-security practices across both remote online proctoring and onsite Test Center delivery, helping ensure Meazure Learning’s testing solutions remain secure, reliable, and aligned with the needs of clients and test takers.

The VP, Security & Quality will partner closely with Technology, Product, Operations, Test Centers, and other functional leaders to provide testing-security expertise as Meazure Learning’s technology and delivery models continue to evolve. The role will also lead the ongoing advancement of quality management and continuous improvement practices that support secure, consistent, and high-quality testing operations.

Responsibilities

Testing Security & Technology Risk

  • Lead the ongoing execution and evolution of Meazure Learning’s testing security strategy, ensuring security practices remain aligned with the company’s technology, products, client needs, and testing delivery models.
  • Provide leadership and oversight for technology-enabled security practices and controls that support the integrity of online and onsite testing, including secure testing environments, candidate authentication, exam content protection, and test delivery safeguards.
  • Partner closely with Technology and Product teams to proactively assess testing-related security considerations and ensure appropriate safeguards remain integrated into testing platforms, proctoring solutions, secure testing technology, Test Center delivery, and the test-taker experience.
  • Maintain and continuously enhance testing security standards, policies, procedures, and controls across remote proctoring and Test Center operations.
  • Stay current on evolving testing-security trends, technology developments, and methods of testing misconduct, and recommend enhancements that support continued exam integrity and secure test delivery.
  • Provide leadership and sound judgment in the review, escalation, and resolution of testing security matters, partnering with appropriate teams to support timely and consistent outcomes.
  • Partner with Test Center leadership to maintain effective security practices for onsite testing, including candidate authentication, secure test delivery, appropriate system access, and protection of testing content and environments.
  • Partner with remote proctoring operations to support the continued effectiveness and evolution of practices that authenticate test takers, protect exam content, identify prohibited behavior, and preserve the integrity of online testing sessions.
  • Provide testing-security expertise as products, technologies, client requirements, and operational processes evolve, helping ensure security, customer experience, and business needs remain appropriately balanced.
  • Monitor and communicate meaningful testing-security metrics and trends to leadership, providing visibility into program effectiveness, emerging considerations, and areas of continued focus.
  • Serve as a senior testing-security resource for client reviews, audits, and inquiries related to the security and integrity of Meazure Learning’s testing solutions and delivery environments.
  • Champion Meazure Learning’s culture of testing security and accountability through ongoing training, communication, and cross-functional partnership.

Quality, Compliance & Operational Excellence

  • Drive business results through the development, implementation, and execution of a quality management system.
  • Apply leading performance improvement methods (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) to define key process gaps, measure current state, assess strategic options for improvement, and drive improvement initiatives.
  • Develop and manage standards, policies, and procedures for quality management across the organization, including process controls and corrective actions.
  • Create product and process quality documentation, visual controls, and standardized client communication.
  • Prepare product, process, quality, and compliance reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information, findings, and trends.
  • Partner with operational leaders to understand current KPIs and scorecards and develop meaningful performance measures and visual controls.
  • Develop policies and processes concerning accessibility, accommodations, and other operational compliance considerations associated with remote proctoring and testing services.
  • Implement process changes and effectively monitor and measure results.
  • Partner with training and functional leaders to ensure changes to policies, processes, controls, and procedures are effectively communicated and sustained.
  • Coordinate audit processes, including reviewing, analyzing, and reporting findings, and collaborate with the appropriate departments and leadership on corrective actions.
  • Synthesize analysis into operational insights and practical recommendations to assess risk, customer impact, and financial impact.

The Desired Attributes

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, information systems, security, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Significant leadership experience in testing security, assessment technology, technology-enabled security, exam integrity, risk, quality, compliance, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated understanding of security risks and controls associated with remote online testing, secure browser technology, test-taker authentication, proctoring platforms, and/or onsite Test Center delivery.
  • Experience partnering with Technology and Product teams to evaluate and strengthen security controls within customer-facing technology platforms.
  • Experience identifying, assessing, and mitigating technology and operational risks that could affect testing integrity, sensitive exam content, or the test-taker experience.
  • Experience with data analytics and statistical processes.
  • Formal Lean and Six Sigma training; Master Black Belt or Black Belt certification preferred.
  • Experience in Higher Education, assessment, certification, credentialing, or academic testing preferred.
  • Experience coaching and mentoring at all levels of an organization.
  • Proven track record of initiating and championing change to drive process improvement, ownership, and accountability.
  • Strong business acumen, problem-solving skills, judgment, and strategic foresight.

Who We Are

Open Up Resources is a non-profit publisher in pursuit of delivering the highest quality learning experiences for all students by providing educators best in class, research-based PreK–12 curricula and professional learning so they may support every student’s academic success and create in-class experiences that celebrate, honor, and empower all students.

The Role

The Regional Development Manager (RDM) will cultivate relationships with school districts and instructional leaders in order to support curriculum adoptions and professional learning implementation. This role will utilize marketing-generated leads, and build a disciplined new business engine that consistently converts connections into qualified opportunities and closed business, furthering the impact of our HQIM.

The Regional Development Manager reports to the Regional/National Director and is a new-business sales role focused on proactive territory development, pipeline creation, and relationship-driven outreach to drive awareness, referrals, and new customer adoption. The RDM will initiate outreach to districts, converting outreach into qualified opportunities and closed business.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively build and manage a healthy pipeline of qualified new-business opportunities across an assigned territory through outbound calls, email, LinkedIn/social outreach, referrals, and networking with district instructional leaders and administrators.
  • Execute a minimum of 15 proactive outbound interactions (calls, emails, LinkedIn) per week to net-new district contacts.
  • Conduct a minimum of 10 live outbound phone conversations per week with prospective or existing district prospects.
  • Schedule and complete a minimum 5 discovery calls, prospect meetings, or presentations per week with instructional leaders or committees.
  • Prioritize the response to all marketing-generated leads to convert them into qualified sales opportunities and at a minimum respond with-in 4 business hours.
  • In partnership with our Enablement team, deliver compelling, tailored in-person and virtual presentations and product presentations to instructional leaders, curriculum committees, and district decision-makers.
  • Identify and cultivate relationships with key influencers — superintendents, curriculum directors, principals, and instructional coaches — to build a referral-driven pipeline.
  • Represent Open Up Resources at conferences, trade shows, and regional education events, fostering relationships.
  • Accurately and consistently maintain Salesforce records, including call logs, opportunity stages, forecast updates, and customer details.
  • Submit a bi-weekly written activity and progress report to leadership.
  • Partner with the leadership to align on territory priorities, messaging, and prospecting strategy.
  • Provide market feedback, competitive intelligence, and product input to inform territory planning and company strategy.
  • Meet or exceed assigned new-business revenue, pipeline, and activity targets.
  • Represent Open Up Resources with professionalism, energy, and deep commitment to educational equity and student success.

Core Competencies

  • Ethics and Integrity: Behave in a fair and ethical manner toward peers, partners, and customers; instill mutual trust and confidence; act with honesty and integrity.
  • Continuous Learning: Hone and improve the level of knowledge and skills through education and training.
  • Teamwork and Collaboration: Work with colleagues to build morale and team commitment to goals and objectives.
  • Diversity: Understand that each individual is unique and celebrates individual differences including race/ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, mental or physical disability, marital status, veteran status, education, training, position, level of authority, seniority, full-time or part-time status.
  • Solution Oriented: Able to take action in solving problems, using reason and a systematic approach.
  • Managing Change: Create an environment that embraces change, both internally and externally, and help others to accept new ideas.

Job Qualifications

  • Experience in K-12 education, curriculum sales, education-technology sales, or related business development — a proactive, prospecting track record of new-business generation.
  • Success in Math/ELA sales with demonstrated knowledge in one or both of these subject areas.
  • Demonstrated success in outbound prospecting, referral-based selling, and pipeline generation, in addition to managing inbound demand.
  • Ability to develop and nurture account relationships with district and school instructional leaders.
  • Excellent presentation, interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills, including comfort presenting to experienced, senior audiences.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills; high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple territory priorities at once.
  • Command of technology applications, including presentation software and Salesforce.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, goal and activity-oriented environment while collaborating closely with leadership and broader team.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% to support territory development and relationship-building.

Benefits

At Open Up Resources, we believe in building and fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace environment. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer where all applicants are considered for employment without attention to color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

We are a virtual organization with headquarters in the California Bay Area.

We offer highly competitive total rewards packages that include employer-paid healthcare, dental, vision, 401k matching, monthly work/life integration stipends, unlimited paid time off, and much more!

This is a benefited, full-time, exempt position with a base salary range of $85,000 - $110,000 annually + a commission package.

Atria is a membership-based preventive health care practice delivering cutting-edge primary and specialty care in New York, South Florida, Los Angeles (2026), and through 24/7 telemedicine globally.

Our multi-specialty team of 60+ top in-house physicians provides proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. We aim to optimize lifespan and healthspan through meticulous screening, leading-edge therapeutics, and tailored interventions designed to prevent disease and detect it at the earliest possible stages.

Each member's care is led by a dedicated Chief Medical Officer who collaborates with specialists in cardiology, neurology, pediatrics, women's health, endocrinology, integrative health, performance and movement, nutrition, and more.

Through our nonprofit Atria Research Institute and Public Health Institute, we also work to accelerate the translation of medical breakthroughs and expand access to preventive care for as many people as possible.

Atria Health is seeking a Software Engineer (Product) to help design, build, and scale the systems that power our member and clinical experiences.

This is an individual contributor role focused on:

  • Building high-quality product features across our stack (web, mobile, backend)
  • Owning projects end to end, from design to launch and iteration
  • Partnering closely with Product, Design, and Clinical teams to ship measurable outcomes

You’ll work with product managers and other engineers to shape how we build features, contribute to our architecture, and ensure that what we ship is reliable, observable, and grounded in data. From clean APIs and performant UIs to strong monitoring and analytics in Mixpanel, you’ll care about both how we build and what we achieve.

Tech Stack

  • Languages: TypeScript
  • Backend: Node, Express
  • Frontend: React, Honeypot SDK
  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Terraform
  • Database: MySQL
  • Tooling & Integrations: Github, Sentry, Okta, Mixpanel, Omni, third-party APIs

Key Responsibilities

Product & Delivery

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and clinicians to turn product requirements into clear technical plans.
  • Own end-to-end delivery of features and services: design, implementation, testing, rollout, and iteration.

Architecture & Systems

  • Design and implement APIs, data models, and integrations supporting your core domain (member journeys, clinical workflows, care coordination)
  • Contribute to evolving our architecture so teams can build new experiences quickly without re-inventing the wheel.
  • Build with reliability and performance in mind: help define graceful failure modes, timeouts, and efficient queries.
  • Participate in design reviews and RFCs, bringing a pragmatic, product-focused perspective.

Quality, Observability & Analytics

  • Write well-tested code with meaningful unit tests and integration tests,
  • Instrument features with high-quality analytics in Mixpanel, using consistent events and properties across products.
  • Help maintain dashboards and alerts that reflect real user outcomes

Teamwork, Mentorship & Culture

  • Contribute to and uphold engineering standards: coding conventions, design patterns, documentation practices.
  • Give thoughtful and constructive code reviews

Who You Are

Core Experience

  • ~4+ years of professional software engineering experience building product experiences in production environments.
  • Track record of owning and shipping features or projects in a modern web stack.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product and design on user-facing features.
  • Comfortable working in evolving domains and complex making tradeoffs.

Technical Skills

  • Strong full-stack skills: you can design an API and schema, implement backend logic, and build the UI that consumes it.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript and at least one modern frontend framework (ideally React).
  • Experience with at least one cloud provider and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform).
  • Solid instincts for systems design basics: reliability, performance, and security
  • Comfortable debugging across the stack: logs, traces, metrics, and data.

Behaviors

  • Take ownership of your work end to end and follow through on details.
  • Communicate clearly in writing and in meetings, tailored to your audience.
  • Comfortable working with clinicians, operations, and other non-technical partners.
  • Open to feedback and invested in helping the team continuously improve.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in healthcare, digital health, or other regulated domains (HIPAA, PHI, SOC 2, etc.).
  • Exposure to EHRs, Wearables Integrations, or other health data platforms

Reporting & Work Arrangement

This role reports to the VP of Engineering. This is a remote role with occasional travel to Atria locations.

Compensation

$125,000–$240,000 depending on location

Benefits

At Atria, we are proud to offer every member of the Atria team:

  • Excellent health and wellness benefits, 100% paid by Atria effective date of hire
  • OneMedical membership for employees & dependents giving access to 24/7 virtual care
  • Fertility & family planning
  • Company-covered preventive health screenings through partner hospitals (Calcium score)
  • Fitness Perks including Wellhub +
  • 401k contributions and 4% match starting after 6 months
  • Flexible Time Off
  • Continuing medical education (CME) and CEU support for professional licensure

Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and monitor high-performance services and APIs.
  • Develop applications in Golang and Python on top of a modern cloud-focused platform.
  • Develop and maintain services using AWS native products such as Kinesis, DynamoDB, and S3, as well as GCP native products.
  • Deliver production-ready code from start to finish.
  • Review code to maintain quality with an eye towards performance, scale, and security.
  • Work in a cross-functional environment composed of software engineers, test engineers, research scientists, and product managers.
  • Identify and evaluate new technologies for implementation.
  • Contribute to improving software engineering best practices.
  • Part of an on-call rotation with night/weekend work required.

Who you are

  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • You enjoy working within a collaborative environment across multiple departments.
  • You love solving hard problems and finding ways to improve the efficiency of processes.
  • You have a proven track record of providing stable and secure code in production environments.
  • You are able to contribute to the feature development in the platform/product with minimal supervision.
  • You can deliver production-ready code from start to finish with an eye towards performance, scale, and security, and with an understanding of how code could impact cloud scalability.
  • You are resilient in the face of challenges, change, and ambiguity.
  • You are optimistic and believe that you can make a problem into a solution.
  • You are resourceful, excited to uncover innovative solutions, and teach yourself something new when needed.
  • You take accountability, do the things you say you’ll do, under-promise and over-deliver.
  • You are nimble and adaptable when priorities change and continue to see the “forest through the trees”.
  • You are happy in a role in which a week in the life might include context switching between application diagnostic troubleshooting using industry standard tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, triaging production issues using tools such as Google Logging and Cloud Trace, troubleshooting regression tests in different environments, designing new product solutions, improving current product features, and coding.

Your skill-set

  • 5-7 years of software development experience
  • Experience with designing and implementing highly scalable cloud-based APIs
  • Experience with multiple programming languages, such as Python and Go
  • Expertise in Data Structures, Algorithms, and Concurrency
  • 2+ years of experience in DevOps practices towards deployment of SaaS services, including hands-on experience with Jenkins, Github Actions, implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, as well as experience with managing and maintaining applications in a multi-container environment, such as Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of different Data Storage technologies such as Redis, MySQL, etc
  • Knowledge of Docker and container orchestration frameworks such as Kubernetes
  • Experience developing and maintaining services using AWS native products such as Kinesis, DynamoDB, and S3
  • Linux Proficiency

What’s in it for you

In an era where synthetic media, fraud, and identity manipulation are accelerating, we ensure that every interaction involves the real human and the right human. Our work directly protects financial institutions, enterprises, and consumers from fraud, deception, and identity compromise. You will wake up every day knowing your work has a real-world impact. You will work alongside some of the best technical minds in security, AI, and voice intelligence. We are intense about excellence, but we are also a team that enjoys the journey. If you want to build something that matters- and be proud of the company you help shape- this is that opportunity.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

jobs.description:
About Tia

Tia is building a new model for women’s healthcare, one that treats women as whole people, not separate conditions or life stages. By integrating primary care, mental health, gynecology, dermatology, and wellness across both in-person and virtual settings, Tia is improving outcomes, lowering costs, and creating a better experience for patients and providers alike.

About the Role

Tia is looking for a Billing & AR Resolution Lead to take ownership of our claims follow-up, denials, and payer rejection functions. This is a hands-on role. You'll work claims, resolve denials, and push aging AR to resolution every day. It's also a role for someone who wants to build something: the workflows, documentation, and queue structure that make this work repeatable and easier to hand off as we scale and the team grows.

You'll partner closely with the Senior Manager of RCM as a true right hand on a lean team. Take full ownership of AR follow-up, flag payer trends before they turn into revenue problems, and bring good ideas for how the function should grow. If you see a messy queue and want to fix the system behind it, not just clear the backlog, this role is for you.

Why Tia

  • Opportunity to help shape and scale a new model of women’s healthcare

  • Mission-driven environment focused on improving care for women across life stages

  • Collaborative, thoughtful team committed to patient and provider experience

  • Modern care model that integrates clinical care, operations, technology, and innovation

  • Meaningful opportunity to help build scalable systems, workflows, and practices

  • Remote role in a fast-moving, high-growth healthcare environment.

  • This is a rare chance to shape a function, not just staff it. You'll have real ownership over how AR and denials work at Tia, direct visibility with RCM leadership, and room to grow as the team does. If you're someone who can't help but build a better process, and you like being the person others trust to know what's really going on in the numbers, we'd love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

AR Follow-Up, Denials & Payer Rejections

  • Own day-to-day AR follow-up across commercial payers, resolving denials and payer rejections from root-cause identification through resubmission.

  • Work claims across multiple queues and payer rule sets, prioritizing by dollar impact, aging, and likelihood of recovery.

  • Partner with Tia's external billing partner on complex appeals and escalated claim issues, giving them the documentation and context they need to resolve them.

  • Own day-to-day AR follow-up across commercial payers, resolving denials and payer rejections from root-cause identification through resubmission.

  • Work claims across multiple queues and payer rule sets, prioritizing by dollar impact, aging, and likelihood of recovery.

  • Partner with Tia's external billing partner on complex appeals and escalated claim issues, giving them the documentation and context they need to resolve them.

  • Track denial reasons and outcomes closely enough to know which patterns are just noise and which ones are the start of something bigger, monitoring trends across payers and markets to surface systemic issues (eligibility, contract terms, coding, payer behavior changes) before they compound.

  • Bring data and recommendations to RCM leadership on where the biggest AR risks and opportunities are, not just a status update on what's outstanding.

Workflow & Process Design

  • Build and document the SOPs, queue structures, and escalation paths that turn AR follow-up from institutional knowledge into a repeatable process.

  • Spot friction points in the claims-to-cash workflow and design the fix, not just flag the problem.

  • Create the reference materials and training documentation that help new team members ramp up quickly as the function grows.

Cross-Functional Support

  • Serve as the subject matter expert on RCM-related questions and concerns for Tia's Billing Care Coordinators, who field most patient billing inquiries directly.

  • Take ownership of escalations that need a claim edit, payer-specific fix, or other RCM-level intervention and ensure timely follow-up through to resolution.

What You’ll Bring

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in medical billing, AR follow-up, denials management, and payer rejections in a healthcare setting.

  • Deep working knowledge of commercial payer rules and claim adjudication.

  • A track record of not just clearing a queue, but improving how it works: building SOPs, spotting inefficiencies, and fixing root causes.

  • Comfortable working independently in a lean, fast-moving team where you'll wear multiple hats and help shape your own scope.

  • Sharp pattern recognition. You notice when something's off in the data before it becomes a bigger issue.

  • Strong written communication for internal documentation, payer correspondence, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Experience with billing platforms such as Candid, Athenahealth, Epic, or similar RCM/EHR systems.

  • Multi-state/multi-market billing.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building or improving RCM workflows, documentation, or training materials from scratch.Exposure to women's health and telehealth. A demonstrated interest in growing into broader ownership as Tia's RCM function scales.Certification such as CPB, CPC, or CRCR.

Work Location

This is a remote role (US-wide)

Compensation & Benefits

Tia is committed to pay equity and pay transparency. Compensation for this role will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, location, role leveling, business needs, and market conditions.

The expected compensation for this role is: $27 to $28 per hour

You are also eligible for:

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • 401k program

  • $300 one-time WFH stipend

  • $50/month phone and internet reimbursement

  • Free Tia membership

About Tia

Tia is on a mission to transform healthcare for women by increasing access, improving outcomes, and delivering a better care experience. Our “Whole Woman, Whole Life” model integrates primary care, gynecology, mental health, dermatology, and wellness across in-person care and a national virtual platform.

We are a Series D, venture-backed company trusted by more than 120,000 women across four markets. Through our technology-enabled care model and partnerships with leading health systems, Tia is building one of the most comprehensive preventive care models for women.

About Tia’s Culture

Tia is building a culture of excellence in people, process, and product. For us, excellence is not perfection. It is the ongoing pursuit of improvement through learning, reflection, experimentation, curiosity, grit, and care for ourselves and others. We are looking for people who are energized by building, iterating, asking why, and helping create a fundamentally better healthcare experience for women.

This position may require attendance at company and team off-sites.

Scam Notice

Tia will never ask for payment, gift cards, or sensitive financial information during the hiring process. All communication from our team will come from an official company email address ending in @asktia.com. If something feels off, please contact .

Equal Opportunity

Tia is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of experience, perspectives, and background leads to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users and patients. We strongly encourage people of color and members of the LGBTQ+ community to apply.

If you are committed to collaborative problem solving, high-quality work, and making waves in women’s healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Title: Senior Consultant, Statistics and Psychometrics - Remote

Job Location: London, Greater London, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Overview

At IQVIA, the Patient Centered Solutions team helps clients generate robust evidence on the patient experience across clinical development, regulatory submissions, and scientific dissemination. Our Statistics & Psychometrics team specializes in the analysis of clinical outcome assessment (COA) and patient-reported outcomes (PRO) data, combining scientific rigor with strategic consulting to support high-impact decisions in drug development.

The Role

As a Senior Consultant, you will lead or support statistical analyses for projects involving COA/PRO data. You will contribute across analysis planning, execution, interpretation, reporting, and client communication, helping deliver evidence that is scientifically sound, regulatory-relevant, and clearly communicated.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the quantitative analysis workstream for projects of moderate complexity, ensuring high-quality, timely, and scientifically sound delivery.
  • Develop and review analysis plans, output shells, output specifications, programming requirements, statistical outputs, and technical reports.
  • Apply advanced statistical methods to COA/PRO data.
  • Interpret results clearly and credibly for internal teams and clients and communicate methodological choices in a way that supports decision-making.
  • Contribute to regulatory- and payer-relevant evidence generation, including support for endpoint strategy and scientific communication.
  • Build strong working relationships with clients and cross-functional internal teams, and contribute to proposals, bid defenses, and business development activities.
  • Assists in managing the scope of the quantitative analysis workstream, including objectives, timelines and quality of deliverables.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to team capability building, training, standards, and process improvement.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or PhD in biostatistics, statistics, psychometrics, outcomes research, epidemiology, or a related quantitative field.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO, healthcare, or consulting environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of complex statistical methods that apply to Phase I-IV clinical trials (multivariate analysis, regression analysis, logistic analysis, survival analysis, mixed models repeated measures, etc.)
  • Familiarity with SAS and/or R.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, matrixed environment.

Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to work on specialized, patient-centered research that informs clinical development, regulatory strategy, and evidence communication across a wide range of therapeutic areas. You will join a collaborative global team with deep expertise in COA analysis, psychometrics, and advanced statistical methodology.

This role is not eligible for UK visa sponsorship

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for a pragmatic, business-minded Head of Legal to build and lead our legal function through our next stage of growth.

As Tailscale’s senior legal leader, you’ll partner with executives and teams across the company to navigate complex legal and business considerations, manage risk, and build the capabilities needed to support a growing, globally distributed technology company.

This is an opportunity to shape how Legal operates at Tailscale. You’ll establish priorities, advise on important company and product decisions, and determine the right combination of internal talent, outside counsel, processes, and systems to support the business. An early priority will be strengthening our commercial legal capabilities, including hiring a dedicated leader to own contracts and help scale our approach to commercial transactions.

You may already lead a broad legal organization, or you may be an experienced legal leader who has taken on progressively greater responsibility and is ready to step into the top legal role for the first time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and evolve the strategy, priorities, operating model, and team for Tailscale’s legal function.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executives and cross-functional leaders, translating legal complexity into clear, practical business guidance.
  • Help leaders identify material risks, evaluate tradeoffs, and move forward with appropriate safeguards.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Sales, Finance, People, Operations, Marketing, and other teams on company priorities.
  • Advise across a range of matters that may include corporate governance, product development, open-source software, intellectual property, privacy, data, AI, security, employment, commercial relationships, compliance, and international operations.
  • Build scalable legal processes, policies, systems, and decision-making frameworks without creating unnecessary complexity.
  • Determine which legal capabilities should be developed internally, delegated to future team members, or supported by outside counsel.
  • Hire and empower legal team members, including building a dedicated commercial legal capability.
  • Select and manage outside counsel across the countries where Tailscale operates, balancing expertise, responsiveness, cost, and business impact.
  • Coordinate guidance across jurisdictions and translate local requirements into practical, consistent company practices.
  • Support strategic partnerships, corporate initiatives, and other business-critical matters as Tailscale continues to grow.
  • Anticipate emerging legal and regulatory developments and help the company prepare for what comes next.

What We Are Looking For

  • Significant legal experience, including meaningful in-house experience within a technology company and a track record of helping legal functions scale in startup or high-growth environments.
  • A law degree and active membership in at least one applicable bar or equivalent authorization to practice law.
  • Progressive growth in the scope, complexity, ownership, and influence of your work.
  • Broad business judgment and the ability to navigate legal issues beyond a single area of specialization.
  • Experience advising executives and senior leaders on complex or consequential decisions.
  • The ability to understand business goals, identify material risks, and recommend practical paths forward.
  • Experience partnering effectively with technical, operational, and commercial teams.
  • Familiarity with the legal considerations facing a growing software or technology company.
  • Experience working with outside counsel and turning specialized advice into clear recommendations for the business.
  • A track record of building or improving legal capabilities, teams, programs, processes, or areas of practice.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to make complex issues understandable to different audiences.
  • Sound judgment, curiosity, and the confidence to challenge constructively when needed.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving between strategic leadership and hands-on execution.
  • Admission and good standing with at least one applicable state, provincial, or other recognized bar association.

Nice to Have

We do not expect candidates to bring experience in every area below. Relevant experience may include:

  • Developer tools, infrastructure, cloud, networking, cybersecurity, data, or another technically complex software environment.
  • Open-source software, licensing, developer ecosystems, APIs, integrations, marketplaces, or technology partnerships.
  • Product counseling, privacy, data governance, cybersecurity, intellectual property, or emerging technology.
  • AI-enabled products or the use of AI within company operations.
  • Cloud, on-premises, self-hosted, or hybrid software offerings.
  • Data residency, sovereignty, localization, or cross-border data considerations.
  • Supporting employees or business operations across multiple countries.
  • Corporate governance, financing, strategic transactions, or board-related matters.
  • Building or scaling a legal function within a growth-stage company.
  • Hiring, developing, or leading in-house legal professionals.

How You’ll Work

At Tailscale, Legal is a thoughtful and pragmatic partner. You’ll seek to understand the goals behind the work, help teams evaluate tradeoffs, and build frameworks that enable people to make sound decisions with increasing independence.

You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy building, are curious about technical products, and want to shape a legal function as the company grows. You know when to engage directly, when to bring in specialized expertise, and when to empower others to lead.

jobs.title: VP, Fulfillment Planning and Optimization
jobs.excerpt: Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands.
jobs.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

Stord is looking for a VP, Fulfillment Planning & Optimization to lead the end to end process of translating customer demand into operational readiness across our fulfillment network. This leader will own Stord’s Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, turning customer and order forecasts into a clear operating plan for the labor, infrastructure, training, and support required to meet demand.

Sitting at the intersection of Customer Experience, Operations, and Operations Support, this leader will program manage the full planning cycle from demand forecasting and operational requirements through resource deployment, performance tracking, and reforecasting, ensuring the network is positioned to deliver against customer commitments efficiently and at scale.

What You'll Do:

S&OP & Demand Planning: Own Stord's S&OP process across the fulfillment network, creating a single operating view of expected customer demand and the resources required to support it.

  • Partner with CX and customers to understand expected order volume, promotions, launches, seasonality, and other demand drivers.

  • Translate customer forecasts into site, process, shift, and time specific operating requirements.

  • Validate customer forecasts using leading operational indicators, including inbound inventory and historical demand patterns.

  • Identify forecast risk early and develop clear scenarios for expected, upside, and downside demand.

  • Establish a consistent planning cadence across customers, sites, and support functions.

Labor Planning: Translate demand into a comprehensive workforce plan across Stord's fulfillment network.

  • Determine labor requirements by site, shift, process path, and planning horizon.

  • Partner with Operations and People teams to ensure hiring, staffing, scheduling, and training plans can support forecasted demand.

  • Track labor demand against actual labor delivery and surface gaps early enough to intervene.

  • Build planning models that account for productivity, attendance, attrition, ramp curves, seasonality, and other operational realities.

  • Continuously improve the accuracy and responsiveness of Stord's labor planning models.

Operational Readiness: Translate the operating forecast into clear requirements for the teams responsible for enabling Operations.

The forecast should trigger a coordinated readiness plan across:

  • MHE: Equipment, capacity, maintenance, and material handling requirements.

  • EHS & Facilities: Building readiness, safety requirements, space, and facility capacity.

  • Procurement: Supplies, packaging, equipment, and other operating inputs.

  • Industrial Engineering & Continuous Improvement: Capacity, process design, building layout, productivity, and future state operating models.

  • Training: Training capacity, onboarding requirements, cross training, and workforce readiness.

Ensure these teams understand what is coming, what Operations will require, when it is needed, and whether delivery is on track.

Readiness Program Management: Own the program management layer connecting S&OP to execution.

  • Translate the S&OP plan into specific requirements, owners, milestones, and delivery dates across support functions.

  • Maintain a single view of operational readiness across the network.

  • Track dependencies and escalate risks before they become operational failures.

  • Hold teams accountable for delivering the resources required to support forecasted demand.

  • Create clear executive visibility into where the network is ready, where it is at risk, and where intervention is required.

Actuals, Feedback & Continuous Replanning: Close the loop between planning and reality.

Once volume begins flowing through the network, this leader owns the process for understanding: What did we forecast? What actually happened? Why was it different? What needs to change now?

  • Monitor actual inbound and outbound volume against forecast.

  • Measure forecast accuracy by customer, site, and planning horizon.

  • Use actual inbound volume and other leading indicators to continuously validate and refine outbound forecasts.

  • Determine whether forecast misses were driven by customer forecast accuracy, internal planning assumptions, labor delivery, productivity, or operational execution.

  • Feed those learnings back into S&OP and continuously adjust labor and resource plans.

  • Build a planning organization that becomes increasingly accurate and responsive as Stord scales.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Significant experience owning S&OP, workforce planning, labor planning, capacity planning, or network planning at scale within a complex fulfillment, distribution, retail, manufacturing, or logistics network.

  • Deep understanding of how order forecasts translate into labor hours, productivity requirements, equipment, space, training, and operating capacity.

  • A track record operating in environments where demand shifts quickly and planning decisions have immediate operational and financial consequences.

  • Strong analytical skills paired with an operator's instinct. You are comfortable challenging assumptions across both Operations and planning teams and are focused on whether the plan actually works on the floor.

  • Exceptional cross functional program management skills, with the ability to drive accountability across senior leaders and create structure across functions without directly managing every team involved.

  • Experience building planning processes, systems, and teams that can scale with a rapidly growing business.

jobs.excerpt: Who We ArePindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you'll do

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Authentication team, you will help build and scale the cloud services behind Passport as the team continues moving customers onto its cloud platform. You’ll focus on highly reliable, secure authentication services that power voice-based identity verification at scale, while increasingly leveraging AI/ML-driven signals and tooling to strengthen fraud defenses and engineering productivity. More specifically, you will:

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and monitor high-performance backend services and APIs using Go and Python, with an emphasis on secure, low-latency authentication and identity workflows.
  • Build and maintain cloud‑native services across AWS and GCP (e.g., S3, DynamoDB, Kinesis, IAM) with a focus on reliability, scale, and secure production operation, including data pipelines that feed downstream ML and risk models used in authentication decisions.
  • Deliver features and enhancements through the full software development lifecycle, including implementation, automated testing, deployment, and operational support, using CI/CD and infrastructure‑as‑code practices.
  • Tackle complex software engineering problems in authentication, identity, and fraud prevention—contributing to architecture decisions, threat‑aware design, and continuous improvement of engineering best practices across the team.
  • Integrate and consume AI/ML capabilities (for example, model-backed risk scores, deepfake detection signals, or ML‑driven policies) by collaborating with Research, MLOps, and Protect/Passport teams, and help productionize these models into scalable, observable services.
  • Use observability and diagnostics tooling (metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards) to troubleshoot production issues, reduce alert noise, and systematically improve reliability and latency for authentication journeys.
  • Partner closely with software engineering, test engineering, research, product, Protect, Passport, and Core teams to deliver new capabilities and improve existing ones, including AI‑enhanced identity and fraud experiences for customers.
  • Participate in the team’s on‑call rotation, including helping cover after‑hours alerts as we expand distributed support coverage for our customer‑facing authentication platform.
  • Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and design reviews that clarify how authentication services behave, how AI/ML components are used safely, and how other engineers should integrate with the platform.

Who you are

  • You are a strong communicator who collaborates effectively across engineering, product, test, research, and other cross‑functional partners.
  • You are an owner who can independently drive work from design through production with strong judgment around performance, scale, security, and reliability in authentication flows.
  • You are energized by solving hard technical problems and improving systems, processes, and engineering standards, especially in high‑stakes, security‑sensitive environments.
  • You are resilient, adaptable, and effective in environments that require context switching, rapid troubleshooting, and operating through ambiguity while maintaining high quality.
  • You are resourceful and curious—comfortable learning new tools (including AI tooling) and teaching yourself what you need to move a problem forward, then sharing that knowledge with the team.
  • You are invested in helping others grow and bring a mentorship mindset to code reviews, pairing, and day‑to‑day collaboration.

Your skill-set

Must-haves:

  • 5-7+ years of professional software development experience building backend services and APIs.
  • Strong experience with Go, Python, or similar languages, plus a solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and Linux-based development.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating cloud-native systems in AWS or GCP, including managed services such as S3, DynamoDB, Kinesis, and IAM.
  • Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, and production ownership, including deploying, monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting services in live environments.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with backend data stores and messaging technologies such as Redis, MySQL, RabbitMQ, and Elasticsearch.
  • Experience in authentication, identity, fraud prevention, or other security-sensitive product environments.
  • Experience with observability tooling and production diagnostics across metrics, logging, and tracing.
  • Exposure to UI work or adjacent product experiences that connect backend systems to customer-facing workflows.

What's in it for you

At Pindrop, you’ll work on the backend and platform systems that power Passport, helping secure critical customer interactions where trust, fraud prevention, and identity verification matter every day. You’ll tackle meaningful cloud engineering challenges that shape reliability, scalability, and the speed at which products reach customers, with direct visibility into the impact of your work. As a senior engineer, you’ll have the opportunity to influence architecture, raise technical standards, and help strengthen a growing team alongside experienced partners across the platform. You’ll join a company operating at the intersection of authentication, fraud prevention, and deepfake defense, where strong engineering directly supports the business and the customers who rely on it.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
    • One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!
  • Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer.

US Base Pay Range
$130,000—$170,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. jobs.description:
The opportunity

BrookGlobal is looking for a hands-on Technical CAD Designer (subcontractor) who can take an approved creative concept and turn it into something our team can confidently price, build, purchase, assemble and install. This is not a drafting-only role. You will be expected to think through how the design actually works in the real world.

About BrookGlobal

BrookGlobal creates donor recognition and experiential environments for healthcare and nonprofit organizations. Our work brings together storytelling, physical design, custom-built elements and digital experiences. The Technical CAD Designer sits between creative design and execution, helping make sure the concept can be delivered accurately, efficiently and at the quality our clients expect.

This is a subcontractor engagement rather than a full-time employee role. Work may be assigned on a project-by-project basis or through an agreed limited number of hours per week, depending on BrookGlobal's active project workload and technical design needs. The scope, timing and expected hours will be agreed for each project or work period.

What You Will Own

  • Create accurate 3D models, assemblies, shop drawings and fabrication / production drawings in SolidWorks.
  • Translate approved experiential concepts, client requirements, site measurements and specifications into buildable technical packages. Develop and maintain BOMs / picklists, material callouts, hardware, mounting details, dimensions, tolerances and assembly information.
  • Design with constructability in mind: how the work will be fabricated, assembled, packed, shipped, installed, serviced and repeated.
  • Review technical inputs and identify missing dimensions, conflicts, unclear requirements or risks before drawings are released.
  • Work closely with Experiential Design, Pre-Construction, Project Management, Purchasing, Production, IT / AV and Installation.
  • Support technical R&D, prototypes, vendor questions and solution testing when a design or application is new or uncertain.
  • Maintain clear drawing revisions and one current approved source of truth. Make sure superseded drawings are not left in active use.
  • Support Production and field teams with technical questions and update drawings when an approved change needs to become part of the permanent record.
  • Support reorders, maintenance and repeat work by keeping technical files accurate, organized and reusable.

What Good Looks Like

  • Production can build from your drawings without having to guess what the designer meant.
  • Installation arrives on site with the right dimensions, details, mounting information and current drawing set.
  • Drawing errors, rework, missing hardware / material and avoidable field surprises are low and continue to decrease.
  • Technical questions are raised early instead of becoming last-minute problems.
  • SolidWorks models, drawings, BOMs and revisions are organized, accurate and easy for the wider team to use.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of hands-on CAD / technical design experience in a fabrication, manufacturing, millwork, signage, exhibits, fixtures, architectural products or similar environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of SolidWorks, including parts, assemblies and production drawings.
  • Ability to create detailed drawings that clearly communicate dimensions, materials, hardware, interfaces, mounting and assembly intent.
  • Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, site information and technical specifications.
  • Strong understanding of buildability and how design decisions affect cost, production, installation and quality.
  • High attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work before release.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working through incomplete or changing technical information.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work directly with designers, project teams, fabricators and installers.
  • Diploma or degree in mechanical design, engineering technology, industrial design, drafting / CAD or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • A portfolio or sample set of technical / production drawings that demonstrates how you turn design intent into buildable work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with custom architectural / experiential elements, donor recognition, signage, exhibits, interiors or healthcare environments.
  • Experience with custom fabrication, millwork, metal, acrylic, mounting systems or integrated digital / LED components.
  • Experience with prototypes, design-for-manufacture, CNC / fabrication workflows or vendor technical coordination.
  • Experience supporting installation teams and resolving technical issues in the field.
  • Familiarity with document control, revision management or PDM-style workflows.

jobs.description:
Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture:

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

At NeuraFlash, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce and Data 360. As a trusted leader in AI, Amazon, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Data 360, Agentforce, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we've earned the distinction of being Salesforce's #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Job Overview

As Solution Architect, Health & Life Sciences, you will lead the functional solution design for Salesforce Health Cloud across our healthcare engagements and act as the functional lead for NeuraFlash's Health practice. You combine hands-on Health Cloud design depth with real industry fluency—you understand how payers, providers, integrated delivery networks, device and distribution companies, and pharma actually operate, get paid and are regulated—and you translate that into designs our Data 360, Agentforce, Service, Field Service and Revenue teams can build.

You will have the opportunity to help lead Health & Life Sciences solutions with key business and IT stakeholders, and internally will be responsible for building the reference architectures, reusable patterns and enablement that let the rest of the practice deliver healthcare work with confidence.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Lead functional solution design for Salesforce Health Cloud grounded in the HLS industry data model and out-of-the-box capabilities—Person Accounts and households, Care Programs and Care Plans, Provider and Payer data models, member and benefits verification, referral management, Utilization Management, and Intelligent Document/Form processing—evaluating every requirement against native capability before recommending custom build.
  • Run discovery and design sessions with client business and IT stakeholders across payer, provider, medtech/distribution and pharma organizations; present design decisions and trade-offs; and drive open questions to written closure with owners and dates.
  • Author and maintain the functional design for Health Cloud engagements: data model mappings, object and field design, process flows, user stories with acceptance criteria and formal design sign-off artifacts, following NeuraFlash's Navigate Next delivery methodology and accelerators.
  • Design for a regulated environment —PHI handling, HIPAA and BAA requirements, Salesforce Shield and field-level encryption, consent and minimum-necessary access—so compliance is built into the design rather than bolted on.
  • Shape the end-to-end architecture with our technical leads —Data 360 (member/patient/customer 360, identity resolution), Agentforce (member, patient and intake agents), Service Cloud Voice, Field Service, Revenue Cloud / ARM and MuleSoft—including integration patterns to systems of record such as EHRs (Epic, HL7/FHIR), core administration and billing platforms.
  • Translate the functional design for the build team (Technical Architects, Developers, Data 360 and Agentforce specialists), review configuration against spec, and support UAT and deployment gates.
  • Define what NeuraFlash owns versus what the client must provide (data access, SME availability, environment access, compliance approvals) and hold both sides to it.
  • Help build our Health practice —own the payer and medtech/distribution reference architectures, capture reusable patterns from engagements, contribute to scoping calculators and SOW templates, and co-deliver healthcare enablement with our HLS sales leaders for the delivery team.
  • Support pre-sales as the Health Cloud subject-matter expert: discovery calls, solution shaping, demos and estimates alongside our HLS sales team and Salesforce Health & Life Sciences account teams.
  • Coach and mentor functional and technical team members on Health Cloud and the healthcare operating environment, and stay current on Salesforce Health Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud and Industries releases.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Salesforce consulting, solution architecture or business analysis, with 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce Health Cloud design and delivery on at least two full-lifecycle implementations
  • Direct experience in the healthcare industry—payer, provider/IDN, medical device or distribution, or pharma—with working knowledge of how each is funded, regulated and operated (CMS reimbursement, payer–provider dynamics, member and patient journeys)
  • Practical understanding of HIPAA, PHI handling and BAAs, and how they shape Salesforce design decisions (data model, sharing, encryption, consent, audit)
  • Deep knowledge of the Health Cloud data model and features: Person Accounts, Care Programs and Care Plans, Provider/Payer models, benefits verification, referrals, Utilization Management, Intelligent Document Processing
  • Proven ability to lead discovery workshops, facilitate design decisions with senior stakeholders and document them to sign-off
  • Experience designing integrations with healthcare systems of record—EHRs (Epic or comparable, HL7/FHIR), claims or core administration platforms, or billing and order systems—typically via MuleSoft or equivalent
  • Ability to tie solution outcomes to business value (member experience, cost to serve, referral turnaround, revenue leakage) through clear storytelling
  • Comfortable with flow-charting and data-modeling tools (for example Lucidchart) and with agile delivery
  • Willingness to travel to client sites as needed

Preferred Skills

  • Salesforce Health Cloud Accredited Professional and an Application or Solution Architect credential; Salesforce Industries or OmniStudio experience
  • Hands-on exposure to Data 360 (Data Cloud) and Agentforce, or a comparable CDP / generative-AI platform, in a healthcare context
  • Experience with Life Sciences Cloud or Veeva CRM (commercial or clinical), and a point of view on Veeva-to-Life Sciences Cloud migrations
  • Experience with Service Cloud Voice, Field Service (device install base, depot) or Revenue Cloud / Asset Revenue Management in medtech or distribution
  • Familiarity with payer distribution channels (brokers and agencies) and integrated delivery networks (health plan plus care delivery)
  • Prior experience standing up a practice, competency or center of excellence at a consulting partner

What can you expect in the interview process?

  • Recruiter screen (phone) – 30 minutes. Introductory conversation to discuss the role and your experience.
  • Peer interview (video) – 45 minutes. You'll talk through your career goals, relevant Health Cloud work examples, and challenges you have overcome and the tools you used to get there.
  • Panel interview with real-time exercise (video) – 60 minutes. You'll receive a healthcare scenario (for example a payer member-service or referral-intake use case) and talk through solution options live—no offline preparation required—and spend time with NeuraFlash delivery team members.
  • Industry conversation (video) – 30 minutes. You'll meet our Health & Life Sciences sales leaders to discuss the healthcare market and where you see it going.
  • Leadership interview (video) – 45 minutes. You'll meet with a member of our leadership team.

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

  • Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
  • Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
  • Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
  • Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
  • Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryWe are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain a scalable, metadata-driven data ingestion and transformation framework on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain a scalable, metadata-driven data ingestion and transformation framework on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

The role will be responsible for developing configuration-driven ingestion pipelines, onboarding multiple source systems, and implementing Raw, Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers. The Data Engineer will use technologies including BigQuery, Cloud Composer/Apache Airflow, Python, Dataform, Datastream, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Run, and Cloud Storage to deliver reliable and reusable data solutions.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in metadata-driven pipeline development, CDC, advanced SQL, Python, data quality, reconciliation, automated testing, and CI/CD. The engineer will work closely with Data Governance and other platform stakeholders to ensure that data pipelines are scalable, governed, auditable, testable, and production-ready.

Responsibilities

  1. Design and build a metadata-driven and configuration-driven ingestion framework using reusable pipeline templates.

  2. Design, develop, and maintain the metadata configuration model covering source systems, source objects, load configurations, execution parameters, run logs, audit information, and reprocessing.

  3. Build dynamic Cloud Composer / Apache Airflow DAGs that generate and execute ingestion workflows based on metadata configurations.

  4. Develop reusable ingestion patterns and pipeline generators instead of building separate pipelines for individual source tables.

  5. Onboard multiple source systems, including relational databases, SAP, REST APIs, files, streaming sources, and other enterprise platforms.

  6. Implement data ingestion into Raw and Bronze layers following defined lakehouse architecture and engineering standards.

  7. Implement source-to-target reconciliation to ensure completeness and accuracy of ingested data.

  8. Implement robust operational controls, including error handling, retries, quarantine processing, alerting, monitoring, and audit logging.

  9. Develop replay-by-batch and reprocessing capabilities to support failed loads, historical reloads, and controlled data recovery.

  10. Support batch, incremental, streaming, and Change Data Capture (CDC) ingestion patterns.

  11. Implement Bronze-layer processing, including data typing, cleansing, schema validation, and schema enforcement.

  12. Implement data de-duplication using appropriate source keys, primary keys, or business keys.

  1. Implement soft-delete representation and appropriate handling of deleted source records.

  2. Implement CDC change-history materialization and maintain historical changes where required.

  3. Develop appropriate BigQuery partitioning, clustering, MERGE, and incremental processing strategies.

  4. Perform data compaction and other performance optimization activities where required.

  5. Design and develop Silver and Gold transformation models using Dataform.

  6. Develop reusable transformation components, macros, dependencies, and incremental transformation strategies.
