Through our trusted brands, including the USA TODAY NETWORK, comprised of the national publication, USA TODAY, and local media organizations, including our network of local properties, in the United States, and Newsquest, a wholly-owned subsidiary operating in the United Kingdom, we provide essential journalism, local content, and digital experiences to audiences and businesses. If you are a California resident, you acknowledge that by applying for a job with us, this California Job Applicant Privacy Notice will apply to our collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com

USA TODAY is looking for an innovative, high-energy, data-driven Audience Editor to lead audience engagement strategy for our news, economy and lifestyles coverage.

As a key member of our reimagined USA TODAY audience team, you will utilize your expertise to enhance audience growth, discoverability, engagement and revenue generation for our core journalism.

This role is right for you if you’re passionate about news and its essential role in helping people understand the world around them, make informed decisions and navigate everyday life. You understand how audiences discover and engage with news content, and you know how to translate complex topics into clear, accessible and useful information. You are both a strategist and an experimenter, combining strong news judgment with audience insights to test new approaches across social media, video, newsletters, search and emerging platforms, then turn successful ideas into repeatable practices.

The ideal candidate is as comfortable interpreting data and platform analytics as they are connecting with audiences on TikTok, Reddit, Instagram or through a newsletter. You understand that the audience is at the heart of everything we do.

You will also be expected to monitor trends in the broader creator industry and identify ways to translate relevant tactics into strategies for our newsrooms.

This highly-collaborative role will be accountable for translating broader business and newsroom strategies into actionable steps for the journalists on the news and lifestyles teams. The successful candidate will oversee a small team of content creators to put our best foot forward at every step of the audience journey. As such, you should be comfortable leading through both direct management and influence, building productive relationships with peers and partners throughout the organization.

We recognize that culture change is challenging, and the right editor will embrace the opportunity to introduce new ideas, improve established practices and help colleagues adapt to a rapidly evolving audience landscape. You will bring energy, resilience and a commitment to turning strategy into measurable action.

This role may require working extended hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays, sometimes unexpectedly, when news requires it.

This role is remote and can be based anywhere in the US, except for Alaska, Hawaii and Wyoming. If you live near one of our local newsrooms, you may have the option to use that as a base of operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop strategies, workflows and best practices to rapidly achieve audience growth and discoverability on social, newsletters, emerging platforms and search in collaboration with the greater USA TODAY audience team and the USA TODAY News leadership team.
  • Monitor analytics both on platform and on social, in newsletters and alerts, translating that data into action steps for journalists on your direct team and on the broader News and Lifestyles teams.
  • Lead audience planning for major events, tentpoles and breaking news, determining how journalism should be packaged, distributed and presented at each stage of the audience journey.
  • Create, edit or optimize audience-focused content during major events and breaking news when needed.
  • Partner crossdivisionally on new efforts to monetize our journalism and grow audience on social media and distributed platform channels.
  • Manage a team of content creators charged with ensuring consistent brand strategy, voice and execution across platforms, including social channels, newsletters, section fronts, app alerts and wherever our journalism meets the audience.
  • Create and monitor reporting and KPI progress, including metrics for loyalty, engagement, relevance and other business goals.
  • Be an innovative, creative thinker that is willing to experiment to support company's goals.

Requirements:

Description

Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We are looking for a Learning Experience Designer to join our B2B Curriculum team and develop technical / AI-focused courses for corporate clients. You will turn client needs and subject-matter expertise into practical, scalable learning experiences and continuously improve them using learner feedback and expert recommendations.

This is a full-time remote contract position. After the Online Introductory Call, candidates will be required to complete a test assignment.

What you will do

  • Own the end-to-end development of new B2B courses, from learning needs analysis and high-level design to final course documentation, in collaboration with Product Managers and subject-matter experts.
  • Build course Skill Trees and map learning outcomes across the course, modules, and individual lessons.

  • Prepare clear briefs for designers and video editors, and develop outlines and facilitator materials for workshops, seminars, and other live formats.
  • Analyze each client’s learning needs, business goals, workflows, tools, operational constraints, and learner profiles together with Product Managers and client stakeholders.
  • Customize learning activities, case studies, learning paths, curriculum structure, and schedules to reflect authentic client tasks and the needs of different roles.
  • Continuously improve the learning experience by auditing cognitive load, motivation, difficulty, and alignment with learning outcomes; use learner feedback and expert recommendations to update content and maintain an improvement backlog.

Requirements

Must have:

  • At least three years of experience as an Instructional Designer, Learning Experience Designer, Learning Content Developer, Program Designer, or in a comparable role.
  • Proven experience applying modern learning experience design models, methodologies, and frameworks to the development of complex skills.
  • Experience structuring end-to-end learning experiences, including building Skill Trees and Learning Journey Maps and mapping learning outcomes.
  • Ability to create different forms of educational content, including long reads, projects, practice tasks, infographics, and other learning aids.
  • Experience designing and integrating skills and knowledge assessments into a course.
  • English proficiency at C1 level (strong B2 users with a good fit in other requirements are welcome to apply, too).

Nice to have:

  • Strong familiarity with popular AI tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Claude Design). Experience creating your own agents or workflows, or some familiarity with coding, is a strong plus.

What we can offer you

  • Performance appraisals twice a year and a bonus system.

At Medallion, we believe healthcare teams should focus on what truly matters - delivering exceptional patient care. By automating licensing, credentialing, payer enrollment, and compliance monitoring, Medallion empowers healthcare operations teams to streamline their workflows, improve provider satisfaction, and accelerate revenue generation, all while ensuring superior patient outcomes.

As one of the fastest-growing healthcare technology companies - ranked #3 on Inc. Magazine’s 2024 Fastest-Growing Private Companies in the Pacific Region, #5 on LinkedIn's 2024 Top US Startups, a Glassdoor Best Place to Work in 2024 & 2025, and featured on The Today Show - Medallion is revolutionizing provider network management. Our CEO, Derek Lo, has been named one of the Top 50 Healthcare Technology CEOs of 2024 by The Healthcare Technology Report. Backed by $130M in funding from world-class investors like Sequoia Capital, Google Ventures, Optum Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Acrew Capital, Washington Harbour, and NFDG, we’re on a mission to transform healthcare at scale.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only come from @medallion.co email addresses.

About the role:

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Implementation to lead a function at the forefront of the Medallion Customer Experience. Implementation is the foundation of every customer partnership: your team works with new clients to implement, train, and drive adoption of Medallion's product suite, setting the tone for the entire relationship.

You'll manage and develop a team of Implementation Project Managers who deliver both repeatable mid-market projects as well as customer enterprise engagements. Just as important, you'll evolve how we run implementation - building a rigorous, data-driven motion, rooted in best practices that you and your team will work to establish, and which enables faster, lower effort, and higher quality delivery.

Implementation sits within Customer Experience and partners closely with Sales, Solutions Consulting, Operations, and EPD. With Sales, you’ll establish a new SOW process to standardize pricing and project scoping across our client base. Within Customer Experience, you’ll work closely with our Engagement Management team for post-live handoffs, and our Technical Solutions team during projects. You will also own components of the services P&L trajectory - implementation and TSM are paid services, and you'll drive them to margin neutral or better.

This role reports to the Director of Technical Services and base compensation for this role may land between $165,000 - $210,000. In addition to base salary, Medallion offers equity, and benefits as part of the total compensation package. Many factors are considered when determining pay including: market data, geographic location, skills, qualifications, experience, and level.

Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership & Strategy
    • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Implementation Project Managers - setting clear goals and performance expectations, holding the team accountable to these goals and expectations, and creating room for growth.
    • Serve as the escalation point for complex, high-impact projects, providing technical and strategic guidance to the team.
    • Build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement across the team and partner functions.
    • Own the staffing model - define how many projects an IPM can carry by tier, when we hire, and what we hire for. Build the onboarding and training program for new implementers.
  • Implementation Delivery & Execution
    • Build detailed project plans with clear milestones, owners, and timelines, and drive projects to on-time, successful go-lives.
    • Lead a team performing technically complex implementations - coordinating data integrations, workflow configurations, and API-based setups across systems.
    • Act as the bridge between customers, Product, and Engineering, translating business requirements into clear technical specs and aligning on scope.
    • Spot risks early, clear blockers, and ensure clean handoffs from Sales and Solutions Consulting into implementation, and from implementation to Engagement Management and PE Ops.
  • Operational Excellence & Scale
    • Define the team's objectives, KPIs, and scalable processes - establishing the data-driven milestones that tell us implementation is working.
    • Develop a scoping and SOW pricing structure based on standardized project plans and work with sales to position and sell implementation services.
    • Own time-to-live, hours per implementation, and utilization by tier. Build the dashboards and operating cadence to manage them.
    • Gather, synthesize, and socialize customer insight to drive improvements to the product and the onboarding journey.
    • Get paid services to margin neutral or positive, with cost floors by tier.

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, technical project management, or professional services
  • 3+ years of people management experience directly leading and developing an Implementation team
  • A track record of owning complex, enterprise B2B SaaS implementations end-to-end
  • Strong technical fluency across data integrations, API-based setups, and workflow configuration, with the ability to translate between business and engineering teams
  • Experience building implementation processes and operating models from the ground up in a scaling environment, not just running an established playbook
  • A demonstrated ability to shorten implementation timelines while maintaining quality, with measurable improvements in hours and weeks from before to after

  • Strong proficiency with AI and project management tools, with a data-driven approach to managing delivery and performance

This role requires a high degree of autonomy and initiative to drive results, leveraging a collaborative approach to consult with network partners and build the resources necessary to strengthen the region’s alumni leadership pipeline.

The ideal candidate is a strategic movement-builder who balances a high-level vision for systems change with the practical ability to mobilize people. You are someone who sees the immense potential of our alumni and possesses the natural ability to connect leaders across borders, turning individual leaders into a unified regional movement. Driven by a deep commitment to educational equity, you are an expert at cultivating leadership in others, communicating complex information, designing group learning journeys, and weaving meaningful relationships. Most importantly, you are a clear-eyed advocate for children, focused on transforming the structures that limit their potential to ensure every student in the region can thrive.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • supporting Teach For All network partner organizations in Asia Pacific with their local alumni strategies through high quality coaching and consulting; fostering peer learning; and developing resources and training to support their organisational work and impact with alumni.
  • driving Teach For All’s strategy to strengthen alumni leadership and connectedness in the Asia Pacific region through devising new programs which develop alumni leadership directly, foster their connectivity and peer learning, and enable their growth as leaders as they learn from and support one another towards greater impact.

This role is part of Teach For All’s Global Alumni Leadership Team, with counterparts in other regions to spread learning and innovation across regions. The role reports to the Head of Alumni Leadership but works in very close -daily- collaboration with colleagues in Teach For All’s Asia Pacific regional team and our global Collective Learning & Consulting team.

Outcomes

Success in this role means that

  • Each network partner organization in the region will have a clear and contextualised alumni strategy, rooted in their vision for system change, that informs their programmatic choices and their support for alumni
  • Alumni in the region are developing as impactful leaders within key high leverage career pathways in their contexts
  • Alumni in the region are connected and are learning from and supporting each other in pursuit of transformational progress for children

About the Team

Today there are over 114,000 Teach For All network alumni working across more than 60 countries. Together, they are one of the world’s largest networks of local leaders working collectively in pursuit of transformational progress for children. We have seen that local alumni leaders move faster when we continue to invest in their growth and are exposed to what is possible in other contexts.

Teach For All’s Alumni Leadership Team

  1. Strengthens network learning about developing alumni leadership
  2. Accelerates alumni leadership in key impact pathways
  3. Fosters cross-border connectivity & learning between alumni

The Alumni Leadership Team is globally spread, with team members in Asia Pacific, Europe, Africa, North America and the Americas.

Key Responsibilities

Network Partner Support

There are currently 20 organisations that Teach For All supports across the Asia Pacific region. Each organization is developing their alumni leaders at the local level. To support their efforts, you will:

  • Collaborate with Teach For All’s Asia Pacific regional team and Functional Area specialists to diagnose and constantly re-evaluate the needs and strengths of partners to determine and deliver the most appropriate support strategies and capture and share innovations and learnings.
  • Establish strong, trust-based relationships with Heads of Program and Heads of Alumni in Asia Pacific, engaging regularly to understand their unique challenges, successes, and areas of growth.
  • Work in close partnership with specialists across and beyond Teach For All to remain at the forefront of the latest network knowledge and insights about developing collective leadership through the recruitment, selection, placement and training of leaders, contributing new insights as you come across them, and developing shared learning experiences.
  • Manage alumni data and share insights (based on your diagnosis of a partners’ needs and priorities) through various mediums including facilitating learning experiences, workshops, newsletters and online platforms, driving learning and engagement amongst Heads of Alumni and Heads of Program.
  • Manage a robust learning community between Heads of Alumni in Asia Pacific which facilitates peer learning, information exchange, peer support, collaboration between them to accelerate their local efforts.
  • Provide personalized coaching and consulting to Heads of Alumni and other Senior Leaders, leveraging your expertise to address specific challenges and enhance the effectiveness of their alumni impact strategies.
  • Influence Chief Program Officers and network partner CEOs, in close partnership with the regional team, to build momentum for alumni support outside of the Head of Alumni role, and collaborate with others to execute high quality cross-functional support and learning across many senior stakeholders to ensure alumni strategy and support is a priority for network partners in the region.

Develop Alumni Leaders

There are currently ~13,000 alumni leaders in the Asia Pacific region who have successfully completed their two years as a participant in one of the Teach For All network partners across the region, and are now continuing to work as leaders in education and across additional sectors. To support their collective growth, learning and impact as leaders across the region, you will:

  • Proactively build strong, credible relationships with alumni leaders to understand their unique challenges, successes, and areas of growth. You will be the Teach For All “point person” for alumni to field their requests and ideas, and the ‘go-to’ for Teach For All staff with questions about alumni in the region.
  • Partner with the Asia Pacific regional team, network CEOs and Heads of Alumni to create and execute programs to accelerate alumni leadership and connectivity at the regional level such as the Asia Pacific Alumni Summit, Policy Fellowships and School Leader development programs.
  • Coordinate small groups of alumni volunteers including our Network Connectors to best leverage their energy and skills towards our goals.
  • Manage a vibrant online community of alumni on WhatsApp to foster their connectivity, learning and to share opportunities for leadership development.
  • Manage applications from the Asia Pacific region to Teach For All’s Communities & Connections Fund to enable alumni to self-organize regional virtual and in-person learning exchanges.
  • Capture and share stories of alumni leadership and impact to inspire and motivate others and demonstrate progress in the region

Qualifications

  • Prior experience and a strong track record of impact as an alumni and/or senior leader from within the Teach For All network in the Asia Pacific region
  • 8+ years of relevant working experience with a credible background in leadership, leadership development, systems change, and/or network building
  • Passion and experience in growing the leadership capacities of others through training and coaching
  • Exceptional communication skills capable of distilling complex ideas and data into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences
  • Proven ability to build strong, credible relationships with multiple stakeholders to understand their goals and motivations in order to support collaboration while working virtually and remotely
  • Exceptional strategic thinking abilities with proven track record of diagnosing and solving complex problems, exercising strong judgment and working with ambiguity
  • Ability to work collaboratively and flexibly with colleagues globally, including a high volume of virtual engagement (i.e., conference calls, virtual collaboration tools)
  • Superior project management skills; a self-starter with the ability to manage multiple streams of work, use strong judgment to independently determine actions and prioritize tasks, and work effectively in a dynamic, globally dispersed team environment
  • Experience and ability to design and execute powerful remote and in-person learning experiences (events, workshops, etc.)
  • Strong orientation towards diversity, inclusivity and equity with heightened levels of self-awareness, cross cultural competence and humility, and ability to adapt approach and communications styles accordingly
  • Ability to influence and motivate others outside of direct team relationships
  • Must be able to work fluently in English

Additional desirable skills

  • Prior experience as a coach or consultant or launching/ leading own venture
  • Experience managing virtual peer learning communities and building strong peer networks
  • Experience managing and mobilizing volunteers

What Teach For All Offers:

  • Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization’s progress
  • Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
  • Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
  • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements
  • And much more!

Application Instructions

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all!

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Therefore, candidates are encouraged to apply at their earliest convenience.

Work authorization

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.

Compensation

Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

Travel and Hours

All work is delivered virtually. Up to 15% of travel may be required. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role.

About Teach For All

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations’ under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All’s global organization works to increase the network’s impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

jobs.excerpt: Szukamy Senior Developerów do zespołu IT w związku z intensywnym rozwojem organizacji, chcących programować z AI.
jobs.description:
Szukamy Senior Developerów do zespołu IT w związku z intensywnym rozwojem organizacji, chcących programować z AI. Senior powinien sprawnie poruszać się w IDE spiętym z AI i doskonale odnajdywać się w tym, jak można błyskawicznie dostarczać wartość biznesową przez rozwiązania IT, jednocześnie trzymając jakość programistyczną.

Stare czasy w IT minęły, nowa era rozwoju oprogramowania już tu jest - w Telemedi dołączamy do prekursorów zmian w procesie developmentu. Wierzymy, że łącząc użycie najnowszych technologii z biegłością techniczną i ponadprzeciętnym zaangażowaniem możemy budować więcej, szybciej, i lepiej, niż to było kiedykolwiek możliwe.

Developerzy w naszym IT pracują z Cursor AI (cursor.com) - to IDE zmienia kompletnie paradygmat programowania. My potrafimy w kilka godzin zrobić to, co innym deweloperom zajmuje kilka dni. I tego też będziemy oczekiwać od Ciebie.

Aplikuj do nas, jeśli:

  • chcesz pracować w firmie produktowej, w której domena biznesowa jest bardzo ciekawa, rozległa i złożona, a Twoja praca dziś przekłada się na wymierny efekt jutro
  • lubisz duże wyzwania i i odnajdziesz się w skomplikowanej aplikacji
  • lubisz dynamiczne środowisko, w którym dużo się dzieje
  • wychodzisz z inicjatywą i na co dzień podnosić standard pracy zespołu
  • czujesz odpowiedzialność za to, co robisz Ty i cały zespół
  • chętnie i otwarcie przyjmujesz konstruktywny feedback do swojej pracy
  • lubisz poznawać biznes i dobrze się komunikujesz z innymi (nie tylko w IT)
  • potrafisz szybko i sprawnie tworzyć jakościowe aplikacje / feature’y
  • jesteś pewny swojej wiedzy technicznej, i potrafisz podnosić jakość aplikacji (w tym umiesz usprawniać kod legacy drobnymi krokami)
  • chętnie poprawiasz procesy wokół siebie

Twoje zadania:

  • udział w tworzeniu rozwiązań IT od początku do końca (u nas IT nie jest “silosem”)
  • rozwój aplikacji webowych (nowe funkcje, bugfixing, refactors)
  • udział w projektowaniu architektury nowych rozwiązań i infrastruktury deweloperskiej
  • udział w code review i dbałość o jakość tworzonych rozwiązań
  • stałe podnoszenie standardów procesów developmentu
  • ścisła współpraca z zespołem (Devs, PMs/POs, QAs)
  • dbanie o wysoką jakość programistyczną i wysokie tempo dostarczanych zadań (indywidualnie i jako team)

Requirements

Czego oczekujemy:

  • Doskonałego rozumienia biznesu i bardzo szerokiego kontekstu na dużym poziomie szczegółowości
  • Doskonałej umiejętności przekładania celu biznesowego na rozwiązania IT, które są tak proste jak to możliwe, i nie bardziej skomplikowane niż to absolutnie konieczne
  • Chęci i wytrwałości w stałym podnoszeniu standardów zespołu (zarówno pod kątem jakości kodu, architektury systemu, jak i szczególnie procesu)
  • Umiejętności korzystania z nowoczesnych narzędzi AI w programowaniu (jak Cursor / Windsurf, które pomagają tworzyć całe funkcje/moduły a nie pojedyncze metody).
  • Min. 4 lata komercyjnego doświadczenia w pracy z PHP i Symfony
  • Min. 2 lata komercyjnego doświadczenia w pracy z TypeScript oraz React.js lub Vue.js
  • Znajomości zagadnień zw. z wydajnością i optymalizacją aplikacji web.
  • Praktycznej znajomości obszaru środowisk skonteneryzowanych (Docker)
  • Praktycznej znajomości wzorców projektowych i dobrych praktyk programowania (SOLID, KISS, DRY itd)
  • Biegłości w pracy z systemami kontroli wersji, np. Git.
  • Ownershipu - samodzielności i odpowiedzialności za powierzone zadania
  • Dokładności i sumienności w pracy (indywidualnie i w zespole)
  • Płynnej znajomości języka polskiego.

Mile widziane:

  • Znajomość zagadnień zw. z infrastrukturą aplikacji w chmurze (np. GCP)
  • Doświadczenie w rozwoju architektury mikroserwisowej.
  • Doświadczenia w pisaniu testów jednostkowych i integracyjnych.
  • Doświadczenie komercyjne z Node.js / Nest.js

Pracujemy z:

  • Backend: Symfony, PHP + MySQL/PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, GraphQL, Hasura
    • architektura: mikroserwisy + duży monolit
  • Frontend: React.js + Typescript + Twig w panelach admina
  • Infrastruktura: Google Cloud Platform + Kubernetes, Datadog
  • Build (CI): Docker, Github Actions
  • Kontrola wersji: Github
  • Issue Tracker: JIRA, Confluence
  • Testy: PHPUnit + Playwright + QA manualne

Benefits

  • Wynagrodzenie: 25 000 - 32 000 PLN netto (B2B)
  • Elastyczny model pracy (hybrid/remote)
  • Opieka medyczna
  • Karta Multisport
  • Współpraca w oparciu o B2B lub umowę zlecenie

Co wyróżni Cię spośród innych kandydatów:

  • Twoja zdolność do myślenia poza schematami
  • Komunikatywność - jasna, klarowna i rzeczowa
  • Umiejętność rozwiązywania problemów "end to end".

Nasze wartości

  • Organizational "YES": Witamy osoby, które z entuzjazmem podchodzą do zmian i nowych możliwości.
  • 5x why, first principles: Zachęcamy do zadawania pytań "dlaczego?" i szukania lepszych rozwiązań.
  • Data-driven: Wspieramy decyzje rzetelnymi danymi i analizami. Zawsze weryfikujemy informacje u źródła - nie przyjmujemy założeń bez sprawdzenia faktów i danych.
  • Startup mindset: Cenimy szybkie działanie i eksperymentowanie poprzez prototypy.
  • Getting things done as an A-player: Koncentrujemy się na realnych efektach i wspólnie świętujemy sukcesy. Nie tolerujemy zaniedbań i nie popełniamy błędów wynikających z niedbalstwa.
  • Transparency: Stawiamy na radykalnie szczerą komunikację w duchu "radical candor" - feedback jest bezpośredni, konstruktywny i natychmiastowy. Mówimy otwarcie co działa, a co wymaga poprawy.
  • Sense of urgency: Działamy sprawnie i efektywnie, dążąc do szybkiej realizacji celów.
  • Accountability: Nie chowamy głowy w piasek - otwarcie przyznajemy gdy coś nie działa i bierzemy odpowiedzialność za wprowadzanie niezbędnych zmian.

Co nie wpisuje się w naszą kulturę pracy:

  • Ignorowanie problemów.
  • Brak zaangażowania w testowanie nowych inicjatyw.
  • Opieranie działań na nieaktualnych danych i brak elastyczności w działaniu.
  • Unikanie odpowiedzialności
  • Stagnacja: Oczekiwanie, że metody, które były efektywne w przeszłości, będą działać na zawsze.
  • Przeciwstawianie się zmianie
  • Brak transparentności
  • Niewłaściwe zarządzanie czasem. Brak pilności w działaniu.
  • Odkładanie zadań na później
  • Ignorowanie problemów
  • Popełnianie błędów wynikających z zaniedbania

Etapy procesu rekrutacyjnego:

  1. krótki quiz online (5-10 min)
  2. zadanie techniczne
  3. rozmowa z Hiring Managerem
  4. (opcjonalnie) Assessment Day dla wybranych kandydatów

Dzięki takim etapom rekrutacji nie wymagamy dużego zaangażowania czasowego na początku, proces rekrutacyjny idzie sprawnie (feedback dostajesz szybko!) oraz możemy dać szansę szerszemu gronu kandydatów.

Jeżeli uważasz, że jesteś właściwą osobą do tego stanowiska, skontaktuj się z nami i dołącz do zespołu, który naprawdę robi różnicę! W swoim CV pokaż nam, że jesteś komandosem, którego szukamy.

Nie zwlekaj, dołącz do nas już dziś!

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and are the world’s leading tokenizer of public equities. We are seeking an experienced attorney to join our legal team as Senior Counsel, Commercial. This role will work closely with business development, partnerships, marketing, operations, and other commercial teams to structure, negotiate, and execute the agreements that support Ondo’s growth.

The Senior Counsel, Commercial will serve as a practical and commercially minded legal partner across a broad range of strategic relationships and transactions. This individual will lead negotiations, advise stakeholders on contractual and regulatory risk, and develop scalable processes that enable the business to move quickly while protecting Ondo’s interests.

The ideal candidate has significant experience negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements within financial services, fintech, blockchain, or another high-growth technology business. They should be comfortable managing complex negotiations independently, balancing legal risk with commercial objectives, and partnering closely with senior business stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a primary legal partner to business development, partnerships, marketing, operations, and other commercial teams
  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of agreements, including strategic partnerships, distribution, technology, licensing, vendor, service, referral, marketing, data, and confidentiality agreements
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations from initial structuring through execution and renewal
  • Advise stakeholders on contractual, regulatory, reputational, and counterparty risks associated with commercial initiatives
  • Support relationships with financial institutions, fintech companies, blockchain protocols, exchanges, wallets, custodians, market makers, technology providers, and other ecosystem partners
  • Develop pragmatic solutions that balance legal protection with commercial objectives and speed of execution
  • Advise marketing and business teams on promotional campaigns, partner communications, public claims, and related commercial arrangements
  • Partner with compliance and regulatory counsel to address issues involving securities, financial promotions, anti-money laundering, data protection, licensing, and geographic restrictions
  • Develop and maintain contract templates, negotiation playbooks, approval processes, and scalable commercial legal workflows
  • Provide training and guidance to business teams on contracting, negotiation, and risk management
  • Manage outside counsel and specialist advisers where appropriate
  • Support the AGC Commercial and other senior legal personnel on strategic transactions and business priorities

Requirements

  • JD degree from an accredited U.S. law school
  • 5–8+ years of legal experience at a major law firm and/or a high-growth blockchain, fintech, financial services, or technology company
  • Significant experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements
  • Strong understanding of commercial contracting principles, including liability, indemnification, intellectual property, data use, confidentiality, service levels, termination rights, and regulatory allocation
  • Experience advising business development, partnerships, marketing, sales, operations, or other commercial teams
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to provide clear, practical advice in situations involving competing business and legal considerations
  • Ability to lead negotiations independently and engage credibly with senior internal stakeholders and sophisticated counterparties
  • Understanding of the blockchain industry and the commercial relationships that support digital-asset or financial-services businesses
  • Familiarity with securities, anti-money laundering, financial promotions, data protection, and other relevant financial-services regulations
  • Excellent drafting, negotiation, analytical, and communication skills
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple transactions and deadlines simultaneously
  • Comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment
  • Experience with tokenized assets, institutional financial products, or international commercial arrangements is a plus

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including but not limited to salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — We are well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation.
  • Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO).
  • Remote-first team across many countries — You will be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices.
  • A+ colleagues — Our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Coinbase, Circle, Uniswap.

Since 2018, Wisetack has been building transparent and intuitive consumer lending products that help service-based businesses thrive (think HVAC companies, veterinarians, or auto repair shops).

Our leadership team comes from top fintech companies such as Lending Club, Affirm, and Varo Money. And we’re backed by leading VCs, including Insight Partners, Greylock, Quadrille, and Bain Capital Ventures (investors in Airbnb, LinkedIn, Instagram, Dropbox, and more).

Having raised $84M, we’re a well-funded startup and have invested in people and technology while growing our partnerships — responsibly.

We’re also proud to have received recognition from the fintech world. Awards we’ve won include:

  • Ranked #21 on 2024 Inc. 5000 based on revenue growth
  • Ranked #15 on 2024 Deloitte Fast 500 based on revenue growth
  • 2024 Best Embedded Finance Solution for Banking Tech Awards
  • 2023 Best Consumer Lending Program by Tearsheet
  • 2023 Best Point of Sale Product by Fintech Breakthrough

But what you’ll find us gleaming about the most is the recognition from our own customers, particularly our sky-high NPS rating of 79. (For reference, the average score is 44 for financial services and 36 for SaaS companies.)

As a result of our efforts in building this healthy company culture, we’ve been nominated to several Great Places to Work lists, such as Best Small Workplaces, Best Workplaces in the Bay Area, and Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance.

Like any startup, we’re in it for the long haul, and we’re looking for people willing to join our journey of building something special together.

This process starts with our company values, which guide us in everything we do — and have played a critical role in our success. We valiantly abide by them, and would expect you to do the same:

  • Put customers first (that’s our M.O.)
  • Act fast (leverage our startup environment).
  • Lead the way (show and tell).
  • Take ownership (everyone is hands-on here).
  • Be a good human (no egos, build financial products that do right by people).

Learn more about our values here.

The Role

The Customer Success Associate (CSA) will play a pivotal role in directly engaging with our SMB customers to drive the successful activation of Wisetack as their preferred financing solution. This role helps merchants understand how Wisetack can support close rates, ticket sizes, and overall business growth, while ensuring new customers are set up to successfully maximize their use of Wisetack to grow loan volume.

Key responsibilities include owning a structured onboarding process, managing merchant relationships, and driving measurable activation outcomes. While this role is not a traditional sales role, it does require consultative communication skills and the ability to guide conversations toward the fastest path to early success with Wisetack.

The ideal candidate will be highly adaptable, motivated, and eager to experiment with various strategies to refine and optimize our merchant activation playbook. This position requires someone who is intellectually curious, diligent, proactive, and deeply committed to customer success, always prioritizing integrity and long-term results over short-term gains. Additionally, the CSA will actively gather and relay product feedback from merchants, contributing to ongoing improvements and innovation within Wisetack’s offerings.

Responsibilities

  • Onboard new customers using different channels (phone calls, video conferencing, emails and text messaging)
  • Educate new customers about the benefits Wisetack brings to their business
  • Executing ad-hoc activation campaigns, as determined by business needs
  • Communicate merchant needs, recurring blockers, and feedback to cross-functional partners, especially product, marketing, and partner teams
  • Collaborate actively with the growth and product teams to ensure consistent experience, share learnings, and consolidate feedback

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, such as customer success, onboarding, support, sales, or account management
  • Bachelors degree
  • Comfort with the types of technology we use as a team: Salesforce, Tableau, Salesloft, Slack, Google Suite, Claude, ChatGPT, Granola, Confluence, and more
  • Demonstrated ability to use customer data and feedback to prioritize work, identify patterns, and surface opportunities for improvement
  • Strong verbal and written communication via phone, text, video conferencing, and email
  • Strong organizational skills, time management, and follow-through in a high-volume environment
  • Product orientation, as evidenced by prior work in a technology start-up
  • Comfort using AI tools to improve productivity, communication quality, and day-to-day workflow efficiency

Bonus points

  • Fintech experience
  • Experience with the home services sector or SMB sector

Conclusion

The range of base salary for the position is between $58,300.00 - $81,600.00, plus $4,000 annual discretionary bonus, equity, and benefits. Please note that the base salary range is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level and competencies.

Spend a little time on our About Us page and check out our Press page and our blog for more. If you think this might be a fit, we’d love to hear from you!

This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making. Our data practices are described in Wisetack’s Privacy Policy.

SAP Basis Consultant – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP Basis Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $90,000–$120,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Basis Consultant to design, build, and operate extensions, side-by-side applications, and integration scenarios on SAP’s Business Technology Platform. In this role you will leverage BTP services across application development, integration, data and analytics, and AI to deliver clean-core extensions of SAP S/4HANA and other SAP applications. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on experience with the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP), SAP Fiori/UI5, BTP services, and CI/CD tooling with a clear understanding of clean-core principles, multi-tenant SaaS design, and SAP integration best practices.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SAP development experience, with significant hands-on work on SAP BTP.
  • Strong experience with the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) in Node.js and/or Java.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 development.
  • Solid experience with OData v2/v4 service design and consumption.
  • Experience with BTP runtimes (Cloud Foundry and/or Kyma) and BTP services.
  • Working knowledge of XSUAA, SAP IAS, and SAP IPS.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD patterns and tooling for BTP.
  • Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA extension patterns and clean-core principles.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • SAP-certified BTP developer credentials.
  • Experience with SAP Build, Workflow, Business Rules, or Document Management Service.
  • Exposure to SAP AI Core and integration with hyperscaler AI services.
  • Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite / CPI.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS applications on BTP.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to . Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Global IT & Digital Transformation Manager

Work Arrangement: Remote

Job Summary

Our client, a global manufacturing company, is seeking an experienced technology leader to drive the continued transformation of its enterprise systems, data capabilities, and technology environment across multiple international locations.

The role will partner closely with business and functional leaders to improve the way technology supports manufacturing operations, business visibility, decision-making, and organizational growth.

The successful candidate will bring strong experience in ERP transformation, enterprise data and analytics, multi-site manufacturing environments, and the ability to coordinate and orchestrate distributed teams, technology partners, and complex transformation initiatives across multiple locations.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Systems, or a related field.
  • An advanced degree or relevant professional certifications are preferred.

Requirements

Experience

  • Background leading technology transformation within multi-plant manufacturing environments.
  • Successful work across complex, international or geographically distributed organizations, coordinating internal technology teams, regional resources, and external service providers.
  • Demonstrated leadership in ERP implementation, migration, modernization, or standardization across multiple locations.
  • Leadership in enterprise data and business applications, including data architecture, analytics, business intelligence, system integration, and the development of scalable data capabilities across business functions.
  • Familiarity with operating within or establishing a hub-and-spoke technology model, balancing centralized standards with the needs of individual locations or business units.
  • Strong technology leadership and governance experience, with the ability to prioritize initiatives, coordinate complex resources, establish accountability, and deliver measurable business results.
  • Experience developing or leading technology professionals across enterprise systems, data, infrastructure, or related functions.
  • Proven ability to partner with senior business leaders on technology investments, vendor relationships, and budget-related decisions.
  • Fluent English required, with strong verbal and written communication skills for interaction with international teams and senior leadership.

Technical Knowledge

  • Enterprise data architecture, data engineering, and end-to-end data integration.
  • Power BI and modern data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable technologies.
  • APIs, ETL/ELT processes, Python, SQL, and data pipeline concepts.
  • ERP systems and enterprise applications; Acumatica experience is preferred.
  • Manufacturing systems, including MES, shop-floor applications, supply chain systems, and operational data environments.
  • Cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, business continuity, and enterprise technology fundamentals.

Competencies

  • Strategic Coordination & Leadership – ability to guide multiple teams, systems, providers, and priorities through influence and direction rather than direct technical execution.
  • Complex Environment Leadership – ability to lead effectively across distributed organizations, different locations, cultures, and technology environments.
  • Prioritization and Decision Making – ability to focus resources on the initiatives with the greatest business impact.
  • Change Leadership – ability to drive standardization, adoption, and organizational change across multiple locations.
  • Business and Technology Alignment – ability to translate operational and financial priorities into practical technology solutions.
  • Influence and Accountability – ability to align stakeholders, establish clear expectations, and drive results through direct and indirect teams.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technology transformation initiatives supporting business growth, operational efficiency, and improved decision-making.
  • Advance ERP modernization and standardization across multiple manufacturing locations.
  • Develop a scalable technology operating structure that improves consistency across locations while maintaining appropriate flexibility for local business needs.
  • Coordinate internal technology resources, regional teams, external providers, and technology partners to ensure clear priorities and consistent delivery.
  • Establish and maintain effective technology governance across enterprise systems, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and external service providers.
  • Strengthen cybersecurity coverage and technology resilience across multiple locations.
  • Evaluate and optimize external technology providers to improve service quality, consistency, and cost effectiveness.
  • Simplify and modernize infrastructure environments to improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Improve technology visibility, reporting, and accountability across key initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify systems, reduce manual processes, improve integration, and eliminate unnecessary complexity.
  • Support automation and digital transformation initiatives that generate measurable operational and financial value.
  • Participate in technology investment planning, vendor evaluation, and budget-related decisions.
  • Strengthen the technology leadership structure by developing internal capabilities across enterprise systems, data, analytics, infrastructure, and digital transformation.

Data & Business Applications Leadership

  • Lead the continued development of the enterprise Data & Business Applications capability, providing direction, prioritization, and technical guidance to the team.
  • Establish data governance, ownership, architecture, and standardized KPI and reporting practices to improve consistency, reliability, and business visibility across the organization.
  • Lead the evolution of the enterprise data platform, integrating ERP, supply chain, manufacturing, shop-floor, and other operational systems into a reliable data foundation for business decision-making.
  • Drive the effective adoption and standardization of business intelligence, modern data platforms, APIs, integration frameworks, and data engineering technologies, reducing siloed systems and spreadsheet-dependent reporting.
  • Ensure data and analytics initiatives deliver practical business value, including improved forecasting, operational and supply chain visibility, and standardized financial and operational performance reporting.
  • Provide functional leadership to Data expertise within the organization, coaching internal resources while maintaining sufficient technical depth to challenge design decisions and ensure solutions remain simple, scalable, and aligned with business needs.

What Client Offers

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to work in an international, growing, and innovative company.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • Exposure to global technology and transformation initiatives.
  • Opportunity to contribute to business-critical technology decisions.
  • Dynamic work environment with a focus on teamwork and collaboration.
Our client is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience.
jobs.description:
iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.

We are currently seeking an ambitious pace-setter to join our team as a Software Engineer remotely in the US.

iFIT is looking for a mid-to-senior level Software Engineer to design and build the backend services powering iFIT's interactive fitness experiences. In this role, you will work on a service-oriented architecture in AWS, primarily using TypeScript and NestJS to create scalable microservices. Your contributions will directly impact millions of users worldwide, ensuring our platform remains reliable, performant, and primed for innovation. You will help drive the evolution of our APIs from REST to GraphQL, modernize legacy systems, and integrate with billing platforms such as Stripe, Apple, Google, and more. To facilitate collaboration, you must be available during core hours of 10 AM - 3 PM US Mountain Time, and will participate in a rotating on-call schedule approximately one week per rotation with the team.

ROLE COMMITMENTS

  • Develop and maintain backend microservices in TypeScript and NestJS deployed via AWS ECS, ensuring services are well-designed, scalable, and aligned with our service-oriented architecture and best practices.
  • Design, implement, and document robust RESTful APIs that are secure, efficient, and easy for client teams to use.
  • Help migrate legacy serverless functions from AWS Lambda into containerized services on ECS, refactoring and re-architecting older systems for improved performance, maintainability, and consistency across the platform.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work closely with front-end and mobile teams, product managers, and designers to deliver end-to-end features, clarify requirements, review designs, and ensure seamless integration across multiple services.
  • Write clean, well-tested code and participate in peer code reviews, maintaining comprehensive unit and integration tests and continuously improving CI/CD pipelines.
  • Take ownership of the reliability of the services you build, monitor performance, troubleshoot production issues, and participate in a rotating 24/7 on-call schedule to quickly address critical incidents and minimize downtime.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

Education and Basic Qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend or full-stack applications in a cloud environment.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and Node.js with hands-on experience with backend frameworks — NestJS strongly preferred, or similar frameworks like Express/Koa with a willingness to learn NestJS.
  • Solid knowledge of AWS services and architecture, with experience deploying and running containerized applications in AWS ECS, EKS, or similar, and familiarity with microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architecture.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs with a strong understanding of API security and performance considerations.
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB, as well as caching mechanisms such as Redis, with the ability to write efficient queries and optimize data access in a cloud environment.
  • Comfortable with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation, and knowledge of monitoring and logging tools such as CloudWatch and Datadog.
  • Ability to jump into unfamiliar projects quickly and work across different services and tech stacks as needed.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a team-oriented mindset and a habit of knowledge sharing and proactive problem-solving.
  • Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of microservice design patterns, inter-service communication including REST, gRPC, and message queues, and related tooling such as API gateways and service mesh.
  • Familiarity with Claude Code or similar AI coding assistants.
  • Experience with DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering practices including automated testing, continuous deployment, and infrastructure monitoring.
  • Experience with Stripe's broad set of products and third-party subscription providers such as Apple App Store or Google Play subscription platforms.

DISCLAIMER
Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan, and exemption status.

jobs.description:
Role Description

As an Infrastructure Engineer, your role will be crucial in shaping and constructing the robust systems that not only support our current flagship products but also lay the groundwork for the next wave of engineering innovations. From optimizing user experiences across various projects to ensuring seamless scalability and data integrity, you'll be at the forefront of shaping the technological backbone of our platform.

Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you'll leverage your expertise to tackle audacious challenges and push the boundaries of what's possible. Your contributions will directly impact millions of users, as every line of code you write furthers our mission to revolutionize the way people work and collaborate.

Join us in redefining the future, where your passion for building scalable, reliable systems will drive meaningful change on a global scale.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Build infrastructure capable of managing metadata for hundreds of billions of files, handling hundreds of petabytes of user data, and facilitating millions of concurrent connections.
  • Assist in expanding Dropbox's role as the data-fabric, linking hundreds of millions of applications, devices, and services worldwide, while spearheading efforts to improve interoperability and adaptability across various ecosystems.
  • Measure and optimize Dropbox's analytics platform to maintain its status as one of the most advanced in the industry for extracting meaningful insights from vast data volumes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to innovate and implement solutions that enhance the performance, reliability, and security of Dropbox's infrastructure, ensuring a seamless experience for users worldwide.

On-call work may be necessary occasionally to help address bugs, outages, or other operational issues, with the goal of maintaining a stable and high-quality experience for our customers.

Requirements

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding(e.g., physics or mathematics), or equivalent technical experience
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience

jobs.title: Research Intern
jobs.excerpt: Machine intelligence will soon take over humanity’s role in knowledge-keeping and creation.
jobs.description:
Machine intelligence will soon take over humanity’s role in knowledge-keeping and creation. What started in the mid-1990s as the gradual off-loading of knowledge and decision making to search engines will be rapidly replaced by vast neural networks - with all knowledge compressed into their artificial neurons. Unlike organic life, machine intelligence, built within silicon, needs protocols to coordinate and grow. And, like nature, these protocols should be open, permissionless, and neutral. Starting with compute hardware, the Gensyn protocol networks together the core resources required for machine intelligence to flourish alongside human intelligence.

The Role

  • Contribute to cutting-edge research in scalable, distributed machine learning systems alongside experienced researchers and engineers. Explore new ways of building and verifying neural networks that operate across huge, decentralised, topologies of heterogenous devices.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to original research in deep learning with a focus on modular architectures, verifiability, continual learning, and scale
  • Design and prototype novel neural network architectures for decentralized compute environments
  • Contribute to joint publications and projects in collaboration with academic and industry researchers targeting top-tier AI venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR

Competencies

Must Have

  • Currently enrolled in a PhD program (or, in exceptional cases, in a Master’s program) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field
  • Prior experience conducting original research, ideally with authorship or co-authorship on ML papers
  • Strong understanding of deep learning fundamentals and experience working with in at least one major framework, e.g. PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow
  • Self-directed, curious, and able to thrive in an environment with high autonomy
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred

  • Research experience in distributed systems, continual learning, or modular neural architectures
  • A desire to contribute to open research and collaborate with the broader ML research community

Nice to Have

  • Experience at the intersection of cryptography and machine learning

Please note: the benefits listed below apply to full-time employees only

Compensation / Benefits

  • Competitive salary + share of equity and token pool
  • Fully remote work- we currently hire between the West Coast (PT) and Central Europe (CET) time zones
  • Visa sponsorship -available for those who would like to relocate to the US after being hired
  • 3-4x all expenses paid company retreats around the world, per year
  • Whatever equipment you need
  • Paid sick leave and flexible vacation
  • Company-sponsored health, vision, and dental insurance- including spouse/dependents [🇺🇸 only]

Our Principles

Autonomy & Independence

  • Don’t ask for permission - we have a constraint culture, not a permission culture.
  • Claim ownership of any work stream and set its goals/deadlines, rather than waiting to be assigned work or relying on job specs.
  • Push & pull context on your work rather than waiting for information from others and assuming people know what you’re doing.
  • Communicate to be understood rather than pushing out information and expecting others to work to understand it.
  • Stay a small team - misalignment and politics scale super-linearly with team size. Small protocol teams rival much larger traditional teams.

Rejection of mediocrity & high performance

  • Give direct feedback to everyone immediately - rather than avoiding unpopularity, expecting things to improve naturally, or trading short-term pain for extreme long-term pain.
  • Embrace an extreme learning rate - rather than assuming limits to your ability / knowledge.
  • Don’t quit - push to the final outcome, despite any barriers.
  • Be anti-fragile - balance short-term risk for long-term outcomes.
  • Reject waste - guard the company’s time, rather than wasting it in meetings without clear purpose/focus, or bikeshedding.

Job Description

Join Us as a Clinical Research Associate (Level II) – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.


As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. As a Clinical Research Associate (Level II), you'll conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e., FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acting as a site processes specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix.

What You’ll Do:

  • Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.
    • Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential
    • investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Performs trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
    • Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
    • Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System).
    • Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
    • Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
    • Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
    • Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools, and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members.
    • Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.


    Education and Experience Requirements:
    • Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related fieldor a Registered Nursing certification or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
    • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 1 years as a clinical research monitor) or completion of PPD Drug Development Fellowship.
    • Valid driver's license where applicable.
    In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

    Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
    • Proven clinical monitoring skills
    • Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
    • Demonstrated ability to attain and maintain a working knowledge of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
    • Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical mindset, in-depthinvestigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Principal Data Lead to help lead the strategy, governance, and quality of data on one of our large-scale federal data platform programs. In this role, you'll own execution of the data strategy for a multi-year enterprise data platform, lead the data supply chain, and drive a multi-phase metadata maturity program that raises the bar for how data is documented, trusted, and reused across the platform. You'll govern how data is promoted from initial ingestion through validated, trusted status, set and maintain data quality standards, and serve as the connective tissue between the platform team and the many upstream source-system teams and business data owners who depend on it.

This is foundational work: the metadata and data quality practices you lead are what make it possible to safely expand governed self-service analytics and AI use cases. If you enjoy building durable data governance capability inside a live, high-stakes production environment — not just writing policy — we'd love to hear from you.

This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location:

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S., be able to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance, and obtain a U.S. Federal Government client badge. Bixal does not sponsor employment visas or assume sponsorship of existing employment visas.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $160,000 – $200,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Own execution of the data strategy for a large-scale enterprise data platform, aligning day-to-day delivery with the organization’s broader data strategy and strategic goals.

  • Serve as the primary coordination point across multiple upstream source-system teams and business data owners, managing handoffs, ingestion readiness, and shared metadata standards across the ecosystem.

  • Lead the data supply chain — source onboarding, ingestion, and transformation — and drive a multi-phase metadata maturity program, treating metadata as an operational capability rather than a one-time cataloging effort.

  • Govern the promotion of data through a tiered catalog architecture (e.g., raw, source, and trusted layers), defining clear admission criteria and applying the model consistently across teams.

  • Set and maintain data quality standards across the platform, including completeness, conformance, freshness against SLAs, and defect/rework tracking.

  • Partner with engineering, product, and AI/platform teams to ensure metadata and data quality are sufficient to support expanding self-service analytics and AI use cases.

  • Establish and track measures of data quality, metadata coverage, and promotion/certification cycle time, and use them to prioritize remediation work.

  • Communicate data strategy progress, risks, and dependencies to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership.

  • Participate in Agile/SAFe delivery cadences, including planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified and trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, plus at least 10 years of related experience.

  • Strong track record coordinating across multiple stakeholder teams and data owners in complex, multi-system environments.

  • Demonstrated experience owning or leading a data strategy for a large, multi-source enterprise data platform.

  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, or similar) and metadata/catalog tooling (e.g., Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Microsoft Purview).

  • Experience defining and enforcing data quality standards, including completeness, conformance, freshness, and defect tracking.

  • Experience defining and enforcing data quality standards, including completeness, conformance, freshness, and defect tracking.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical data concepts for non-technical audiences, including client leadership.

  • Professional certification in a cloud or data platform (e.g., AWS, Databricks), data governance (e.g., DAMA CDMP), or Agile delivery (e.g., SAFe).

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in highly regulated federal data domains (e.g., healthcare, benefits, or financial data).

  • Familiarity with responsible AI governance and how metadata and data quality maturity gate the expansion of AI use cases.

  • Hands-on experience building, tuning, or troubleshooting data pipelines on a cloud lakehouse platform (e.g., Databricks or comparable).

  • Exposure to CI/CD, source control, and observability tooling as applied to data platform and pipeline operations.

  • Experience supporting or serving in a Key Personnel role on a federal contract.
