jobs.description:
About Hopscotch Primary Care

At Hopscotch Primary Care, we believe great healthcare should be accessible to all people across all communities. Today, almost 20% of Americans live in a rural community, yet only 11% of physicians practice in those same communities. We are on a mission to transform healthcare in rural America. We provide high-quality primary care tailored to meet the needs of our patients through our robust care model and comprehensive care team, delivering care in our clinics, and across settings, and wrapping resources around the patients who need them most.

Our patients and the care teams who serve them sit at the center of everything we do at Hopscotch. Hopscotch Primary Care takes a team approach to serve patient needs and provide the best care possible. Our goal is to provide the care each of us would want for ourselves or for our family members, in the right setting, and at the right time.

Today, we are serving thousands of patients in our value-based care model and the number is growing every day. If you want to bring your experience, skill and passion to make a lasting impact in healthcare, we’d like to meet you.

Role Description

The Sr. Analyst, Health Plan Analytics operates at the intersection of FP&A, analytics, and population health, turning claims and clinical data into the insight that drives Hopscotch’s value-based care performance. Working on top of our engineering governed data foundation, this person will mature and maintain the standard claims model and the reporting infrastructure that underpins financial close, clinical review, and performance management. We're looking for someone equally strong at building the infrastructure and interrogating what comes out of it - technically excellent, with the judgement to know when a number is wrong and why.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the in-house build of Hopscotch’s cost categorization capability – including customizations, updates for new code and mappings, and change management.
  • Own the ongoing maintenance, enhancements, governance, change control, and documentation for Hopscotch’s payer data and cost categorization capabilities.
  • Build and maintain the medical economics reporting suite (e.g., SQL, PBI, Excel) and support IBNR estimation, cohort forecasting, and paid-risk pacing.
  • Review monthly outputs to surface cost drivers and emerging trends, distinguishing real movement from the impact of incomplete claims and statistical noise.
  • Analyze medical cost trend across factors such as unit cost, utilization, mix; and enrich claims with EHR, eligibility, provider, and risk adjustment data to explain population-level trends and financial performance.
  • Work with medical economics and finance leadership to identify and complete high-impact analyses, including pro forma and ROI for medical cost initiatives.
  • Partner across Clinical, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into analyses, ensure results flow accurately into management reporting, and build repeatable analytic processes that scale across programs.

About You

  • You build and you interrogate – you can stand up a clean dataset and tell when the output doesn't pass the smell test or is logically inconsistent.
  • You exercise critical thinking and understand the conceptual framework and database relationships that underly healthcare data.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguous problems and immature data and take pride in acknowledging what's unknown while taking steps to fill the gaps.
  • You form a point of view; you don't just produce the number, you explain what's driving it and why it matters.
  • You document as you build, so your definitions are transparent and others can rely on them.
  • You're a self-starter with an ownership mindset, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and care about transforming rural healthcare.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's in Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Health Informatics, Actuarial Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare analytics or medical economics (payer, provider, health system, ACO, or VBC).
  • High proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and Excel.
  • Hands-on experience with healthcare claims data, and combining data sources (claims, eligibility, EHR, risk adjustment).
  • Familiarity with healthcare financial and utilization concepts (e.g., PMPM, MLR, utilization per 1,000, trend, risk adjustment)
  • Experience with maturing data models, identifying improvement opportunities while still generating value from nascent datasets.
  • Experience presenting and communicating data-driven insights to functional leaders.

Preferred / Bonus Qualifications

  • Direct value-based care / medical-economics analytics experience, and familiarity with key considerations and leading methodologies for claims cost categorization.
  • Experience with Palantir Foundry or a comparable enterprise data platform.
  • Comfort using AI-assisted tooling to accelerate build and analysis.
  • Statistical methods (regression, difference-in-differences, propensity score matching).
  • Experience leading technical/analytical projects with combined teams of functional and technical stakeholders.

In accordance with the Illinois Pay Transparency Act, we’re providing the full salary range for this position. Actual compensation will be determined based on location, relevant experience and qualifications. Most offers will fall within a portion of the listed range. This position has a salary range of $110,000 – $120,000 annually, based on location, relevant experience and qualifications. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

We're scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don't insulate us from feedback or basics. Every product, strategy, or asset we create must be both beautiful and functional; practical, usable, and designed for real-world impact.

Humans are our most valuable resource, and we only grow by hiring people who push us forward. Across strategy, engineering, design, data, and operations, we seek out teammates who raise the bar and make us better. Always hire up, never down.

We partner with organizations of all sizes to explore, design, and implement AI strategies that are secure, scalable, and human-centered. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it, and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

The Opportunity

This is not a traditional sales role. We are not calling on mid-level executives to sell packaged service engagements. We are becoming the AI entrepreneur embedded inside the biggest companies in America — the team that gets carte blanche from the owner to go build the future of their business.

That requires owner-level access. It requires trust that takes years to build. It requires a network of relationships at the very top of the market — founders, family office principals, PE partners, and the executives who actually control capital allocation and strategic direction. You have that network. You open the doors. We close together.

You will be responsible for building the commercial engine that takes Human Agency from a high-performing consultancy to the strategic AI partner for the 5,000 most important companies in North America. This is your opportunity to prove what you're capable of at the highest levels of business.

Who You Are

jobs.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Senior Logistics Strategy and Integration Specailist to provide subject matter expertise to the United States Transportation Command's Strategy, Policy, Programs, and Logistics Directorate (USTRANSCOM J4/J5/J7).

The selected candidate will work as part of a multidisciplinary team of subject matter experts to integrate spacelift point-to-point delivery (P2D) of cargo into USTRANSCOM's Joint Deployment and Distribution Enterprise (JDDE). The primary objective of this role is to support the integration of spacelift as a fully recognized fourth mode of cargo transportation within the JDDE.

This position focuses on joint-level policy, doctrine, and planning integration, rather than day-to-day operational execution. The Senior Logistics Strategy and Integration Specailist will collaborate with joint, Service, and Combatant Command stakeholders to develop, assess, and implement policy and guidance that enables future spacelift-enabled logistics operations.

This is a remote position with the ability for occasional travel (<25%).

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed. Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

LMI offers a generous compensation package with excellent benefits that start the first day of employment. Business casual dress, flexible work schedules, generous leave and tuition reimbursement are a few of our many work-life benefits available to our employees. Come join the organization consistently ranked as a top workplace!

Responsibilities

  • Support joint-level planning efforts related to the integration of spacelift capabilities into the Joint Deployment and Distribution Enterprise (JDDE)
  • Apply the Joint Planning Process (JPP) to analyze mission requirements, operational concepts, and policy implications associated with spacelift-enabled cargo delivery
  • Conduct DOTMLPF-P analysis to identify capability gaps, risks, and opportunities related to spacelift integration, and develop recommendations to inform policy, doctrine, and capability development
  • Develop, staff, and continuously refine Commander’s Estimates, incorporating evolving guidance, assumptions, constraints, risks, and analytical results throughout the planning lifecycle
  • Develop, review, and coordinate joint doctrine, policy, and service-level guidance in support of spacelift and space mobility initiatives
  • Provide analytic support, including qualitative and quantitative assessments, modeling, simulation, and other analytical tools, to inform senior leader decision-making
  • Design, develop, and execute DoD exercises, wargames, and tabletop events to evaluate spacelift concepts, policies, and operational constructs
  • Coordinate with USTRANSCOM, USSF, the Joint Staff, Combatant Commands, and other DoD stakeholders to align spacelift planning efforts with joint logistics and mobility frameworks
  • Prepare senior-level briefings, decision papers, reports, and other written products in support of policy development and planning activities
  • Facilitate and support working groups, planning sessions, and stakeholder meetings, both in person and virtually
  • Track, assess, and communicate emerging issues, risks, dependencies, and recommendations related to spacelift integration and joint logistics policy

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree with 4 years of relevant experience, or Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of relevant experience, in DoD project leadership, joint planning, transportation, and logistics
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification (desired)
  • Logistics planning background with demonstrated experience applying the Joint Planning Process (JPP)
  • Staff-level experience at the Joint Staff, Service Headquarters, Major Command (MAJCOM), Agency, and/or Combatant Command (CCMD) level
  • Experience conducting DOTMLPF-P analysis and supporting the development of senior leader decision products, including Commander’s Estimates
  • Experience conducting qualitative and quantitative analysis, including the use of analytical and simulation models and Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI)
  • Experience designing and executing DoD exercises, wargames, or tabletop events
  • Experience with, and understanding of, DoD joint operations
  • Understanding of USTRANSCOM roles, issues, and priorities
  • Understanding of United States Space Force (USSF) organization, mission, and operational constructs
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience preparing error-free, senior-level correspondence, presentations, meeting minutes, and reports
  • Ability to facilitate high-level meetings and planning sessions with multiple stakeholders, both in person and virtually
  • Self-directed and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and adapt to a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities
  • Ability to perform occasional shift work and extended hours, as required
  • Availability for limited travel within CONUS (approximately 10%)
  • Active Secret security clearance required, with the ability to obtain a TS/SCI; U.S. citizenship required

AI-Augmented QA Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an AI-Augmented QA Engineer to own and expand automated testing for an early-stage, fast-moving security platform.

You’ll work closely with frontend and backend engineers to build reliable test coverage, strengthen the existing Playwright test suite, and ensure critical product workflows remain stable as the platform evolves.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll have significant ownership. You’ll receive clear goals around test coverage and reliability rather than step-by-step instructions, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working independently and improving systems proactively.

What You’ll Own

Test Automation & Coverage

  • Write and maintain automated end-to-end tests using Playwright
  • Expand coverage across critical product workflows
  • Build regression tests that run automatically on every pull request
  • Test workflows including dashboards, detection workflows, device management, user permissions, and settings
  • Keep the test architecture clean, maintainable, and scalable as the product grows

Test Infrastructure & Reliability

  • Own the reliability of the automated test suite and CI pipeline
  • Diagnose and reduce flaky tests
  • Manage test data and seed data requirements
  • Monitor and improve staging environment stability
  • Maintain reliable test execution as the product and test suite expand

AI-Assisted Exploratory Testing

  • Use AI-assisted browser automation to explore edge cases and uncover bugs
  • Work with Claude and LLM-based tools as part of daily testing workflows
  • Experiment with AI-driven testing approaches beyond scripted test cases
  • Identify issues that traditional automated regression tests may not catch
  • Continuously explore ways to improve QA efficiency through AI tooling

Engineering Collaboration

  • Work directly with frontend and backend engineers throughout the development cycle
  • Collaborate on testing requirements and critical product flows
  • Communicate test failures, bugs, and reliability issues clearly
  • Contribute to a culture where engineers trust and act on automated test results
  • Take ownership of QA improvements without relying on layers of project management

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of QA, software testing, or test automation experience preferred
  • Candidates with less experience will also be considered if they demonstrate strong automation skills and relevant hands-on experience
  • Strong TypeScript skills and the ability to write clean, maintainable test code
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright, Cypress, or a similar E2E testing framework
  • Strong understanding of web application testing
  • Understanding of DOM interaction, network requests, and asynchronous behavior
  • Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot flaky automated tests
  • Experience creating or maintaining automated regression tests
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of testing goals
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Willingness to learn and use AI tools as part of the testing workflow
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to test reliability

Nice to Have

  • Experience building E2E testing infrastructure from scratch
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI pipelines
  • Experience with test data management, parallelization, and test reporting
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright specifically
  • Experience testing complex B2B web applications
  • Experience with multi-tenant applications and role-based access
  • Experience testing multi-step workflows
  • Familiarity with Claude or other AI/LLM-based development and testing tools
  • Experience working with React applications
  • Familiarity with Sentry, GCP Stackdriver, or similar observability tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Prefer building automated testing systems over relying primarily on manual QA
  • Enjoy improving test coverage and reliability proactively
  • Can work independently from high-level goals
  • Are comfortable diagnosing problems rather than waiting for detailed instructions
  • Have strong curiosity about AI-assisted testing and emerging tools
  • Enjoy working directly with engineers in a small, fast-moving team
  • Care about building test suites that engineers genuinely trust
  • Think beyond individual test cases and consider the reliability of the overall QA system

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript — Test code
  • Playwright — E2E testing framework
  • Claude & AI tooling — AI-assisted exploratory testing
  • React — Frontend application
  • Sentry — Error monitoring
  • GCP Stackdriver — Logging and observability

  3. Final Selection & Onboarding

Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

As a Research Scientist II on the Video team, you will independently drive core research initiatives, deliver reproducible experimental results, and help translate machine learning models into real-world product solutions. In this role, you will:

  • Conduct research to develop new functionalities and improve existing technologies for real-time video processing and meeting analytics.
  • Design, implement, and evaluate deep learning algorithms related to video processing, face recognition, and video deepfake detection.
  • Design, develop, and maintain internal research packages to train and test ML models, ensuring absolute reproducibility and computational efficiency.
  • Partner closely with research engineers and engineering teams to help deploy research models and tools into production environments.
  • Participate in cross-functional team meetings, contribute to regular research and code reviews, and publish patents and peer-reviewed papers in top computer vision, audio, and speech conferences.

Who you are

  • You remain focused, persistent, and scientifically rigorous through multiple experimental iterations, navigating ambiguity in research data, quality, or shifting methodologies while continuing to make steady progress.
  • You work effectively across functional boundaries with research scientists, research engineers, and product partners, communicating research assumptions, findings, and implications with clarity.
  • You take individual ownership of assigned research projects and workstreams, making sound technical decisions using available data, theory, and rigorous experimental evidence.
  • You follow through on your commitments, communicate research progress transparently, and maintain the highest standard of technical integrity, documentation, and model reproducibility.
  • You use machine learning frameworks effectively to design, train, and evaluate models, carefully validating outputs and applying sound judgment to balance experimentation speed with robustness, compliance, and model quality.

Your skill-set

Must-Haves:

  • PhD in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence) or equivalent industry research experience.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in Deep Learning, specifically applied to computer vision, face recognition, video deepfake detection, or general machine learning.
  • Strong programming proficiency in Python with a proven ability to design, develop, and maintain research packages to train and test ML models.
  • Hands-on mastery of modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.
  • A proven track record of successful, timely project delivery and the ability to contribute to patents and peer-reviewed publications.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Functional programming experience in C/C++ or working knowledge of deployment environments using Go, TF-Lite, and TF-Micro.
  • Practical experience with real-time video processing pipelines and video data acquisition/preparation tasks.
  • Foundational domain knowledge of biometrics, identity authentication, fraud patterns, or consumer security concepts.

What’s in it for you

This is an outstanding, high-impact opportunity to join Pindrop's core Research team and work on revolutionary research ideas designed to combat sophisticated deepfake threats. In an era where synthetic media and identity manipulation are rapidly accelerating, you will work alongside some of the best and brightest technical minds in AI, security, and computer vision.

Your day-to-day contributions will directly enhance real-time communication safety and defend global enterprise systems from fraud and deception. We are intense about execution excellence, but we are also a highly collaborative team that enjoys the journey—offering a sustainable engineering culture backed by unlimited rest and continuous professional growth.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
  • One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!
  • Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer.

$160,000—$185,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

jobs.description:
Description

MEDvidi is a telepsychiatry platform delivering psychiatric evaluation, medication management, and ongoing behavioral health care to patients in approximately 35 states. We operate through a management services organization supporting affiliated professional corporations, and our clinicians treat conditions that require careful, closely governed prescribing, including controlled substances.

The work is regulated at every layer: federal controlled-substance law, state medical practice and scope-of-practice rules, health information privacy, consumer-protection and advertising rules, and payer requirements. Getting that right is not an overlay on the business. It is the business.

About the Role

We are hiring a Chief Legal Officer to own legal and regulatory strategy for the company. This is a hands-on executive role. You will be the senior legal voice on prescribing architecture, entity structure, privacy, marketing, litigation, and workforce questions, and you will do much of that work yourself while building the function around you.

The role is scoped as Chief Legal Officer only. The Chief Compliance Officer function is separately designated, so that legal strategy and compliance reporting remain distinct. We have chosen that structure deliberately, consistent with OIG and DOJ guidance on compliance program design.

Responsibilities

  • Controlled substances. Own the company's legal position on telemedicine prescribing under the Controlled Substances Act and the Ryan Haight Act; track DEA registration and rulemaking developments and state PDMP and examination requirements; and carry any agency inquiry or inspection.
  • Clinical practice regulation. Advise on fifty-state scope-of-practice, supervision, and collaborative practice requirements; clear licensure for new state markets; and set telehealth modality and consent rules.
  • Corporate structure. Draft and negotiate management services agreements, IP licenses, equity restriction and succession arrangements, and intercompany terms across the MSO and professional entities, with continuous attention to corporate practice of medicine and fee-splitting boundaries.
  • Fraud and abuse. Structure clinician, vendor, and partner arrangements under the Anti-Kickback Statute, EKRA, and Stark where applicable.
  • Privacy and security. Apply the HIPAA Privacy, Security, and Breach Notification Rules to live systems and vendors, and advise on state health privacy statutes, business associate terms, and tracking-technology and data-residency questions.
  • Marketing and consumer protection. Advise Marketing on advertising substantiation, endorsement and testimonial rules, and unfair-or-deceptive-practice standards under the FTC Act; negative-option and auto-renewal requirements; TCPA consent, timing, and revocation for SMS and outbound messaging; state medical board advertising rules for telehealth prescribing; and HIPAA constraints on tracking technologies, pixels, and campaign data.
  • AI and clinical product. Determine whether AI-enabled features constitute a regulated device (Software as a Medical Device) or fall within clinical decision support or general-wellness categories; build a defensible position under the state-by-state framework governing AI in mental-health care, including disclosure, crisis-response, and licensed-clinician-oversight requirements; and advise on AI's intersection with HIPAA, Section 1557 algorithmic nondiscrimination, and the federal FDA, FTC, and HHS framework.
  • Litigation and disputes. Set litigation strategy, select and manage outside counsel and budget, direct litigation holds, and tender insurance.
  • Workforce. Advise on clinician classification, multi-state employment compliance, separations and investigations, and executive and equity agreements.
  • Commercial and payer. Negotiate payer participation agreements and vendor contracts, own the contract playbook, and oversee billing and coding compliance.
  • Governance. Support board and committee process, maintain entities and foreign qualification, and keep the company diligence-ready.

Requirements

  • J.D. and active good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, with eligibility for in-house or registered in-house counsel status in your state of residence.
  • 12+ years of combined firm and in-house practice, including at least 5 years advising healthcare providers, digital health companies, or health systems.
  • Primary responsibility, not adjacent exposure, for controlled-substance regulatory advice, including the Ryan Haight Act telemedicine exceptions and the post-public-health-emergency landscape.
  • Direct experience drafting and negotiating MSO and friendly-PC structures, and the ability to defend that structure against a corporate practice of medicine or fee-splitting challenge.
  • HIPAA Privacy and Security Rule fluency applied to a real engineering and vendor environment, not only to policy documents.
  • Healthcare marketing and consumer-protection fluency for a direct-to-consumer business: FTC advertising and substantiation standards, TCPA, state medical board advertising rules, and HIPAA marketing constraints.
  • Ability to structure clinician and vendor compensation under the Anti-Kickback Statute and EKRA without routine outside counsel dependence.
  • Experience carrying a government inquiry, such as an agency subpoena, civil investigative demand, board action, or licensing investigation, from receipt to resolution.
  • Multi-state employment law experience, including contractor classification under both the FLSA economic realities test and state ABC tests.
  • A record of building: policies, playbooks, or a legal function stood up where none existed.

Would be a plus:

  • Prior General Counsel or Chief Legal Officer role at a healthcare company between 100 and 1,000 employees.
  • Behavioral health, psychiatry, or substance use disorder treatment experience, including 42 C.F.R. Part 2 where applicable.
  • Government service at DEA, HHS OIG, a U.S. Attorney's Office, a state Attorney General's office, or a state medical or pharmacy board.
  • Commercial payer contracting experience, particularly through a transition from cash-pay to insurance-reimbursed care.
  • Defense experience in healthcare privacy class actions, including tracking-technology claims.
  • AI governance experience across clinical tooling and vendor diligence, including Software as a Medical Device and clinical-decision-support analysis, Section 1557 algorithmic nondiscrimination, and emerging state requirements for AI in mental-health care.
  • A current point of view on the DEA and HHS telemedicine controlled-substance-prescribing landscape and the forthcoming special-registration framework.
  • Certification such as Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP) or Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC).

What we offer

  • Time off: Paid time off (PTO), plus paid sick leave.
  • Wellness: Dedicated wellness days each year to rest and recharge.
  • Retirement: 401(k) with company matching.
  • Health & insurance: QSEHRA eligibility toward medical and dental insurance coverage.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.excerpt: Position OverviewMetroSys is seeking an experienced BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) Consultant to provide ad hoc professional services supporting a client experiencing application connectivity issues involving BeyondTrust EPM and Resideo/Honeywell Compass software.
jobs.description:
Position Overview

MetroSys is seeking an experienced BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) Consultant to provide ad hoc professional services supporting a client experiencing application connectivity issues involving BeyondTrust EPM and Resideo/Honeywell Compass software.

The client currently has approximately 110 BeyondTrust EPM Desktop Cloud licenses for Windows and macOS endpoints. BeyondTrust has been implemented and was operating successfully; however, certain Windows workstations running Compass are now unable to connect to remote alarm panels despite being governed by the same BeyondTrust policies.

The consultant will be responsible for performing a cross-platform technical assessment to determine whether the issue originates from BeyondTrust EPM policies, Windows/Microsoft components, SQL/.NET dependencies, endpoint security controls, network behavior, or the Compass application itself.

This is not intended to be a traditional break/fix support role. The consultant should be capable of owning the investigation across multiple technologies, isolating the root cause, implementing or recommending remediation, and documenting appropriate BeyondTrust configuration and application-management practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review the client's existing BeyondTrust EPM Desktop Cloud configuration, policies, application rules, elevation policies, and endpoint behavior.
  • Troubleshoot Compass installation and runtime behavior across affected and functioning Windows endpoints.
  • Compare a known-working workstation against affected systems to identify differences in configuration, policy enforcement, permissions, services, registry settings, networking, and application dependencies.
  • Investigate whether BeyondTrust policies or endpoint controls are affecting or redirecting Compass communications with remote alarm panels.
  • Review application dependencies including Microsoft .NET Framework, SQL Server Express, Windows services, application permissions, and local security settings.
  • Analyze Compass outbound communications and determine whether connections are being blocked, redirected, modified, or otherwise affected by endpoint or network controls.
  • Review BeyondTrust application events, audit information, policy matches, elevation activity, and other available logs to identify potential conflicts.
  • Temporarily test or modify BeyondTrust policies in a controlled manner to isolate EPM as a potential cause without unnecessarily weakening endpoint security.
  • Coordinate troubleshooting findings with BeyondTrust, Resideo/Honeywell, Microsoft, and the client's internal IT team as appropriate.
  • Identify the root cause or provide a documented technical assessment identifying the most likely responsible component and recommended next steps.
  • Implement approved BeyondTrust configuration changes or application exceptions when required.
  • Document final configuration, troubleshooting findings, remediation steps, and recommended BeyondTrust EPM best practices.
  • Provide additional BeyondTrust professional services using a block-of-hours model as requested by the client.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) Cloud for Windows.
  • Experience creating, troubleshooting, and modifying BeyondTrust application control and privilege-management policies.
  • Strong Windows endpoint troubleshooting experience.
  • Working knowledge of Windows networking, application communications, DNS, firewall behavior, services, registry, and security controls.
  • Experience troubleshooting Windows applications dependent upon .NET Framework and Microsoft SQL Server/SQL Express.
  • Ability to analyze application behavior using Windows and network diagnostic tools.
  • Experience troubleshooting situations involving multiple vendors where the source of the issue is initially unknown.
  • Ability to independently perform discovery, testing, root-cause analysis, remediation, and technical documentation.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills and ability to coordinate with third-party vendor support teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • BeyondTrust certifications or significant BeyondTrust EPM implementation experience.
  • Experience with Resideo/Honeywell Compass, alarm-management software, building automation, or similar Windows-based operational applications.
  • Experience with Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Defender, Group Policy, or other endpoint-management/security platforms.
  • Experience troubleshooting application traffic using tools such as Wireshark, ProcMon, Event Viewer, PowerShell, or similar diagnostic utilities.

Enterprise Cybersecurity Architect

Concurrent Technologies Corporation

Remote Position – United States

As a trusted partner and leader in providing energy and sustainability consulting services to the federal government, Concurrent Technologies Corporation (CTC) understands the increasing complexity of achieving energy security and data management in a changing world. We take our role seriously, as our efforts ensure our installations and assets are prepared in any operating environment, present and future.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the OT-specific Cybersecurity Architect supporting development and deployment of the Marine Corps FRCS Enterprise Architecture.
  • Plan and coordinate a MCEN-hosted FRCS Reference Architecture leveraging SDN, SDA, and OT continuous monitoring platforms.
  • Develop and maintain the FRCS Enterprise Architecture and associated enterprise POA&Ms.
  • Create and update RASCI charts identifying roles and responsibilities of the FRCS Architecture.

  • Develop Information Papers, Decision Papers, Executive Briefs, and sustain FRCS SharePoint content.

  • Travel to Marine Corps installations to support architecture planning and cybersecurity expertise.
  • Assess security postures of OT networks, including protocol analysis (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC), segmentation, and perimeter defense.
  • Provide guidance on cybersecurity compliance for ICS/SCADA vendors and integrators.
  • Stay abreast of emerging cyber threats, attack techniques, and industry best practices in computer network defense. Assess their potential impact on the organization and make recommendations for proactive measures.
  • Participate in conferences, work groups, meetings and other required events.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Experience with RMF documentation, control implementation, POA&M development, and compliance validation.
  • Experience with software-defined networking/software defined access (SDN, SDA) and segregated OT environments.
  • Experience coordinating with multiple stakeholder organizations at the enterprise level.
  • Experience developing or maintaining MOAs/MOUs/SLAs and defining cross-functional responsibilities.
  • Experience supporting ATO processes, cybersecurity assessments, or system accreditation efforts.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional cybersecurity certifications: CISSP, CISM, CASP+, CySA+, GICSP, GSLC, or equivalent.
  • Experience developing RASCI charts or organizational governance frameworks.
  • Experience with Cybersecurity Service Provider (CSSP) operations.
  • Experience with SharePoint site design, documentation workflows, and enterprise communication products.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager E-Commerce (m/w/d) · Remote
jobs.excerpt: Das ist dein Job bei unsDu möchtest das Marketing einer Performance-Marketing-Agentur komplett verantworten?
jobs.description:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Du möchtest das Marketing einer Performance-Marketing-Agentur komplett verantworten? Eigenmarketing ist bei EVOLVE ein eigenständiges System aus Ads, Content und Brand und läuft bereits erfolgreich. Deine Aufgabe ist es, dieses System zu übernehmen, zu schärfen und weiter auszubauen. Die Fachbereiche aus Creative, Media Buying und Vertrieb stemmen die Umsetzung mit dir.

Wie dein Arbeitsalltag aussehen kann:

Du entwickelst einen Lead-Magnet für unsere Wunschzielgruppe, D2C-E-Commerce-Unternehmen, und bewirbst ihn über Ads. Kurz nach der Veröffentlichung kommen viele Eintragungen und direkt vier neue Kundenanfragen.

Du wertest aus, welche Hooks und Themen am besten performen. Nach kurzer Abstimmung, machst du daraus mehr: einen Guide für unseren YouTube-Kanal, passende LinkedIn-Beiträge, neue Ad-Konzepte für Meta Ads und eine E-Mail-Kampagne.

Wenige Tage später ist das Thema auf allen Kanälen präsent, sodass niemand an EVOLVE als ganzheitlichem Wachstumspartner vorbeikommt. Zwei Wochen später hat unser Vertriebsteam den Kalender voll mit Terminen aus genau diesem Content. Genau das ist der Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir sind einer der führenden ganzheitlichen Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote ab Tag 1. Weekly Recaps, Coffee Chats und Team-Events sorgen dafür, dass Remote bei uns kein Einzelkämpfertum bedeutet.

So funktioniert B2B-Marketing bei EVOLVE

Bei EVOLVE ist Eigenmarketing ein eigenständiges System aus Ads, Content und Branding. Du verantwortest dieses System, statt es nur auszuführen. Darunter verstehen wir:

  • Pipeline-Generierung über Ads, Content und E-Mail als ein zusammenhängendes Marketingsystem, nicht als drei getrennte

  • Aufbau der EVOLVE-Brand, um unsere Wahrnehmung als ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner in Deutschland zu stärken

  • KI-Workflows, die manuelle Abläufe ersetzen, damit deine Zeit in Konzept statt in Klickarbeit fließt. AI ersetzt bei uns niemanden. Jeder nutzt KI wie einen Junior an seiner Seite, um besser und effizienter zu arbeiten

Was dich hier erwartet

  • Strategie und Priorisierung: Du baust Brand und Agentur-Marketing als System auf, entwickelst die Strategie hinter der Pipeline-Generierung und entscheidest, was zuerst passiert

  • Content: Du entwickelst Content-Ideen und Content-Guides, schreibst LinkedIn-Posts mit und verantwortest den Contentplan über unsere Kanäle

  • Ads: Du entwickelst Ad-Konzepte und gibst zu laufenden Kampagnen Feedback. Du verantwortest das Ergebnis, nicht die Klickarbeit

  • Events und Messen: Du sorgst dafür, dass sie wirklich neue Kunden bringen

  • Projektmanagement: Du treibst alle Eigenmarketing-Projekte eigenverantwortlich voran und sorgst dafür, dass sie on time realisiert werden

  • Datenanalyse: Du bewertest alle Maßnahmen anhand der Performance-Daten und kommst aus eigener Initiative mit dem nächsten Schritt für mehr qualifizierte Anfragen zur Geschäftsführung

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Diese Rolle gibt es bei EVOLVE nur einmal. Du steuerst und koordinierst, produzierst aber nicht alles selbst. Bei der Umsetzung bekommst du Unterstützung aus mehreren Fachbereichen, von Creative und Copywriting über Media Buying bis zum Vertrieb. Du orchestrierst diese Ressourcen.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Du hast schon einmal eine Media- oder Personal-Brand mitaufgebaut und dort einen Kanal oder Funnel komplett verantwortet.

  • 2 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance- oder Growth-Marketing, in der du auf Pipeline, Leads oder Umsatz gesteuert hast. Nicht auf Reichweite und Follower

  • Du hast ein Gespür für Direct Response. Du siehst einem Hook an, ob er zieht, noch bevor die erste Zahl reinkommt

  • Du denkst in ganzen Funnels, von der ersten Content-Idee bis zum qualifizierten Termin.

  • Du willst selbst bestimmen, was gemacht wird, statt nach Briefing zu arbeiten

  • Du arbeitest AI native mit Claude, Gemini oder vergleichbaren Modellen. Du nutzt eigene Prompts und Systeme, nicht nur zu Recherche, sondern, um die Effizienz deiner Arbeit zu steigern.

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Zweimal jährlich Team-Events und Workations, in Person und an wechselnden Orten

  • Wöchentliche Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats, damit Remote nicht heißt, den ganzen Tag allein zu arbeiten

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Steuerfreier Sachbezug von 50 € monatlich als Gutschein deiner Wahl

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

So läuft der Prozess

Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR. Es geht um gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, zusammen mit der Geschäftsführung.

Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, menschlich und fachlich.

Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.

Wie lange das dauert: Wir legen Wert auf einen schnellen Bewerbungsprozess. Zwischen den einzelnen Schritten liegen nur wenige Tage. Wenn du parallel in anderen Prozessen bist, sag uns Bescheid. Dann richten wir uns danach.

Deine Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Die ersten zwei Monate. Einarbeitung in laufende Kampagnen, Contentplan und Systeme. Du entwickelst bereits erste Ideen, Content Pieces und Ads, die wir wenig später antesten.

Mittelfristig. Vollständig eigenständige Verantwortung für Pipeline-Generierung und Brand-Aufbau.

Langfristig. Du verantwortest das gesamte Eigenmarketing von EVOLVE. Das umfasst nicht nur die Unternehmens- und Arbeitgebermarke, sondern auch Personal-Brands von Mitarbeitenden aus dem Team. Du bringst die gesamte Außenwahrnehmung auf ein neues Level.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking an experienced Technical Lead to guide the design, development, and delivery of an enterprise-scale, accessible digital platform for a federal government client. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with day-to-day client engagement, driving architecture decisions across WordPress, Drupal, and Salesforce, and API implementations that support these and other business functions, while mentoring a cross-functional delivery team.

You will work closely with the Project Manager, product owners, designers, and fellow engineers to mature and modernize the platform, ensuring every release meets rigorous accessibility, security, and performance standards. In close collaboration with the Project Manager, you will lead and engage the client – bringing technical judgement, translating complex technical tradeoffs into clear, confident conversations that build trust and keep delivery on track.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss or demonstrate relevant project experience during the interview process.You will have the opportunity to join a project that directly supports Bixal’s mission of improving how government serves people.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

This is a full-time role with a salary range of $135,000 – $155,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership

  • Lead architecture and implementation decisions across WordPress, Drupal, and Salesforce, along with API design and integration work connecting these systems.

  • Guide the team in maturing legacy and evolving platforms into modern, enterprise-grade, scalable systems.

  • Set and enforce coding standards, review architecture and code, and drive continuous improvement of technical practices.

  • Ensure development and design work meets accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG 2.1) across the platform.

  • Partner with DevSecOps and infrastructure teams to maintain secure, reliable, well-documented systems.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

  • Supporting the Project Manager as the technical point of contact, communicating complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Build and maintain trusted, collaborative relationships with client stakeholders, project sponsors, and cross-functional partners.

  • Lead release planning and prioritization by listening to stakeholder input, bringing a clear vision for the solution, and guiding the team toward scope, sequence, and tradeoffs that move the platform forward.

  • Represent the team in client meetings, technical reviews, and planning sessions with polish and confidence, proactively surfacing risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to keep the client informed and engaged.

  • Demonstrated ability to build genuine rapport with clients and stakeholders, remaining calm, positive, and collaborative under pressure.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide day-to-day technical leadership and mentorship to a cross-functional team of engineers and designers.

  • Foster a collaborative, high-performing team culture grounded in accountability and continuous learning.

  • Guide the team through iterative delivery.

Delivery & Quality

  • Develop the technical roadmap collaboratively with the Project Manager, and contribute to its presentation in client and planning sessions.

  • Drive quality through code reviews, automated testing, and adherence to secure development practices.

  • Identify and resolve technical risks, bottlenecks, and technical debt before they impact delivery.

  • Support other technical and delivery activities as needed to keep the platform on track.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree plus at least five (5) years of relevant professional experience in software development or technical leadership; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • At least five (5) years leading or performing on contracts/projects of similar size, scope, and complexity.

  • Experience migrating or consolidating content management platforms, including hands-on work with WordPress and Drupal - theming, custom module/plugin development, and content architecture.

  • Proven experience designing, building, and integrating RESTful APIs across multiple systems and platforms.

  • Experience evaluating and integrating third-party plugins, extensions, and commercial solutions to extend platform capabilities, with sound judgement about when an existing tool meets the need versus when custom development is warranted

  • Demonstrated experience working within enterprise environments and maturing or modernizing existing platforms.

  • Strong understanding of accessible development and design practices (Section 508, WCAG 2.1).

  • Proven track record leading technical teams, with strong mentorship and team-building skills.

  • Polished, confident communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting to and building relationships with clients and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

    This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience developing for federal government clients or in a federal consulting environment.

  • Experience with Salesforce, including configuration, customization, and integration with external systems.

  • Cloud platform (AWS, Azure,) certifications.

  • Experience with DevSecOps practices in compliance-driven environments.

  • Knowledge of FISMA, FedRAMP, or other federal security frameworks.

  • Experience with content management system migrations or platform modernization efforts.

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About the role:

As a Talent Acquisition Scheduler, you’ll play a critical role in delivering a seamless and engaging experience for both candidates and hiring teams. Working closely with Talent Acquisition Partners, hiring managers, and interview teams, you’ll coordinate interviews across multiple time zones and business functions, ensuring every stage of the hiring process runs smoothly. Your organisation, attention to detail, and commitment to exceptional service will help us attract and secure top talent while creating a positive candidate experience.

What you'll do:

  • Coordinate and schedule interviews across multiple teams, locations, and time zones.
  • Manage interview logistics, including calendar invitations, meeting links, room bookings, and travel arrangements where required.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process.
  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition Partners and hiring managers to ensure efficient interview scheduling and resolution of calendar conflicts.
  • Maintain accurate candidate and interview data within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  • Monitor interview activity and proactively identify and address scheduling challenges.
  • Deliver a high-quality candidate experience through timely, professional, and inclusive communication.
  • Assist with recruitment reporting and scheduling metrics.Identify opportunities to improve recruitment coordination processes and operational efficiency.

About you:

  • Previous experience in recruitment coordination, talent acquisition, scheduling, HR administration, or a similar support role.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven experience coordinating complex calendars and scheduling across multiple stakeholders and time zones.
  • Excellent communication skills with a professional and candidate-centric approach.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Microsoft Office tools, particularly Outlook, Teams, and Excel.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to confidently navigate scheduling challenges.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and colleagues at all levels.
  • Comfortable handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Passion for creating exceptional candidate and stakeholder experiences.

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.
We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy noticebefore applying to Avalere Health.

Role Overview: The Bookkeeper & Administrative Officer is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing payroll and compliance obligations, overseeing job scheduling within MyTrucking, and ensuring contractor and customer billing accuracy. Daily Duties

  • Manage all incoming emails, filing, and organisation of correspondence.
  • Send invoices and attachments to Xero and maintain accurate financial records.

Weekly Duties

  • Calculate weekly fuel levy using the AIP diesel price calculator.
  • Process accounts payable and pay weekly bills.

    • Matching set-rate kilometres with schedules
    • Verifying manifest numbers in MyTrucking
    • Ensuring correct contractor business names are assigned

    • Produce Billing Hours spreadsheet each Friday
    • Generate weekly invoice in Xero

    • Employee wages
    • Superannuation
    • PAYG tax
    • Loan schedule monitoring and repayment reminders
  • Communicate with drivers/contractors to correct job entries, obtain PODs, and resolve discrepancies.

Monthly Duties

  • Complete BAS transaction reconciliations.
  • Prepare and lodge monthly BAS statements.
  • Calculate On-Road Diesel Fuel Rebate and track eligible vs non-eligible litres.
  • Review and manage loan repayment rules in Xero.
  • Conduct monthly financial checks and reconciliations.
  • Monitor PAYG and IAS obligations.
  • 4. Annual Duties
  • Reconcile rateable remuneration for WorkCover.
  • Calculate and confirm WorkCover premium requirements.
  • Assist with annual payroll and financial compliance queries.
  • Complete TAR reporting to the ATO via Xero.

MyTrucking System Responsibilities (Ongoing)

  • Maintain and update MyTrucking software for all transport operations except Duk.
  • Update fuel levy within MyTrucking for accurate job costing.
  • Manage customer information, new accounts, and portal access.

  • Review, issue, and email finalised invoices.
  • Maintain customer rate schedules, fuel levies, and contract-specific pricing.
  • Maintain operational templates including spreadsheets, Hours Worked sheets, and job templates.

Award & Compliance Responsibilities

  • Maintain and apply award conditions for:
    • Road Transport (Long Distance Operations) Award 2020
    • Road Transport and Distribution Award 2020
  • Ensure correct pay rates, penalties, allowances, overtime rules, and entitlements.
  • Monitor Fair Work updates and adjust payroll settings accordingly.
  • Maintain payroll compliance across all contracts and employee classifications.
  • Maintain documentation and evidence for audit or compliance review.
  • Maintain payroll categories, allowances, penalty rates, and award-specific pay items in Xero.
  • Monitor superannuation clearing house submissions and resolve errors.

General & As-Needed Responsibilities

  • Maintain accuracy across all financial, payroll, contractor, and job scheduling records.
  • Maintain Chart of Accounts and Xero settings, rules, and account structure.

  • Provide administrative and operational support to management.
  • Ensure timely communication with contractors, employees, and external partners.

  • Strong bookkeeping and financial administration skills.

  • Proficiency in Xero, MyTrucking, ComBank, and Microsoft Office/OneDrive.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

Position Summary

The Account Executive – MI Clarity is responsible for driving awareness, adoption, and utilization of MI Clarity, an AI-powered prognostic assay designed to assess both early and late distant recurrence risk in postmenopausal patients with HR-positive/HER2-negative, node-negative early-stage breast cancer.

The Account Executive will partner with oncologists, breast surgeons, pathologists, nurse navigators, and healthcare systems to educate stakeholders on the clinical value of the test, integrate the assay into clinical workflows, and increase appropriate utilization.

This role requires a strong understanding of oncology, breast cancer treatment pathways, molecular diagnostics, and value-based clinical conversations. Success is measured through account engagement, clinician adoption, testing utilization, and long-term strategic growth.

Job Responsibilities

  • Educate healthcare providers and care teams on the clinical utility, prognostic value, and evidence supporting MI Clarity, including its ability to identify both early and late distant recurrence risk in eligible breast cancer patients.

  • Present clinical data, validation studies, and evidence-based insights, while explaining the differentiation of AI-driven pathology analysis from traditional genomic and molecular assays.

  • Conduct in-person and virtual educational programs and lead consultative, evidence-based discussions on risk stratification, treatment planning, extended endocrine therapy considerations, and opportunities to reduce overtreatment and undertreatment.

  • Position MI Clarity as a clinical decision-support tool that optimizes patient care, addressing questions related to assay performance, patient selection, workflow integration, turnaround time, and clinical interpretation.

  • Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans to drive awareness, adoption, and utilization of MI Clarity.

  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including medical oncologists, breast surgeons, pathologists, advanced practice providers, nurse navigators, health system administrators, and other clinical decision-makers.

  • Identify and engage key opinion leaders, decision-makers, and clinical champions within target accounts to support adoption and long-term utilization.

  • Support implementation of testing workflows and operational integration within healthcare systems and clinical practices.

  • Analyze territory and account performance data to identify growth opportunities, monitor utilization and adoption trends, and develop targeted engagement strategies.

  • Maintain accurate CRM documentation, forecasting, and account activity records.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, and other internal teams to support customer success and business objectives.

  • Ensure all activities are conducted in compliance with company policies, healthcare regulations, and industry standards, maintaining accurate, balanced, and approved clinical and promotional communications.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; life sciences or healthcare-related field preferred.

  • Strong understanding of breast cancer treatment pathways and oncology terminology.

  • Proven ability to build relationships with healthcare providers and health systems.

  • Excellent presentation, communication, and consultative selling skills.

  • Ability to interpret and communicate clinical data.

  • Ability to travel within assigned territory.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling oncology diagnostics or precision medicine solutions.

  • Existing relationships within oncology or breast centers.

  • Experience launching new products or assays.

  • Familiarity with pathology workflows and digital pathology.

  • Knowledge of prognostic and predictive breast cancer assays.

  • Provider engagement and educational activity

  • Successful workflow implementation within target accounts

  • Territory growth and market penetration

  • CRM accuracy and activity execution

Physical Demands

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods.

Additional Information

jobs.description:
About Balto

Balto is a fast-growing leader in the AI Contact Center with a heavy emphasis on delivering amazing customer experiences. As a small, dynamic team, we rely on efficient processes and data-driven decisions to fuel our continued growth.

Our Culture: We’re AI Obsessed

We’re building an AI company, and we expect everyone at Balto to think like an AI operator.

No matter your role, you should use AI to work smarter, move faster, and find better ways to solve problems.

We expect you to:

  • Use AI every day to improve your productivity and impact.
  • Build automations, GPTs, or agentic workflows that eliminate repetitive work.
  • Apply AI to make faster, smarter decisions.
  • Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and turn them into practical business advantages.
  • Challenge existing workflows by asking, “Why does a human still do this?”

If AI isn’t already a core part of how you work—or something you’re excited to adopt—Balto probably isn’t the right place.

If it is, you’ll be surrounded by people who think the same way.

Why Balto

  • Fully remote team — work from anywhere in the US
  • Mission-driven culture with smart, supportive, and AI-obsessed teammates
  • Great benefits: healthcare, 401(k), unlimited PTO, learning stipends, and more

Assessment Process

Our hiring process includes virtual interviews designed to evaluate your problem-solving ability, strategic thinking, and communication skills and a skills test.

Full-Time, Remote, U.S. Only

The Role

We are seeking a Technical Support Engineer to join our Support team. In this role, you will serve as the primary internal escalation point for Support's most complex, multi-part customer issues, owning them from investigation through resolution, and acting as the buffer between Support and Engineering so that only genuinely engineering-level problems consume engineering time.

What You’ll Own

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for the Support team's Technical Success Specialists (TSS) on cases that exceed T1/T2 complexity
  • Investigate and diagnose complex technical issues: integration failures, connector/softphone problems, platform behavior that doesn't match documentation
  • Own multi-part enterprise escalations end-to-end: track every open thread, assign next steps, keep the customer and internal stakeholders informed, and close the loop. This is a project-management function as much as a technical one.
  • Filter and package what actually reaches Engineering: confirm an issue meets escalation criteria (regression signal, multi-org symptom, confirmed defect, etc.) before it consumes engineering time, and make sure what does get escalated arrives with the diagnostic groundwork already done
  • Troubleshooting complex integration/softphone issues, and act as a technical consultant on networking, firewall, and connectivity questions
  • Help maintain the technical documentation and runbooks that let the tier 1/tier 2 support team resolve more on its own over time
  • Partner directly with Engineering (including the existing tier-2 escalation path) and Implementation Managers as a peer, not just a hand-off

What We’re Looking For

Skills & Requirements

  • 2-3 years in a technical support, support engineering, or technical escalation role
  • Knowledge areas:
    • networking, firewalls, and VPNs;
    • softphone or CCaaS integrations;
    • log/observability tooling (Datadog or equivalent);
    • basic code literacy (Python, JSON, HTML/CSS/JS) to understand integration behavior;
    • Salesforce Service Console or equivalent case-management tooling
  • Demonstrated ownership of ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems through to resolution
  • Strong project-management ownership: experience holding multiple open threads, knowing when to escalate vs. keep driving
  • Support case triage: experience owning problems within support’s wheelhouse, but determining when it needs additional resources
  • Demonstrated experience using different AI tools and a general understanding of prompting
  • An exceptional written and verbal communicator, with experience communicating complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • A critical thinker with the capacity to understand a complex technical problem
  • Self-motivated, detail-attentive, and able to continuously learn

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in a tier-2/tier-3 support or technical escalation role, ideally in a SaaS or contact-center technology environment
  • Familiarity with CCaaS platforms

Balto's Values

  • Anchor on success: We set goals that align with success, and don’t settle for “good enough.”
  • Love every customer: We care for and appreciate our customers, no matter their size, industry, or sophistication.
  • Talk things out: We assume positive intent in others, talk through disagreements, and create open lines of communication across departments and levels.
  • Start with gratitude: We stay humble, recognize others, and make the most of everything.
  • Always be growing: We never stop learning. We seek to be a force of growth for ourselves and others.
  • Own the work: We are drivers who seek to fix things and push forward towards the solution. We don’t wait for problems to solve themselves.
