jobs.description:
Rockstar is recruiting for an innovative edtech company dedicated to transforming how schools develop and manage their schedules. This client was founded by former educators who experienced firsthand the challenges of school scheduling and set out to build a solution that saves time, unlocks resources, and aligns with the unique priorities of each school. Their platform leverages AI optimization and is supported by a team deeply familiar with the needs of school-based and central office staff.

Who They Are

This company was founded to build the tool its founders wished they had when working in schools—aiming to save hundreds of hours of wasted time while helping schools develop better schedules that enable their academic, budget, and staffing priorities. The solution addresses the needs of school-based employees who build schedules and central office employees who need visibility into them.

The school schedule reflects values and priorities. With 75 to 90% of a district budget dedicated to personnel, there are few questions more paramount than how staff and students spend their time every day, what positions are needed, how many teachers to hire, and how students will interact with them. Strategic resource allocation across schools, proper access to core courses and electives, and dedicated support to sub-groups begins with the development of a school schedule.

This company provides a home for secondary scheduling featuring AI optimization and support from a team of former educators who know and have lived scheduling. Not only does the platform save time and headache, it unlocks resources so district and charter leaders can build a schedule that aligns with their vision.

About the Role

As a School Success Manager, the selected candidate will be at the forefront of the mission to help schools create more effective, equitable, efficient, and innovative schedules. This role works directly with school partners, guiding them through the entire scheduling process and ensuring they maximize the benefits of the platform and support model.

Role & Responsibilities

The School Success Manager role leads all aspects of the customer-facing support model.

Own a portfolio of schools

  • Own and manage a portfolio of district and charter school partners through the customer journey
  • Provide end-to-end support to finalize schedules; this will require problem-solving through complicated constraints and unique school needs
  • Develop strategic relationships with key stakeholders including lead schedulers, principals, district leaders, and other members of the scheduling teams
  • Track success metrics for each partner, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and renewal rates
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to district and school-based teams to ensure their schedule aligns to their unique priorities

Lead implementations

  • Drive the end-to-end implementation process for each partner across a portfolio of schools
  • Lead onboarding and training for new and returning partners
  • Support the data integration process by collaborating with partners’ IT teams and the data integration team, owning aspects of the data transfer process (e.g., appropriately structuring data files for upload into the app)
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues as the external representative of the company, with support from the product & engineering team
  • Communicate and coordinate cross-functionally across sales & marketing and product & engineering teams to share customer feedback and relevant insights into implementation that will improve sales, product, and overall solution

Support sales and general operations

  • As a young company, the School Success team contributes to sales efforts in the scheduling “off-season,” including joining sales pitches, leading product demos, answering questions from prospective school partners, and liaising with schools through the procurement and contracting process
  • Pitch in wherever and whenever is needed to contribute to team success

Be part of the brain trust to build a lasting and valuable company

  • The small and quick-moving team is committed to both impact and financial success, and this role works hand-in-hand with leaders across functional areas in making and implementing major decisions that determine the company’s future

What They Are Looking For in Candidates

The role requires someone with:

  • Meaningful experience developing middle and/or high school schedules
  • Willingness to roll up sleeves and work in a scrappy environment

The following additional experiences would also be a plus:

  • Customer success or related experience – experience building systems/processes; consistently delivering support to people and teams so they can achieve their goals
  • Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth entrepreneurial environment

Who You Are

  • An experienced scheduler: Someone who has lived secondary scheduling and ideally has at least 3 years of experience building and owning a middle and/or high school schedule
  • A “school person”: Has worked at least 5 years inside a school, understands the operations and culture of schools, and identifies as such
  • Detail-oriented: Meticulously reviews schedules, slides, and other related documents with critical attention to detail
  • Strategic: Able to take in many different signals, cut through the noise, and deliver for district/CMO and school partners
  • Efficient: Excited to build an impactful product in a lean environment, able to handle multiple priorities, tasks, and requests at the same time
  • Collaborative: Experienced working across cross-functional teams and comfortable in an environment requiring constant collaboration with other colleagues
  • Passionate about schools: Driven to improve how schools operate and help them use their most precious resources – time, money, and talent – to best serve students

Benefits Offered

  • Health: medical, dental, vision, and a contribution-only 401(k) plan

jobs.description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.
As a DevOps Engineer, you will assist the development team in building infrastructure to support production of the sequencer software, as well as build tooling for the deployment of test networks.

  • Assisting with CI/CD pipelines and general code management practices
  • Develop and maintenance of tooling for deployment of Espresso Systems services

  • Experience with Terraform or other similar declarative cloud operations technologies
  • Comfort working in the Linux command line

Preferred

  • Experience with Ansible, AWS container orchestration, Docker, Github Actions, Nix, Rust, and Terraform

Benefits

  • Work alongside the brightest minds in the crypto space
  • Competitive salary + equity package

  • Top-tier health, dental, and vision coverage for US employees

We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. At Wipfli, people count.

At Wipfli, our people are core to everything we do—the catalyst behind our ability to create exceptional impact and extraordinary results.

We believe in flexibility. We focus on relationships. We encourage each individual to follow their own path.

People truly matter and they feel it. For those looking to make a difference and find a professional home, Wipfli offers a career-defining opportunity.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage tax compliance engagements in accordance with firm and professional standards, within budget and deadline expectations
  • Plan and schedule tax engagements with clients and firm resources
  • Serve as the main tax point of contact within our firm for clients
  • Tax Manager is responsible for clients receiving proactive communication and timely service
  • Perform detailed reviews of tax work papers and provision calculations completed by other associates
  • Review tax returns, tax research, tax communications, and other requested deliverables
  • Communicate proactively with clients and engagement partners regarding project status, client service opportunities, and other significant matters in a timely manner
  • Provide training, direction, and supervision to staff and senior accountants
  • Participate in and provide leadership for firm initiatives and projects
  • Maintain technical expertise in various tax areas related to industry specialization

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Qualifications:

  • Requires a Bachelors Degree in Accounting or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • CPA certification required in the respective state in which they are practicing
  • Requires at 5+ years of job related experience
  • High Net Worth Individual tax experience required
  • Requires prior accounting and/or tax experience
  • Subject matter leader in similar accounting and/or tax services
  • Management and/or mentoring experience with other staff members
  • Experience making recommendations to management
  • Prior public accounting experience desired

Amanda Feltner, from our recruiting team, will be guiding you through this process. Visit her LinkedIn page to connect!

Additional Details

Additional Details:

Wipfli is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All candidates will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identify, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristics protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Wipfli is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, interview, or participate in our recruiting process, please send us an email at

Wipfli values fair, transparent, and competitive compensation, considering each candidate's unique skills and experiences. The estimated base pay range for this role is $106,000 to $160,000, with offers typically not made at the maximum, allowing for future salary increases. The actual salary at the time of offer depends on business related factors like location, skills, experience, training/education, licensure, certifications, business needs, current associate pay, and relevant employment laws.

Individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, subject to participation rules and based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual and Firm performance.

Wipfli cares about our associates and offers a variety of benefits to support their well-being. Highlights include 8 health plan options (both HMO & PPO plans), dental and vision coverage, opportunity to enroll in HSA with potential Firm contribution and an Employee Assistance Program. Other benefits include firm-sponsored basic life and short and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) savings plan & profit share as well as Firm matching contribution, well-being incentive, education & certification assistance, flexible time off, family care leave, parental leave, family formation benefits, cell phone reimbursement, and travel rewards. Voluntary benefit offerings include critical illness & accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, legal, long-term care, pet insurance, ID theft protection, and supplemental life/AD&D. Eligibility for all benefits programs is dependent on annual hours expectation, position status/level and location.

"Wipfli" is the brand name under which Wipfli LLP and Wipfli Advisory LLC and its respective subsidiary entities provide professional services. Wipfli LLP and Wipfli Advisory LLC (and its respective subsidiary entities) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. Wipfli LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients, and Wipfli Advisory LLC provides tax and business consulting services to its clients. Wipfli Advisory LLC and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Account Manager - Appraisals
Company: Snapsheet
Job Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-time

About Snapsheet: Snapsheet is claims technology the way it should be: purposeful, precise, and designed to deliver outcomes. Where others bolt things on, we engineer them in to our core systems and processes across cloud-based claims management, virtual vehicle appraisals, and elite loss and recovery services. Trusted by over 170+ P&C Carriers, MGAs, MGUs, TPAs, and logistics companies, our open architecture is built to fit how our companies work, not the other way around.

What you’ll get:

  • Remote working environment - your new commute is however long it takes to walk to your desk!
  • Flexibility - empathy is ingrained in who we are and we are happy to offer a flexible PTO policy, casual dress code, and more!
  • Development - Mentorship programs, 1-on-1 management, promote when ready culture, quarterly internal promotion opportunities, and goal setting sessions.
  • Fun - Celebrations just because, yearly in-person and remote events, Snapsheet Swag, Employee Resource Groups, and more!

Job Overview:

In this role, you will manage and nurture relationships with target clients, acting as a strategic partner to optimize Snapsheet’s Appraisal Service. You’ll develop and execute account plans, identify revenue opportunities, and collaborate with internal teams to introduce new products. Additionally, you will lead client communications, analyze usage data, and ensure low-usage customers receive necessary training for optimal product utilization. Your expertise will drive user and enterprise adoption while providing clients with valuable insights and results.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the relationships with target clients
  • Build and execute account plans for your assigned accounts by understanding key decision makers, org charts, product utilization and new revenue opportunity
  • Act as a strategic partner to your clients - deeply understanding where opportunities and friction exists and by partnering with them to implement or tune Snapsheet’s offering.
  • Act as a SME for the Snapsheet Appraisal Service offering understanding where and how we drive value for each customer.
  • Collaborate with internal Stakeholders to introduce new products to existing clients where applicable.
  • Manage ongoing client communication including regularly scheduled meetings/calls and provide exceptional follow up, written reports and presentation.
  • Analyze and develop strategies to increase user-level and enterprise-wide adoption
  • Review learning and education plans to ensure customers with low usage are provided with additional training/education to fully optimize usage of Snapsheet Products
  • Document communication with users and accounts accurately and in a timely manner via system tools. Ensure that issues are escalated appropriately to appropriate internal departments and management
  • Regularly review and analyze data identifying the most relevant and impactful quantitative results to add value and insight to your clients business.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years in sales or account management within the insurance industry
  • Strong understanding of auto insurance claims
  • Demonstrated success building and maintaining client relationships, delivering results, and anticipating roadblocks
  • Track record of communicating compelling value propositions and educating customers on new technology and services
  • Experience implementing internal process improvements
  • Strong data analysis and reporting skills
  • Proficiency with Salesforce
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Willingness to travel as needed

Preferred

  • Experience in claims operations
  • Background in insurtech, insurance carriers, or fintech

We’re Built to Grow With You – And That Starts With How We Support You

At Snapsheet, we know that growth doesn’t happen in a vacuum—it’s fueled by the right support at the right time. That’s why we’ve built a benefits experience designed to grow with you, wherever life takes you.

Comprehensive Benefits for Every Stage of Life:

  • Choose from 2 robust medical plans through Blue Cross Blue Shield—plus, we contribute to your HSA when you enroll in our high-deductible health plan.
  • Offer two dental plans and one vision plan to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Peace of mind with company-paid Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance.
  • Additional protection through voluntary benefits like Accident Insurance, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness, and Legal Assistance.
  • 401(k) with a 4% company match—because your future is worth investing in.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with 6 sessions per life incident to support your mental well-being.

Perks That Make Growing Here Even Better:

  • Flexible PTO and 7.5 company-observed holidays to recharge on your terms.
  • In-person connection points throughout the year including our annual Summit and Roadshows.
  • Snapsheet SWAG and surprise mailers to keep the spirit alive.
  • Endless opportunity to shape your path—career growth, learning, and real impact are all within reach.
  • Health and wellness campaigns that evolve with you year over year.

Compensation that Grows with You

For this position, the base salary range is $85,000-105,000 plus annual bonus incentives. While this range serves as a guideline, your actual compensation will reflect your unique experience and skill set.

At Snapsheet, we believe growth should be rewarded—our compensation and benefits are built to evolve with you as your career does.

We are currently unable to accept applications for candidates who reside in the following states: Alaska, California, Hawaii, Montana, New York, North Dakota, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Wyoming.

*Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas for this position at this time.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Snapsheet, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways.

Snapsheet is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or accommodations, please let us know by emailing .

Snapsheet is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Snapsheet is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.excerpt: Advance your legal career with a firm where innovation meets legacy.
jobs.description:
Advance your legal career with a firm where innovation meets legacy. LOGS Legal Group LLP—a pioneer in creditors’ rights law for nearly 50 years - is seeking an Associate Attorney to join our Tennessee Litigation team. Step into a role where you’ll collaborate with industry leaders, leverage cutting-edge technology, and help shape the future of creditors’ rights law.

  • JOB TITLE: Associate Attorney
  • BUSINESS UNIT: Legal
  • LOCATION: Remote
  • TRAVEL REQUIRED: Court Related
  • POSITION REPORTS TO: Managing Attorney
  • POSITION TYPE: (FLSA) Full- Time Exempt, Professional

WHO WE ARE

The LOGS Employee: Our team is built on a rich blend of experience and fresh perspective- from those launching their careers to seasoned professionals who’ve grown alongside our company. We value individuals who are passionate about progress and who bring unique ideas to the table. At LOGS, we foster a collaborative, inclusive, and technology-driven environment where innovation is not only encouraged but also expected. As we integrate artificial intelligence and digital tools into our daily operations, we seek team members who are excited to grow with us and help shape the future of legal services.

Our Core Values (What We Look For):

At LOGS, we live by core values that emphasize integrity, innovation, teamwork, and results. We celebrate fresh perspectives and value every team member’s contribution — whether you’re new to law or a seasoned pro. You’ll work with a smart, collaborative team that embraces change and leads with solutions.

We believe that how we work is just as important as what we do. Across all roles at LOGS, we look for team members who embody these values in every interaction and every task:

  • Highly Focused on Results – You’re responsive, efficient, detail-oriented, and driven to meet goals.
  • Understand the Value of Reputation – You’re accountable, professional, and value our reputation.
  • “We” Focused – You collaborate with respect, humility, and a team-first mindset.
  • Drive to Innovate – You adapt, grow, and seek continuous improvement.

These values aren’t just words - they shape our culture and our success.

What We Offer:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • HSA with quarterly employer contributions
  • Group Life insurance
  • Supplemental Life Insurance plans
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Paid Time Off(PTO) and paid holidays
  • Legal services and telehealth benefits
  • National discount programs
  • Opportunities to grow your practice and expand licensure across states

Tools & Tech:

We’re tech-forward and provide tools to support that, including Microsoft Office Suite and cloud-based legal platforms.

What You’ll Do:

The Associate Attorney provides comprehensive legal representation across all firm practice areas, including foreclosure, bankruptcy, litigation, and related matters. Working collaboratively with experienced attorneys and supported by a skilled operational team under the guidance of a managing attorney, this role offers the opportunity to develop a well-rounded legal skill set.

As our Associate Attorney for Litigation, you will:

  • Represent financial institutions in foreclosure, bankruptcy, replevin, and related court proceedings.
  • Manage case workflow and ensure compliance with client requirements, laws, and court rules.
  • Draft and review motions, pleadings, and correspondence.
  • Attend court hearings both in-person and virtually.
  • Provide legal oversight and collaborate with support staff.
  • Deliver responsive, client-focused legal services in a high-volume practice.

What You Bring:

  • Licensed in Tennessee (required)
  • 3+ years of litigation experience preferred (all qualified applicants considered).
  • Experience working in a role that focuses on litigation.
  • Strong legal writing, communication, and analytical skills.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and driven.
  • Preferred: Multi-state licensure, bankruptcy or collections experience, federal licensure.

Location/Travel:

  • Location: Remote
  • Travel: Court-related travel may be required

Ready to apply? Join a forward-thinking firm where your ideas are welcome and your impact is real.

Our firm is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. All applicants applying for U.S. job openings must be authorized to work in the United States. If you require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate same when responding to this posting. This employer participates in E-Verify. All newly hired employees are required to complete the I-9 form and provide documentation of identity and work eligibility.

jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

This hands-on delivery role within the Modern Apps practice focuses on building software: designing, writing, testing, debugging, and deploying production-quality code within client engagements. The ideal candidate brings strong coding ability, sound engineering habits, a growing sense of technical judgment, and a passion for delivering high-quality software faster through effective use of AI-assisted development tools.

Technical Consultants own defined features, components, and small workstreams end to end. They operate with day-to-day independence while working inside the technical direction set by a Senior or Principal Technical Consultant, and are trusted contributors on delivery teams building and modernizing web applications, mobile applications, APIs, functions, and related platform services.

In Modern Apps, this role is especially well suited to engineers who are excited about AI-native software delivery. Candidates should be productive daily users of tools such as Claude Code and have experience using AI to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and other parts of the software development lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

    • Deliver hands-on development across greenfield and brownfield application engagements

    • Design, write, test, debug, and deploy production-quality code across modern application stacks

    • Own defined features, components, and small workstreams from implementation through delivery with limited supervision

    • Write and maintain automated tests, and validate that delivered work meets functional, performance, and security expectations

    • Participate in code reviews as both author and reviewer, giving useful feedback on correctness, readability, and maintainability

    • Use AI-assisted development tools daily for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test creation, and documentation

    • Extend AI into supporting SDLC activities such as test coverage, engineering documentation, story refinement, and technical research

    • Review and verify AI-generated output before committing it rather than accepting results at face value

    • Produce component-level and feature-level designs and document them clearly for the team and the client

    • Apply established design patterns correctly and recognize common anti-patterns in implementation-level work

    • Coach Associate and Senior Associate Technical Consultants through pairing, code review feedback, and day-to-day guidance

    • Own the quality, timeline, and handoffs for assigned work, and raise risks and blockers early

    • Serve as a dependable point of contact for client project-team stakeholders, and present and defend your work in customer sessions

Qualifications:

    • working proficiency in a second: Java, C#, JavaScript, or Python

    • Demonstrated ability to write, test, debug, and deliver production-quality code with limited supervision

    • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery practices

    • Practical experience with automated testing and testing strategies for reliable, production-ready code

    • Working knowledge of design patterns and anti-patterns, with the ability to produce component-level and feature-level design artifacts

    • Experience building or modernizing applications, APIs, and cloud-native services using modern development frameworks and DevOps practices

    • Working knowledge of security, CI/CD, source control practices, and operational basics such as logging and monitoring

    • Proficiency with AI development tools, especially Claude Code; experience with Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Continue.dev, and similar tools is valued

    • Ability to apply prompting, context management, and output validation, and to use AI beyond coding for test creation, documentation, and technical research

    • Ability to work independently on defined scope, manage competing priorities, and know when to escalate ambiguous or high-risk decisions

    • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical work to client project-team stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Consulting or professional services background in custom application development or modernization

    • Experience contributing to modernization of legacy or brownfield applications

    • Experience with messaging, event-streaming, or integration technologies

    • Experience across more than one delivery pattern, such as web, mobile, API, integration, or serverless

    • Relevant cloud platform certifications

    • Experience coaching or onboarding junior engineers

    • Community involvement such as writing, internal enablement, or meetup participation

Why AHEAD:

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

India Employment Benefits include:

Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents
Paid time off and company holidays, along with additional leave benefits as per policy
Flexible work arrangements, supporting work-life balance
Learning and development opportunities to support continuous growth and upskilling
Employee wellness initiatives and programs focused on physical and mental well-being
Retirement and statutory benefits in line with India regulations
Inclusive and people-first culture, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

jobs.description:
About Us

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software.

We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations.

Job Description

This is a remote position.

Team: Engineering – Platform Consulting

About ElitevoraSys

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software. We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations. Our work blends clean architecture, practical engineering, and a startup mindset.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help expand WorkPro, our flagship operations platform deployed across multiple client environments. You'll work in a small, senior team, own services end-to-end across the stack, and help shape the technical direction of a system used daily by real operational teams.

This role is perfect for an experienced full-stack engineer who enjoys solving complex workflow problems, building reliable APIs, and working across modern and legacy systems.

What You'll Do

Backend & Integrations

  • Build and maintain REST APIs using Java (Spring Boot), Python (Django/FastAPI), .NET (C#/), Golang, or comparable frameworks, powering dispatch, service orders, billing, and asset workflows.

  • Design relational schemas, migrations, and high-performance queries against SQL Server and PostgreSQL.

  • Develop integrations with enterprise platforms (Dynamics 365, Coupa, Trackunit, Power Automate/Logic Apps).

  • Maintain and modernize legacy backend code (Java/J2EE and similar stacks) while delivering new services in whichever language best fits the module.

  • Document APIs using OpenAPI/Swagger and maintain versioned contracts for client teams.

  • Implement workflow automation, asynchronous job processing, audit trails, reporting, and intelligent backend features — including AI-assisted or LLM-backed capabilities where they add value.

  • Ensure API performance, reliability, and security across high-volume operational workloads.

Frontend

  • Contribute to Angular UI components for WorkPro modules as needed.

  • Support role-based UI flows for dispatchers, managers, and field technicians.

  • Help maintain responsive, mobile-friendly interfaces across devices.

Team & Delivery

  • Work with a Product Owner to deliver features in tight, iterative cycles.

  • Collaborate with a Principal Developer on architecture and engineering standards.

  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and production deployments.

  • Own backend features from design through release.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional development experience (backend/API focus).

  • Strong hands-on experience shipping production REST APIs in at least one of: Java (Spring Boot), Python, .NET (C#), or Golang.

  • Solid SQL experience — relational modeling, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures.

  • Practical experience with an ORM (JPA/Hibernate, Entity Framework, SQLAlchemy, GORM, or equivalent) and migration tooling (Flyway, Liquibase, Alembic, or similar).

  • Experience maintaining and refactoring legacy codebases.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems (ERP/CRM).

  • Comfort with concurrency, messaging, and asynchronous processing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Testing discipline (JUnit/Mockito, pytest, xUnit/NUnit, Testcontainers, or equivalent depending on stack).

  • Basic working knowledge of Angular + TypeScript for occasional frontend contributions.

  • Good proficiency with AI-assisted development tools and workflows (e.g., Copilot, Claude, LLM-backed automation) is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, agile consulting environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with Dynamics 365, Power Automate, or Logic Apps.

  • SQL performance tuning and query optimization.

  • Experience with Azure (App Service, Functions, Service Bus), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.

  • Build and quality tooling: Maven/Gradle, pip/poetry, NuGet, Go modules, SonarQube, static analysis.

  • Deeper experience with AI-assisted development or LLM-backed workflows (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic tooling).

  • Background in operational, dispatch, or field-service software.

  • Polyglot experience across two or more of Java, Python, .NET, and Golang.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave

  • FSA/HSA options

  • BYOD reimbursement

AI Solutions Architect / Copilot Developer

Human-centered problem-solving meets Microsoft AI technology

Role Overview

We're looking for someone who thinks like a strategist, debates like a philosopher, and builds like an engineer. This role sits inside our AI Solutions Group, where the individual will need to reason clearly about ambiguous problems, build consensus among stakeholders, and translate that thinking into working solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform.

You'll partner directly with clients to figure out where AI can provide tangible improvements, gather and interpret requirements (even when clients aren't sure what they need), build solutions using Power Platform tools, help test and validate what you've built, and keep it optimized over time. This role is about people, logic, and persuasion as much as it is about implementation.

Why This Role Is Different

We believe the core skills for working effectively with AI aren't primarily technical. They're:

  • Creative problem solving: finding non-obvious paths through ambiguous, messy, or "less than optimal" situations
  • Strategic thinking: seeing the whole system, not just the ticket in front of you
  • Logic and structured reasoning: the same discipline that makes a good philosopher makes a good prompt engineer and a good solution architect
  • Communication and diplomacy: building consensus among stakeholders with competing priorities, teaching non-technical teams, and handholding through change

If you have a background in philosophy, strategy consulting, teaching, mediation, debate, logic, systems thinking, or similar disciplines, and you're excited by AI tools, we want to talk to you, even if your technical resume looks nontraditional.

What You'll Actually Do

With Clients

  • Act as a trusted advisor: ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and help clients articulate problems they haven't fully defined yet
  • Build consensus across stakeholders with different, sometimes conflicting, priorities. This is often the hardest part of the job
  • Teach and support end users through change, including patient handholding for less AI-fluent teams
  • Translate business problems into technical requirements, and technical constraints back into plain language

Building the Solution

  • Design and develop solutions in Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and related Power Platform tools
  • When necessary, integrate adaptive cards, connectors, triggers, and APIs to extend functionality
  • Craft effective prompts and grounding strategies for Copilot, Claude, and related AI tools. This is applied logic and language craft as much as coding
  • Build and prototype using Copilot-related AI tools for development and automation, always within strict data-control guardrails
  • Where possible, apply this same workflow to working with Anthropic’s Claude

Keeping It Working

  • Participate in testing, validation, and quality assurance
  • Support ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and enhancement of deployed solutions
  • Document decisions and create user guides that make adoption easier, not harder
  • Escalate and resolve issues, mentoring teammates along the way

Staying Sharp

  • Continuously evaluate new AI tools and platforms, with a healthy respect for compliance, governance, and data protection in a regulated environment
  • Bring an "AI mindset": curious, experimental, but never careless with sensitive data

What We're Looking For

Core (non-negotiable) skills:

  • Strong critical thinking and structured reasoning: you can break down a fuzzy problem into a clear plan
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to and persuade skeptical or non-technical audiences
  • Diplomacy and consensus-building, with comfort navigating disagreement without avoiding it
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and a track record of picking up new tools quickly
  • Comfort improvising solutions to non-technical problems, including political, organizational, or human friction, not just code bugs

Technical qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or real-world experience equivalent, any field, with philosophy, humanities, and social sciences welcome, and 3+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Hands-on experience (or strong aptitude to quickly gain it) with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) and Copilot Studio
  • Familiarity with modern AI tools, especially Microsoft Copilot and Claude, including prompt engineering and LLM behavior
  • Ability to work within a regulated environment with strict data controls, balancing experimentation against compliance

Preferred:

  • Background in strategy consulting, teaching, philosophy, logic, mediation/facilitation, or debate
  • Understanding of Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, and system integrations
  • Experience with RAG-based architectures
  • Certifications in Power Platform, AI, or Copilot-related specialties
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery

Work Environment

  • Location: United States, Eastern Time Zone
  • Travel: None required
  • Schedule: Remote-first, asynchronous-friendly, with some real-time overlap for meetings and collaboration

The Bigger Picture

This is a strategic development role on a high-performing team helping organizations reimagine how they work with AI, using Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot, Claude, and beyond. The technology moves fast, and we have a need for people who can think clearly, communicate persuasively, and navigate ambiguity with grace. If that's you, let’s talk.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) is hiring a Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to support our Higher Education business, with a focus on R1 research universities.

R1 institutions are not one customer. A single campus can behave like a dozen different organizations at the same time: central IT running enterprise applications, research computing and HPC teams, genomics and imaging cores, AI and machine learning labs competing for GPU time, an academic medical center with its own rules and its own budget, and faculty groups buying infrastructure directly with grant money. Decisions move through CIOs, research computing directors, principal investigators, sponsored programs offices, procurement, and consortium contract vehicles, often in parallel and not always in agreement.

That environment rewards someone who can hold a lot of context at once, translate between very different audiences, and connect technology to the outcomes these institutions actually care about: time to result for researchers, compliance with sponsor and grant requirements, data that stays usable for a decade or more, and budgets that have to stretch further every year.

You will be the technical lead on these accounts, working alongside account managers, specialists, and partners to build solutions customers can defend internally, both technically and financially.

Location: MD / VA

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop a real understanding of what drives each institution: research priorities, funding cycles, capital versus operating constraints, and who actually makes the decision
  • Connect technology, including the Everpure portfolio and the broader ecosystem, to measurable research and institutional outcomes
  • Move fluently between principal investigators, research computing staff, central IT, CIOs, finance, and procurement, adapting the conversation to each audience instead of delivering the same presentation
  • Build the business case alongside the technical one: total cost of ownership, power and cooling, data center footprint, staff time, and the real cost of the current environment
  • Support research workloads end to end, from instrument and sequencer output through HPC and AI pipelines to long-term retention and archive
  • Help customers work through data management questions: lifecycle and retention, reproducibility, sponsor and funding agency data sharing expectations, research data governance, and security requirements such as NIST 800-171 and CMMC where they apply
  • Partner closely with account managers, specialists, channel partners, and higher education purchasing consortia and contract vehicles
  • Take ownership of evaluations, benchmarks, proofs of concept, and system configurations, and secure the technical win
  • Capture requirements and translate them into solutions that help institutions grow their research capability rather than just their capacity
  • Author responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, which in this segment are frequent and detailed
  • Stay current on the competitive landscape and make sure our positioning reflects it honestly
  • Follow market and research computing trends closely enough to bring that thinking back into our organization
  • Lead by example living the Pure Values: Persistence, Creativity, Teamwork, Ownership and Customer-first

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend

The Opportunity:

Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.

You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.

AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.
  • Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.
  • Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.
  • Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.
  • Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.
  • Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.
  • Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.
  • Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.
  • Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.
  • Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.
  • Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.
  • Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.
  • A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.
  • Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.
  • Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.
  • An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.
  • Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.
  • Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.
  • Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.
  • Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.
  • Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Spain, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 106,680- EUR 128,016. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

jobs.description:
Willkommen bei easybill.

22.000+ Unternehmen verlassen sich auf easybill. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Rechnungen, Prozesse und Integrationen im Alltag einfach laufen. Mit easybill-mobile bringen wir zentrale Funktionen unserer Plattform auf iOS und Android – und suchen dich, um die App technisch und produktseitig mitzugestalten.

Du bekommst klare Prioritäten, kurze Wege und Raum, um Dinge sauber zu lösen. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung: für technische Entscheidungen, durchdachte Nutzerführung und eine App, auf die sich unsere Kundinnen und Kunden unterwegs verlassen können.

Das ideale Profil? Du bist Freelancer und in TypeScript, React Native und Expo richtig tief drin, verstehst die Besonderheiten mobiler Anwendungen und möchtest ein Produkt in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase entscheidend prägen. Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Kenntnisse in PHP und Symfony mit, um Funktionen auch auf Seiten unserer REST-API mitzugestalten.

Aufgaben

Du entwickelst easybill-mobile auf Basis von React Native, Expo und TypeScript für iOS und Android weiter. Eine technische Grundlage mit Anmeldung, Dashboard und Dokumentenübersichten ist bereits vorhanden. Darauf baust du auf und gestaltest die nächsten Schritte gemeinsam mit dem Team.

  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen rund um Rechnungen und Dokumente in verständliche mobile Abläufe und hochwertige native Oberflächen.
  • Du entwickelst die App-Architektur weiter und schaffst wartbare Strukturen für Navigation, wiederverwendbare Komponenten, Formulare und Datenzugriffe.
  • Du bindest unsere REST-API an und sorgst für verlässliches Datenmanagement: von typisierten Schnittstellen und Validierung bis zu Caching, Ladezuständen und Fehlerbehandlung.
  • Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen App und Backend. Bei Bedarf erweiterst du unsere REST-API auf Basis von PHP und Symfony, damit neue mobile Funktionen durchgängig umgesetzt werden können.
  • Du arbeitest an sicherer Authentifizierung, Session-Verwaltung und dem sorgfältigen Umgang mit sensiblen Kunden- und Geschäftsdaten.
  • Du behältst Performance und Plattformbesonderheiten im Blick – auch bei wechselnden Netzverbindungen, App-Wechseln und unterschiedlichen Geräten. Barrierefreiheit und Mehrsprachigkeit gehören für dich zur Produktqualität.
  • Du sicherst Änderungen mit automatisierten Tests und prüfst das Verhalten auf Simulatoren und echten Geräten. Du gestaltest Build-, Release- und Monitoring-Prozesse bis zur Veröffentlichung in den App Stores mit.
  • Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, bringst eigene Lösungsvorschläge ein und begleitest Funktionen von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung und Weiterentwicklung.
  • Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge wie Claude Code intensiv im Entwicklungsalltag und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Qualität, Verständlichkeit und Korrektheit der Ergebnisse.

Unser Mobile-Stack umfasst React Native, Expo, Expo Router und TypeScript. Dazu kommen TanStack Query und TanStack Form, Zod und NativeWind. Für Tests setzen wir auf Jest und React Native Testing Library. Unsere bestehende Plattform und die REST-API basieren auf PHP und Symfony.

Qualifikation

  • Du musst nicht jede Bibliothek bereits kennen. Entscheidend ist, dass du deinen Stack verstehst, gute technische Entscheidungen triffst und dich selbstständig in neue Themen einarbeitest.
  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit TypeScript, React Native und Expo auf Senior-Level und hast mobile Anwendungen über die reine Implementierung hinaus bis zum Release begleitet.
  • Du verstehst React, Komponentenarchitektur, Zustandsverwaltung und asynchrone Datenflüsse und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich strukturieren.
  • Du kennst die Besonderheiten von iOS und Android und gehst systematisch an Performance-Probleme, Plattformfehler und Debugging heran.
  • Du bist sicher in der Anbindung von REST-APIs und verstehst API-Verträge, Authentifizierung, Validierung und Fehlerbehandlung.
  • Idealerweise bringst du zusätzlich Kenntnisse in PHP und Symfony mit. Du kannst bestehende API-Endpunkte verstehen, Fehler zwischen App und Backend analysieren und Schnittstellen eigenständig erweitern.
  • Automatisierte Tests, nachvollziehbare technische Entscheidungen und wartbarer Code gehören für dich zum Entwicklungsalltag.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und pragmatisch, kommunizierst klar und behältst den Nutzen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden im Blick.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte sind Erfahrung mit EAS, nativen Modulen in Swift oder Kotlin sowie App-Store-Veröffentlichungen und mobilen Release-Prozessen. Auch eigene veröffentlichte Apps, Open-Source-Beiträge oder öffentliche Experimente auf GitHub sind willkommen.

Wenn du nicht jedes Kästchen erfüllst, aber ein außergewöhnlich starker Engineer bist: Bewirb dich trotzdem und zeig uns, was du gebaut hast. Zeig uns, was du gebaut hast!

Benefits

  • Remote-First Team – keine Bindung an einen Standort
  • Eine inspirierende und flexible Arbeitsumgebung, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung basiert
  • Die Möglichkeit, an der Gestaltung der Unternehmensstrategie und -kultur mitzuwirken
  • Ein engagiertes Team und die Chance, gemeinsam an innovativen Lösungen zu arbeiten
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents

Du möchtest easybill auf iOS und Android mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Besonders interessieren uns Projekte, bei denen du technische Verantwortung übernommen hast: Was hast du gebaut, welche Entscheidungen hast du getroffen und was hast du dabei gelernt?

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an AI-Augmented QA Engineer to own and expand automated testing for an early-stage, fast-moving security platform.

You’ll work closely with frontend and backend engineers to build reliable test coverage, strengthen the existing Playwright test suite, and ensure critical product workflows remain stable as the platform evolves.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll have significant ownership. You’ll receive clear goals around test coverage and reliability rather than step-by-step instructions, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working independently and improving systems proactively.

What You’ll Own

Test Automation & Coverage

  • Write and maintain automated end-to-end tests using Playwright
  • Expand coverage across critical product workflows
  • Build regression tests that run automatically on every pull request
  • Test workflows including dashboards, detection workflows, device management, user permissions, and settings
  • Keep the test architecture clean, maintainable, and scalable as the product grows

Test Infrastructure & Reliability

  • Own the reliability of the automated test suite and CI pipeline
  • Diagnose and reduce flaky tests
  • Manage test data and seed data requirements
  • Monitor and improve staging environment stability
  • Maintain reliable test execution as the product and test suite expand

AI-Assisted Exploratory Testing

  • Use AI-assisted browser automation to explore edge cases and uncover bugs
  • Work with Claude and LLM-based tools as part of daily testing workflows
  • Experiment with AI-driven testing approaches beyond scripted test cases
  • Identify issues that traditional automated regression tests may not catch
  • Continuously explore ways to improve QA efficiency through AI tooling

Engineering Collaboration

  • Work directly with frontend and backend engineers throughout the development cycle
  • Collaborate on testing requirements and critical product flows
  • Communicate test failures, bugs, and reliability issues clearly
  • Contribute to a culture where engineers trust and act on automated test results
  • Take ownership of QA improvements without relying on layers of project management

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of QA, software testing, or test automation experience preferred
  • Candidates with less experience will also be considered if they demonstrate strong automation skills and relevant hands-on experience
  • Strong TypeScript skills and the ability to write clean, maintainable test code
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright, Cypress, or a similar E2E testing framework
  • Strong understanding of web application testing
  • Understanding of DOM interaction, network requests, and asynchronous behavior
  • Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot flaky automated tests
  • Experience creating or maintaining automated regression tests
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of testing goals
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Willingness to learn and use AI tools as part of the testing workflow
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to test reliability

Nice to Have

  • Experience building E2E testing infrastructure from scratch
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI pipelines
  • Experience with test data management, parallelization, and test reporting
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright specifically
  • Experience testing complex B2B web applications
  • Experience with multi-tenant applications and role-based access
  • Experience testing multi-step workflows

jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to own quality for our AI voice virtual agent.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to own quality for our AI voice virtual agent. This role is for someone who is equally comfortable reasoning about a large language model's behavior and reading a SIP trace.

You should be interested in testing non-deterministic systems. A voice agent takes a live phone call, transcribes speech that may be accented or noisy, interprets intent, reasons over an LLM, generates a spoken reply, and decides whether to resolve the request or hand it to a human—all within a latency budget callers will notice. Nothing in that chain can be validated with a simple assertion of equality, so you will design the evaluation approach that makes it testable anyway.

You should also be interested in the underlying telephony. Testing this agent means placing real calls: provisioning SIP endpoints and softphones, driving calls programmatically, controlling media conditions, and distinguishing a model failure from a codec, jitter, or call-routing issue.

  • PLEASE SUBMIT CV IN ENGLISH.
  • ONLY ACCEPTING CANDIDATES FROM LATAM.
  • ADVANCED SPOKEN ENGLISH IS REQUIRED.

Responsibilities

  • Embed fully within a Scrum team, participating in all ceremonies and maintaining associated artifacts.

  • Own the end-to-end test strategy for the AI voice virtual agent across the LLM, speech, and telephony layers.

  • Design test scenarios for complex conversational behavior, including multi-turn dialogues, interruptions and barge-in, ambiguous or incomplete input, out-of-scope requests, human escalation/transfer, and failure recovery.

  • Build and maintain an evaluation framework for non-deterministic output, leveraging golden datasets, semantic/rubric-based assertions, and automated regression detection for prompt, model, or retrieval changes.

  • Adversarially test the agent against hallucinations, incorrect grounding, guardrail bypasses, prompt injections, and unauthorized disclosure of customer data.

  • Prepare and provision SIP devices, endpoints, and call scenarios to automate call origination end-to-end.

  • Diagnose failures across the entire stack, isolating issues down to the LLM, ASR (speech recognition), TTS (text-to-speech), media path, or call routing layer.

  • Extend automated coverage and integrate test suites into the CI/CD pipeline to serve as release gates.

  • Define and track core quality metrics, including task completion, containment, intent accuracy, transcription accuracy, response latency, and escalation correctness.

  • Maintain documented test coverage in the TMS with full traceability to business requirements.

  • Communicate and escalate quality risks to stakeholders backed by data and evidence.

Requirements:

    • 5+ years in QA, with recent hands-on ownership of a complex, integrated product.

    • Practical experience testing SIP/VoIP systems, including call flows, SIP signaling, media handling, softphones, or SIP trunking, with the ability to troubleshoot using SIP traces or packet captures.

    • Demonstrated creativity in test design (live scenario design will be a core part of the interview process and heavily weighted).

    • Proficiency in Python, sufficient to independently build and maintain automation frameworks.

    • Experience testing non-deterministic or probabilistic systems, with a clear approach to designing assertions for variable outputs.

    • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to define quality metrics, justify their calculation, and use data to back release decisions.

    • Hands-on experience with formal TMS tools and Jira.

    • Professional fluency in English (spoken and written), with reliable overlap with US Eastern business hours.

We use the following technologies:

  • Python with pytest for test automation.

  • Playwright for browser and WebRTC-based call driving.

  • JsSIP / WebRTC for programmatic call origination and media control.

  • SIP softphones and devices for manual and exploratory testing.

  • Allure TestOps as our TMS, linking automated runs to documented test cases.

  • Jira for project management and issue tracking.

  • Jenkins & GitHub Actions for CI/CD pipelines.

  • Grafana for quality and delivery metrics.

  • LLM APIs and evaluation tooling — currently in active development, and we are open to any effective approach.

Pluses:

  • Direct experience testing LLM-based or conversational AI products, including evaluation frameworks and LLM-as-a-judge approaches.

  • Familiarity with speech technologies, including ASR/transcription accuracy measurement (WER), TTS quality assessment, endpointing, and silence detection.

  • Experience with RAG or retrieval-grounded systems, specifically in evaluating grounding correctness and context retrieval.

  • WebRTC and media-layer testing experience, including codec behavior and performance degradation under jitter or packet loss.

  • Background in testing IVR, contact center, or conversational IVR platforms.

  • Multilingual testing capabilities, with emphasis on Spanish/English code-switching.

  • Literacy in prompt engineering, sufficient to analyze system prompts and identify potential failure modes

We are pleased to offer:

  • Remote work opportunity!

  • B2B Employment ($, gross).

  • Stable job with long-term growth perspective.

  • Competitive salary with annual performance review.

  • Really good hardware.

  • An exciting and challenging job with talented people around.

  • Continuous learning and career growth opportunities.

  • Compensation for professional training, seminars, and conferences.

  • Referral program: get rewarded for helping us grow the team with talented people.

  • Company-supported English classes to enhance your professional growth.

Creativity is a core requirement for this role, not a nice-to-have. The defects that matter here are found by someone who imagines the caller who interrupts mid-sentence, switches languages halfway through, gives a partial account number, answers a different question, or deliberately tries to jailbreak the agent. Scenario design is the primary skill we are hiring for.

Current State: We have automated call testing built on JsSIP/WebRTC with Python and Playwright, alongside a growing body of test scenarios. The evaluation layer—how we score responses consistently, catch regressions when a prompt or model changes, and report quality metrics leadership can act on—is where this role will have the most impact.

About us:

IDT Technologies is a part of IDT Corporation—an American telecommunications company founded in 1990 and headquartered in New Jersey. It is an industry leader in prepaid communication and payment services and one of the world's largest international voice carriers. We are listed on the NYSE, employ over 1,500 people across 20+ countries, and have revenues in excess of $1.5 billion.

Net2Phone () is a global provider of unified cloud communications solutions. It offers an integrated communications suite featuring powerful collaboration tools, including voice, messaging, chat, and unlimited domestic and international calling to 23+ countries.

jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a Principal Analyst to join our GTM Analytics team, where we turn data into the insights that shape decisions across Sales, Strategy, RevOps, Marketing, Deal Desk, and more. In this role, you'll be a force multiplier for the senior manager and a technical anchor for the broader team, taking on the most complex and time-sensitive questions across the business. When a request genuinely calls for a dashboard, you'll shape the requirements and propose the logic for our central data team to build.

In this role, you'll handle the team's most ambiguous and time-sensitive requests — often scoping a question live, in a meeting with senior stakeholders, and turning it into a usable answer quickly. You'll build models that blend statistical rigor and financial fluency (forecasting, pipeline coverage, quota simulation), review and unblock work from other team members, and represent the team's analytical judgment in rooms the senior manager isn't always in.

This is a full-time position based out of our Costa Rica office.

Technologies You’ll Use

SQL, dbt, Looker, Omni, Sigma, Excel and/or Google Sheets (financial modeling), Hex or similar notebook tools (exploratory analysis), Python (statistical libraries), Salesforce, Claude (or similar AI assistants)

What You’ll Do

  • Translate ambiguous, often verbal requests from senior stakeholders into a scoped analytical plan in real time
  • Build and maintain complex models that combine statistical and financial methods (e.g., pipeline coverage, quota simulation, forecast accuracy)
  • Deliver fast, directionally-correct analysis under time pressure, then refine to full rigor when the deliverable warrants it
  • Represent the team's analytical judgment in meetings with VP+ stakeholders without requiring the manager's involvement
  • Reframe stakeholder questions when the request as asked doesn't match the underlying business problem
  • Review and unblock analytical work from Level 2 and Level 3 team members
  • Triage incoming requests and help route them appropriately across the team
  • Own end-to-end delivery of strategic, cross-functional analyses (e.g., account matching strategy, end-of-quarter deal pattern analysis)
  • Apply statistical methods (e.g., regression, confidence intervals, cohort analysis) to strengthen the rigor of insights
  • Collaborate with Finance's own analysts when a request touches revenue or forecasting logic, to make sure GTM models stay consistent with how Finance defines and tracks those numbers

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Advanced, self-serve proficiency in SQL, dbt, and BI tools (Looker, Omni, Sigma) — able to independently get, analyze, and visualize data with minimal support
  • Strong understanding of SaaS sales motions (opportunity stages, pipeline progression, SFDC structure) and working knowledge of financial/forecasting concepts (ARR, quota attainment, pipeline coverage, bookings) — enough to collaborate confidently with Finance's own analysts, not to replace them
  • Statistical knowledge (e.g., regression analysis, distributions, confidence intervals) applied to business problems
  • Analytical mindset with the judgment to reframe a stakeholder's question when it doesn't match the underlying business problem
  • Ability to quickly scope and prioritize ambiguous requests under time pressure, often live in meetings, and strong judgment on when to move fast vs. when to prioritize rigor
  • Experience reviewing or mentoring others' analytical work
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy in front of senior or executive stakeholders

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience owning forecasting or planning methodology, not just reporting on it
  • Prior experience in FP&A or a quantitative finance role
  • Experience building simulation models
  • Some informal people leadership or team lead experience
  • Advanced Python (pandas, numpy, statsmodels)

Perks and Benefits

  • RSU stock grants*

  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.
